text: Beautiful venue to see a show.  I’ve seen so many awesome shows here, the Dirty Heads was probably my favorite. The stage is beautiful, it’s a great live music spot!!

name: Bev Stevens
text: Absolutely love this theatre and I will be looking for more opportunities to go to events here. The seats are a little narrow so be prepared. But getting to your seats are easy and the view is great. I was in the upper balcony for the Nutcracker ballet and was able to see very clearly. I just with the guy behind me hadn't felt it necessary to keep his feet over the seat next to me..

name: David Metzger
text: The theater is set up in a way that allows for good views everywhere. There is a balcony with plenty of extra seating. A couple bars available. The merch table is in an inconvenient place in the main foyer where the crowd is entering. Sound was pretty good. Loud with very little distortion.

name: Katie Hatch
text: They have been absolutely knocking it our of the Park with their lineup. Good variety, frequent concerts and a really great space. Standing GA up fronts and seated GA on the Maine floor on the back half and balcony level. A fee bars inside the concert hall with standing elevated space.

name: Mac Coldwell
text: Great venue. They have been pulling on some great acts in lately. Very efficient security. Decent drink selection. The historical renovations look great. There is no of street parking, but you can find parking within a 5 minute walk. Garage options also available.

name: Becky S
text: Fun place!  You have to be in the right mood for general admission it's a little young & kinda crazy. Get a seat if you don't want to be danced into or spilled on.. Balcony looked like great place to be 😜

name: Ken Moulton Jr.
text: Great appearence in the main hall area, the performance area, and the balcony. I've seen comedy shows, light rock, techno, and heavy metal shows here. For the most part it's an awesome spot. There are a few downfalls... Parking is horrendous. It cost $30 at the closest garage, and it takes forever to get out after a show. If you choose not to use the garage, you're on the street, and there are only about 25 spaces. Also, I don't know if it's just the clientele of a venue like this who ruin the experience, but they always seem to have disgusting bathrooms, and overflowing toilets.

name: Kris Howes
text: Love this place! I've probably seen over a dozen concerts here. The multiple bars are a plus for keeping lines short. The upper balcony seats are tight, but a great view. Usually sounds great here and the building is awesome

name: Trevor Geiger
text: The cornerstone of the Maine Music Scene. Without Lauren Wayne and the leadership who took over/renovated the venue in 2010, Portland would not be what it is today. The current layout provides great sound and easy access to drinks, bathrooms, etc. Impeccable booking/programming just makes it even more impressive. Best venue in Maine. Hands down.

name: Amber Young-Dalton
text: Love this beautiful theater. Went to see a Magic show, enjoyed the event immensely!

name: ben mullen
text:
Good venue in Portland.
Saw an acoustic show. A great night.

name: Jinni Workman
text: I always enjoy seeing shows at the state theater. The atmosphere is great. It's no e to be able to go from sitting to standing and vice versa for most shows. My husband and I most recently saw the Rise Against show at the theater. Drinks are a little pricey(7-9 dollars for a beer), but I don't drink much so it didn't bother me. Good use an increase in restrooms though as it took nearly twenty minutes to be able to use the ladies room.

name: Philip Sidebotham
text: Had a great time at the State theater it was my first time there. Great time no matter where you are at in the theater.

name: Jeff Sherman
text:
Great venue. Drinks are reasonable for a venue (although people complain about it). I wish coat check was a little faster and would be willing to pay more money. We actually missed the opener waiting to put our jackets away.

Overall the place is really cool and I cannot wait to be back.

name: SHARMAN MAHONEY
text: Great venue with amazing sound! The building is absolutely fabulous and the staff has been super amazing every show I have attended;) the State Theatre has an eclectic mix of shows a true Portland gem.

name: Eric Cyr
text: Amazing venue. Great staff.

name: Daniel Barnhard
text: Very nice concert venue! Saw Steel Panther, the staff were professional and courteous. The theater itself is art deco but very well preserved can't wait to see my next show here!

text: Great venue...Jesse and the band were phenomenal...

text:
My first visit to this venue. Good sight lines to the stage and a lot of folks loved to watch some of the show from the bar area inside the theatre. Definitely got very warm in the theatre. Seats were comfortable and good leg room where we were.
The staff are wonderful and helped make the experience more memorable.

name: Pietro Monteleano
text: So far I've been to two concerts at the State Theatre. Staff courteous and efficient. Does take some time to get in as they do a thorough job of keeping everyone safe. Room is glorious old Theatre. Good sound, seating as well as standing general admission areas.

name: Dayne Dennett
text: #culture #livemusic #concert #standingroomonly went to see Umphrey's, and it was a great show!

name: Christopher King
text: I have seen some great shows here. Always fun and tickets remain reasonable. Recently saw Devil Makes 3 and the Lost Dog Street Band. Excellent, had a blast.

name: Ashlee Smith
text: Large, antique, decorative theater. Very good lighting variety and options, as well as large speakers that produce nice base sounds. Has bar inside the theater, I recommend for adults. Not a playground for children.

name: Jessi Polchies
text: Place is pretty righteous if you're catching a show. Ticket prices are always stellar... But unfortunetly they make up the difference on the adult beverages. It could use more restroom facilities, as the lines are always long but for the most part, pretty decent venue, and I've been a patron before the renovations and after ( so for the kids... That's a long a$$ time). To State, thanks for being a decently priced place to catch a show and for the great artist that you bring!

name: Cynthia Ladd
text: We enjoyed Little Feat here . Great venue we always like it . Will be back .

name: Angela Dubois
text: My favorite venue, especially in Portland. Perfect size and doesn’t get too hot. All general admission usually which is really cool too.

name: Matthew Lee
text: I saw Lucinda William's perform here and she and the theater were amazing. Not a bad seat in the house and the sound system was fantastic. It's a small performance space so every seat is close. I really enjoy seeing shows here.

name: Jodi Jeannette
text: Really nice looking venue with no bad seats! Great for  rock shows or comedy shows alike.

name: Alfred Speredelozzi
text: This was a lovely theater.  We got great seats for a Kansas concert here.  The bar inside was a nice touch.  The crowd was rocking while we were there and we had an awesome time.

name: Alexander Blackstone
text:
Was at State Theater for a SYSK show, the show was great and the theater was unique!

The venue was very clean, the front got everyone into the building quickly.

Bar service was available, the line moved much slower then it should have with the number of staff they had behind the bar.

Will definitely enjoy many more shows here!

name: Austin Cantara
text: Great shows, acoustics/sound are iffy. Great drink prices and always fun no matter the show.

name: Lina Creed
text: Easy entry, parking garage close by, AMAZING acoustics, and Portland pie pizza!? The state theatre has an awesome vibe for any type of show. (Gorgol Bodellos encore of course rocked the place!)

name: Rachel Colton
text: Love going to shows here! Went to several this year and had a great experience no matter where we were sitting. I’m sure I’ll be back!

name: Mountain Man

name: Tom Kane
text: Nice theater that does a ton of different events. Just try to avoid it in the summer if you can't handle the heat as there is no AC and a lot of people crammed into a smaller venue.

name: Lindsey Ho
text: Pictures are of The Black Heart Burlesque show. The seats could be a little better to allow easy viewing and they're way too close together. The climate inside the theater isn't well-maintained, but it's a nice place to see a show.

name: Alec Salisbury
text: Great seeing Pete but no Air Conditioning

name: Mark Levensalor
text: This theater is absolutely not the place it was 20 years ago. Clean and well staffed, it's a wonderful venue for any event.

name: Melissa Doughty
text: The State is a favorite venue for music. Small enough to be intimate, yet large enough for a good crowd. A great mix of new artists and legends are booked, creating a diverse mix of music. Ornate decor, and a balcony, as well as a sky bar overlooking the stage, are just a few of the little extras. The staff is friendly and helpful. Go see a show! You will love it!

name: Jason Ustaris
text: Always a great venue that caters to both people who want to be up close or that want a comfortable view from the back or balcony. The bars and coat check add to the comfort of winter concert going.

name: Elizabeth O'Zemko

We were here for the Bear Hands and Walk the Moon concert, and were here for Kaycee Musgrave a few weeks ago.

The venue is nice. We like the balcony area for the view but there's not really a bad spot. The acoustics are phenomenal. Every band we've heard here has sounded great. We definitely plan on coming back.

text: It's a great venue, intimate, comfortable and nice to enjoy a drink during the show. But the acoustics still aren't great. You can hear the loud noise from the instruments but the vocals often got lost. Could be my older ears, could be the sound crew setting up. Still was a fun concert.

name: Jeff Chetkauskas
text:
The design of this historic place was amazing.  This place has shows year round with many A and B-list acts to see.  The sound quality is good with all seats considerably close, so you can see what is happening on the stage from any seat.

The one criticism I would have is because it is a historic building there is no air conditioning.  In the summer, if it is hot or humid outdoors, expect it to be hot indoors with little relief.  The security does open the doors, but my experience is it provides little relief.

Be sure to have your tickets saved on your phone.  They do not accept printed tickets.

name: Mark Maguire
text: Dropkick Murphys were an incredible show!!!

name: Erica Mericaa
text: Once you go in you are not even granted the freedom to go outside for fresh air , not a fan.

name: Erik K
text: This place has come a long way in recent years! Happy with several recent shows. Staff is on point but laid back. Facilities are clean. Great variety of talent coming through.

name: CHAD DAVIS
text: It was awesome I don't think a bad seat in the place

name: Jennie Walker
text: A+ venue, with multiple levels for GA, both seated and standing. So many types of shows come through here, from music of all genres to comedy to drag. The building is also set up quite nicely - there's a place to order drinks on both the middle and lower levels, free water in the lobby, and coat check on the middle level. The staff is always wonderful and ready to help, and while security can sometimes seem stern, all that I've come across have been friendly and an absolute delight to talk to. For photographers, the shows almost always have a barricade/photo pit unless it's a seated event. Also, even seated events have standing room at the top most balcony level behind the seats if you need to stretch your legs for a moment.

name: Emily Smith
text: I always absolutely love this venue. It's beautiful, with plenty of vantage points for enjoying a great band. The sound quality is also superb. It's definitely hot in the Summer, so if you're delicate about that, beware. The bartenders know how to make tasty basic drinks and the bathrooms are generally pretty clean. They've improved the experience for disabled folks as well, which is important to me and my crew.

name: Miles Stanton
text: Just saw the Jay and silent Bob roadshow here, great local theater!

name: Kris Pahel
text:
I've been going here for years.  I love the venue.  It has several bars and you can see the show very well from the balcony.
They moved us right along for a sold out show.  The line cleared in under 5 minutes.
Security was present and visible.
The bathrooms week okay..
Awesome place.

name: Michael S
text:
BEWARE...hours for advanced ticket purchases at the box office have recently changed. You can purchase tickets for the Congress Street box office on Wednesday and Thursday ONLY from 10 am - 5 pm and 1 hour before the day of the show.

Have been going to the State Theatre for concerts and film festivals for a lot of years.

It is a great place to see live concerts as well as the annual film Festival. They have several bar stations at this venue so that you can enjoy your favorite beverage pre-and during admission of the show.

A great place to experience!

name: Sjoukje Stewart
text: Rob Thomas was amazing on August 21st! Great way to celebrate our 3rd anniversary. =)

name: SpiDys Tangled Web
text: Went to see Tape Face! What a fantastic show. I love the original architecture. Staff was a little confused how to use the electronic ticket ( that was scary) all in All a great experience.

text:

The seats in the balcony area have very little leg room. As someone who is over 6ft tall I had an incredibly hard time squeezing in.

name: Ricky Allen
text:
I went to see Sleep, a heavy metal band.  Admission was general audience, so no assigned seating, and most everyone was standing.  The band sounded pretty good, if a little muddy at times.
The biggest issue was me being short.  I was unable to get up front, and unable to get to the balcony.  This meant incredibly poor seeing angles throughout the entire show.  Wasn't a huge deal, but did hamper my experience.  The venue staff seemed nice and relaxed.

I might go back, but probably not for a GA show.

name: Pippa Jollie
text: Concert fabulous.  Venue not so much. Rude loud staff interfered with be able to hear and enjoy the show.

Absolutely beautiful venue

name: Azulea Cormu
text:
TL;DR They have had the same complaints for years and don't change anything, so help yourself out and don't wear anything heavier than shorts and a t-shirt.

I hate this venue. I try avoiding it if I can, usually opting to go to other venues in New Hampshire or Boston if artists are playing there as well and it works with my work schedule. That's right, I'd rather drive to a different state than go here. I understand that it is a historic and old building, but the acoustics are terrible and I have to plug my ears to begin to hear the music clearly. It also gets hotter than satan's t@!nt and they try to combat this by simply opening a side door on the balcony. The latest concert I went to here was Lord Huron. We got in just after the opener finished, about 1/2 an hour before he went on. I was wearing a lightweight dress and was feeling the sweat on my neck and back before they even came on. My boyfriend was fanning his shirt the whole time, and he was wearing shorts and a t shirt. This wasn't a concert where everyone is jumping around, this was pretty laid back. The only time I've enjoyed this venue was seeing John Mulaney, I don't remember it being miserably hot then. Not that this review is going to change the way they run things, but if you take anything away from this: Wear shorts and a T-Shirt at the most! Go nude if you can.

name: Aavery Mundt
text:
This beautiful theater in the heart of Portland is always worth seeing a show at.  Their beautifully restored pipe organ is always worth coming out to see.

If you are looking for an inexpensive show that is family friendly their organ shows are the one to see.   This is a unique a wonderful experience.  Whether they are playing classical, or contemporary pieces their guest organist series is always a pleasure.  One of only two cities left to have a municipal organist, stop in and support this beautiful art.

Check out their calendar and come in for a show, you won't regret it.

name: Christyn Waisanen
text: Brought my 3 year old son to see Daniel Tiger. Parking was available at "Top of the Hill" lot (open evenings for all Merrill auditorium events) as well as across from that lot for $10. Within a 3 minute walk to the auditorium. Ticket window is straight through the door on the left within a large open area. Auditorium entrance is through doors to the right and down the hall. Drinks and snacks were available and allowed within the theater with the $2 purchase of a travel cup with cover. Both non-alcoholic beverages and soda/water available. Theater itself nice not extravagant. Aisles are wide enough for a wheelchair and there are reserved handicapped seats available. There is balcony seating as well. Theater is small enough that even the back rows can see the stage and actors clearly. Sound for this particular show was very loud. There was a slight mix up in regards to the VIP tickets but only in reference to how things were going down for the photo op after the show. This part could have been more organized. When I purchased the vip tickets was written that I was purchasing a signed poster (got the same unsigned poster that I could have purchased separately) and a meet and greet with the cast(only got Daniel Tiger and a different Prince Wednesday than was on stage) and photo was taken with my cell phone (so if I had not brought it in to the venue with me I would not have gotten the photo). Because of the disorganization it was after 9 before we got to Daniel and 15m before they had formed a line for Daniel (each family was told to sit in their seats and they would come get us for the photo). Staff was friendly and professional, and very understanding of the theater being filled with restless infants and toddlers. Would use this venue again.

name: Maine Osprey
text: So we saw Gordon Lightfoot in May 2017 and last night Ray Lamontagne at the Merrill. Ray was better musically, but Gordon was more fun. Here’s why: for the Gordon Lightfoot show we sat in the back on the lower level, but for last night’s show we opted for balcony seats. We were asked to wait during the opening act for a break between songs to be seated (we were late because there was quite a line at concession). Once we sat down people behind us instantly, angrily, told us to be quiet. We apologized. Then during the main performance between songs I whispered thank you and I love you to my date and the same people sicced the usher on us. Mind you this wasn’t during a song. So basically what I’m saying is be careful with seat selection. On the balcony three hours of total silence and stillness is the expectation. It was similar to seeing Yo Yo Ma or the BSO. You can’t get up or speak the entire show....which can be tough. Otherwise the acoustics are amazing, but I much preferred the lower level.

text: The amazing smell of bbq and freshly smoked meats was the first thing my sister and I smelled when we got out of the car, very enticing! We opted to sit outside on a cute patio, though it was too close to the road and the chairs were very uncomfortable. Inside, the restaurant was a cozy and welcoming space. The service was fast and friendly. The food was obviously fresh and surpassed our expectations! They have some of the best cornbread, ever! Their house-made sauces were great and they had locally produced Root Beer. Our major gripes came with our bill and to-go order. Firstly, the menu was priced differently than our bill and the waiter disagreed the point, but then quickly corrected the bill when he realized we were right. Secondly, the container of sour cream we requested with our meal (which traditionally should have been provided) was over-priced at $2 and only half-filled.

name: Christopher Bell
text:
Went to Elsmere for my anniversary and it was a positive experience. We were greeted as soon as we walked in. Food came a reasonable amount of time after we ordered. The food was excellent! We ordered "the works" and the side sampler. The meat fell off the ribs, the brisket was superb, and the chicken was the star.

We sat in some of the stool stables. The stools don't have much of a back to them, so they might not be comfortable for some. There are booths, regular seating, and some outdoor seating. There are also two bar tops, with one overlooking the kitchen.

There were lots of families there so it looks like it's a good place to bring the family, and judging from the decor and atmosphere it looks like it would be a great place after the kids have gone to bed as well.

Parking is a little limited, so be prepared to park on a side street near by.

Overall, it's a must go to restaurant. Highly recommended.

name: Michael Lionetta
text: The place looked cool on the outside.... Unfortunately went at a busy time Saturday  6:30 ish. Was told a table wait was 25 minutes. But after 50 minutes and seeing other people getting seated before us. We left. Should've made reservations if they take them. But went to Willow's and it was great.......

resp.text: We're sorry to hear that this happened, Michael. Due to the fact that every table in the South Portland location can accommodate small parties (3 or less), but only five tables in the entire building can fit parties of 4 or more, we reserve these 6-top booths for large parties (4 or more) between the hours of 5 and 8pm. There are often times when we have multiple large parties come in the door all at once, which is the reason we stick to the policy until 8 most nights. We also only accept reservations for parties of 8 or more. We hope you understand.

text: I liked the atmosphere. The food left wasn't the best. The burnt ends nachos were tasty and the cornbread was excellent. Brisket was dry and the sausage wasn't very flavorful. The ribs were decent however they lacked any smoke flavor. I was pretty disappointed this being my first visit here.

resp.text: We hope you'll be back again soon to give us another try, Andy! We're sorry your first visit wasn't as you had expected.

text: Food was good and atmosphere was great. Had lunch there with my best friend and the waiter was very nice to each of us. Location was a little sketchy but once you are inside its wonderful!

resp.text: We hope to see you again soon, Tatyna!

name: Chris Douglas
text: If not southern Maine's best BBQ its in the top 5. They offer 3-4 styles of BBQ, 4 types of sauces, 3-4 types of meat, a full bar with craft beers, desserts if you have room and lots of napkins. Indoor & outdoor seating, although out is only about 6 tables.  Service is always good. The restrooms are clean. The front doors may be difficult to get through with any aid or assisting device. Most of the parking is street side.

resp.text: Woohoo! We'll take top 5!

text: Food was great. Service was ok until our waitress got a big group than I could not get her attention. I would go back.

text: Been going to elsmere for quite sometime.  The food is delicious and the sauces are a hit as well.  The service at my last visit was very prompt, sometimes it can be slow depending upon how busy the place is.  I recommend going when they open on the weekends, fast service and run of the place for seating.  Nights are usually pretty busy, but you can get seated in good time.

resp.text: Thank you, Sam, for stopping by to leave this review! Glad you love the sauces!

text: Good menu little pricey, have more of the old port pricing, but the food was good. The macaroni and cheese has onion powder in it so for those who don't like onions, lookout for the Mac and cheese 🧀. The tacos were good, better if hard shell was used instead of soft, less soggy. The corn bread doesn't have actual corn in it, was a bit surprised by that at first, thought I had something in the cornbread that wasnt supposed to be there hahaha

text: My friends love it. I took a bite of my daughter's brisket and it was delicious. I am salt restricted and my Caesar salad was an unpleasant melange consisting of tough ends of romaine and what looked like pieces of plastic (parmesan cheese). That said, the dressing was very good.

resp.text: Hi, Vanya! We are so sorry to hear you didn't enjoy your salad, and we thank you for your feedback. We hope you'll come in again soon and give us another chance!

Tacos were the best thing for sure but these were (for full disclosure purposes) definitely some gentrified fancy pants tacos. The full bar was nice and I had a good specialty cocktail. Overall: meh.

name: Paul Dixon
text:
Had dinner in here on a Friday night recently.  The place was busy as the crowd for the theater place up the road was still there - but we got a seat at the bar.

It's a funky place - an old dry cleaners I believe - and a little bit 'hip', but without being pretentiously so (I'd say).  Decent beer selection (although a touch pricey).

The food was excellent.  The brisket in particular was amazing.  I consider myself a bit of a barbeque snob, and it's definitely on a par with the best.

I just wish it was a touch cheaper (don't we all)!

name: Christopher Julian
text: It's a really clean and neat grocery store but overall it's mostly locally made products and some of it is over priced but very enjoyably!! I would recommend this place if you were looking to eat healthy and organic. The register was fast and they did all the work this time. 👍👍🍎🥦🍄

name: BirthME Maine's premier doula service
text: Best healthy frozen meal options that actually taste good!  Prices are great!  Customer service is usually awesome.  Worth the trip even if you dont live nearby.

name: Oscar Enrique Phelps
text: Love how they are taking care of the clients with COVID-19. Very sad that they don’t have the reusable shopping bags from Maine in this location!

name: Jennifer LeBroke
text: Trader Joe's always has the most interesting selection of foods, spices, and wine. The staff is phenomenal, always helpful and very interactive with my cheerful 18 month old who loves to wave and greet those around her. Always an enjoyable experience.

name: Sarah Novak
text:
I love the idea behind Trader Joe's but found a lack of "assistance" and when I asked if they had ice I could buy (long distance home) I was directed to Walgreens - which changed my cart choices.
The cashier must have assumed I knew the covid protocol (am ALL FOR SAFETY but 1st time at Trader Joes) and I felt a bit embarrassed with the attitude - the baggers were amazing!!!!!! Some great items and many LOVE it.

name: Jay Tarbox
text: I hiked over to trader Joe's with a backpack full of beaver pelts.  I tried to buy some organic cauliflower mac and cheese with them but they were not accepted.  I had to pay in American dollars for them.  Five stars despite that and the mac and cheese was good

name: Peter Gore
text: Awesome. Love it here. Great products, very good prices and the staff here is very helpful and accommodating. There is often a line right now, but the staff have it moving, and wait times are minimal. What they say about Trader Joe's is true. Shop here.

name: Craig Bowers
text: Couldn't finish a frozen meal, disgusting. What happened to being able to just buy a basic one from this place that didn't require time segments at different settings? Might just go to Hannaford.

name: Clint Marshall
text:
Good prices, quality products, decent selection. Well worth a visit.
The only downside is that the parking lot is often full.

name: Jason Levandoski
text: I love everything about this place. Good food, nice people, wicked good deals... What's not to love?

name: Ann Rich
text: They always have the most beautiful flowers. There Christmas treats are amazing you just need to go early in December . The peppermint ice cream is so good. I shop at trader Joe's frequently.  I've never bought anything we didn't like.

name: Charlie Emmons
text: Always great.  Good selection,  nice, helpful people!

name: Kacey-Jane C
text: Well stocked, the staff are friendly and prices are pretty good. My only issue was that it was rather crowded.  Other than that, I had a pleasant experience here, and would recommend it.

name: leslie ewing
text:
I can find items here that I cannot get at other grocery stores. I have 2 homes in different states, and this still applies. I love Trader Joe's frozen artichoke hearts, jars of tahini, jars of peanut butter and the facial cleansers and body moisturizers, just to name a few things.

I love to shop at Trader Joe's. The employees are courteous and helpful. Checkout goes smoothly. If I have to drive for an hour to get to the closest Trader Joe's store, I will. I just make an excursion out of the trip, and I just go less often to make up for the drive.

name: Grady Drago
text: This place is COVID-19 safe and pleasant. The parking is always packed. There are great deals and always interesting good quality items. Oh, and stay away from the chocolate covered toffee... they are all mine.

name: michelle smith
text: Love this place. Great values, fresh fruit and veggies, beautiful flowers and delicious frozen entrees that are quick and easy to prepare.

name: concreteguy420
text: Exiting the store could use a little  more area behind the registers

name: B Soley
text: Trader Joe’s is amazing but this one’s much smaller than most. Missing a handful of my favorite Joe’s staples. Great people working there. Friendly and helpful. 9/10 on Covid safety - doing great.

name: J'aime Dahn
text: Love this place, always a great trip to Portland when I can swing into Trader Joe's and grab my favorites!! Just came across their Matcha Green Tea Latte Mix on this last visit and I already need more!

name: Pristorn H.
text: It's a Trader Joe's. Pretty basic set up. Always busy. However, the associates there are very friendly and knowledgeable. Worth going to for basic shopping needs.

name: Corey Smart
text: Really cool has alot of great grocery items

name: John Carll
text: A must-stop place every time I'm in Portland. The frozen meals are second to none.

name: Carmine Leighton
text: Trader Joe's spicy chai tea latte, Bamba puffs, and Furikake seasoning 🤗 I would name my children after these things if I had children. These items are solid gold and well worth the trip to Portland to get them. It's usually very busy, but they are very organized and friendly.

name: Cris Durocher
text: Honestly,  if it wasn't for Trader Joe's, I probably would have killed myself by now

name: Claudia O'Donal
text: Love Trader Joe's and staff. Very busy today but checkout easy.

name: Kim Crabb
text: Everyone is always incredibly friendly. It's obvious they like their jobs and the people they work with. Considering the amount of people that come through TJ's every day, remaining friendly is an amazing feat. :) I haven't seen him in quite a while, but we especially loved the wine guy. We see him around Portland and say, "heeeey! Wine guy!" He's always super friendly and stops to talk to us. :)

name: Jane Laika
text: They always have great products for great products. Nice selection and a super friendly staff. They're taking the pandemic very seriously. Everything was very clean. Keep up the good work, friends!

name: Kodi Nichole
text: I love this store. Great produce selection as well as other neat finds you typically wouldn't find in a regular supermarket. & some things have interesting names. Friendly & helpful staff. That 1 hour drive is well worth it!

name: Max Luick
text: Always like the food and the prices. But, like every TJ's I've ever been to, the parking situation is way annoying.

name: Noelle Leeman
text: We love Trader Joe's so much that we make the 45 min drive to Portland. We need more Tader Joe's in Maine!

name: Sharon Stacey
text: I didn't realize I could get stuff I needed for my particular dietary needs at cheaper prices until I found this place. Nice! Score!

name: Elmira Khusainova
text: Prices are fair, service is great!

name: david chase
text: What's not to like about Trader Joe's ?...Years ago when we'd travel to Framingham for the closest store we could only dream that they'd come to Portland... here they are !  Now if this store would only resist the huge pressure from beer wholesalers to ratchet up their prices - I wouldn't feel so bad about buying the beer from the Portsmouth, Cow Hampshire store,  !

name: Katrina Shaffer
text: All the employees were wearing masks and taking spacing seriously.  It's great to see!

name: Glenn Creel
text: Early  a.m easy in and out. Staff awesome

name: Bruce Lee
text: Best darn organic food around !

name: Sandi R.
text:
I luv Trader Joe's but I went in there a few days ago for the first time since covid-19  began and the checkout experience was a bit more rude than safe. I had to stand back with my granddaughter still in the cart!!
I purchased three brand new reusable bags and was told They can't use them to bag and also I wasn't allowed to bag my purchases. I bought items that I'm giving as gifts so I bought the bags to pack the gifted items in. Bummer.

name: Kathy Keinath
text: Love TJ’s. People.  Products. Everything.

name: Kai Schraml
text: Perhaps the most COVID safe grocery in Maine.

This trader joes is great—staff are super nice and friendly and the seasonal rotations are fun. Avoid this place on the weekends and between 3 pm and 6 pm on the weekdays like a plague. While the tj staff are great. The tj shoppers are some of the worst. Some of my worst memories of Maine are in the TJ parking lot!!!

name: Ben Zimmerman
text: This is a good location with nice staff and plenty of space inside.

name: Jan Mazerolle
text: Very safe place to shop and prices are great. The staff is very knowledgeable and considerate.

name: Peg Astarita
text: Great items with great prices! Wonderful products and always friendly.

name: Lynn Hupe
text: Claudette was my cashier today and she did a fantastic job. She thanked me for coming in. Now thats what I call Service. A big Thanks to Claudette.

name: Leigh Downes
text: Good social distancing protocols at this one. Thanks team.

name: Ana Clarke
text: Really good and following covid guidelines very strictly which is great.

name: Dr. Gregory F. Maassen
text:
It is a Trader Joe's. Well organized for COVID 19, sufficiently stocked and fast moving lines. They have wonderful non alcoholic beer, organic food and good prices.

Overall, it was a pleasant experience. Parking was not an issue.

name: Thomas Abbott
text: Always good..no line

name: Michael Bernier
text: Unique and organic foods and drinks.  Organized with plenty of room to move. Worth the trip.

name: Robin Twombly
text: Always good. The service and the food make for a great moment after a long day.

name: Reb Brann
text: Helpful staff, social distancing practices in place.

name: Gary Nickerson
text: Always a great selection and a great bunch of employees.

name: SmokeytheBear66
text:
I'm not sure if they have the workers' loved ones as hostages.. or they treat their employees right, but they have consistently had the best customer service of any grocery store I've ever been to.

The employees are extremely kind and seemingly happy. It's strange to me to go in a store and not have the employees look like they watched their dog get disemboweled in front of their eyes. I need to go to Trader Joe's more often.

name: Greg West
text: Well done Trader Joe's. You have made shopping in these uncertain times outstanding. Your employees are patient, hospitable and the store is laid out so well to practice what they are requesting for Social Distancing. I appreciate the work and efforts of all of your employees. Well done!!!

name: Frank DeLaCerda II
text: Overall its a great place. The people they have working the door today, NOT GOOD. Oh well I guess that's life in the BIG city.

name: Sadie
text: Basically a grocery store. Trader's has unique items aswell asthe usual.

name: Giorgi Baino
text: Love their products and services

name: Kat G. Moynihan
text: Have been to many Trader Joe’s - this one was spacious, with friendly staff and easy to find items. And great covid safety precautions.

name: David & Beth Jackson
text: Had a great visit. They really are being very cautious and making sure the store is not overcrowded. Always a great selection of food and drink and friendly staff.

name: Jeff Royster
text: Love their frozen foods, the locals are a bit much though. One must jostle for position like at a Cattle feed. That is true of Whole Foods too. Frenzied shopping to get access to pricey foods.

name: Jodie Maher
text: Always such a lovely experience.

name: Boris A. Saurus
text: Nice store ! Spread out cash registers and plenty of them too. Trader joe's always has quality food and products as well.

name: Ian Toal
text: They've improved their wait lines for getting into the store, I only had to wait a short time to get in. Once I started shopping, there was plenty of room for social distancing and they had plenty of items.

name: SanDra
text: Always excellent experience at TJ's!  Great service & great value for delish & nutrish sustenance!

name: Geoff Anthony
text: Great employees very helpful.  Great prices

name: Lynda Berry
text: Excellent place to shop.

name: Matthew Calder
text: I have never been to a bad Trader Joe's! Everyone is great! Food is awesome! Prices are great! Parking lot is horrible because they are always busy! Does not seem to deter anyone, including me from going. I wish they would move to a better location.

name: Tetyana Durkin
text: They keep nice coronavirus protocol in the store and still very well stoked.

name: sharon paul
text: Employees are always helpful and courteous

name: Kelly Hall
text: Always have pleasant experiences at Trader Joe's. Even though this was the day before Christmas Eve and it was packed all the employees were super nice & helpful. My cashier was awesome. Love this store! Kind of glad it's an hour away and I only get to go occasionally. They would get too much of my 💲

name: Alice Bean Andrenyak
text:
Enjoy the variety of premade foods available frozen and fresh. The overall assortment of fresh and non perishable foods are different than what you find in most Maine grocery stores. I scored canned Jack Fruit which I have been searching for for months.

Their wine and beer selections are carefully chosen. Their store brands offer significant savings. The store is clean and neat. Parking can be difficult as it is very popular.

name: Christine Popovich
text: Just love it. Terrific products and prices. Great customer service.. ALWAYS a smile from employees.. clearly they enjoy working there. Always appreciate coffee offered as taste test. Just shopped for upcoming holiday and looking forward to enjoying the cheese, tortellini. 🤗

name: Patty Duquette
text: They had what we were looking for. Very friendy

name: Cinde Tilton
text: Great store. Lots of options and good prices.

name: Sarah Fennessey
text: Trader Joe's is incredible. There is no question.  The employees are so friendly and helpful and I've never been disappointed by a purchase there.  The major downside that prevents me from coming here is the parking lot.  It's way too small for the amount of people that want to go, which leads me to avoiding it most of the time, sadly.

name: Hosannah Pearl
text: Courteous staff, Masks required,  my kind of place!! Safe & healthy!

name: yatta *
text: Fantastic pandemic experience,  everyone was polite and informative! The shoppers were also cognizant myself and others.  Checkout was a breeze and everything was nice!

name: Johanne Garfield
text: Clean and wide spaces, good service, well stocked, easy access

name: Tin Ko
text: Standard chain store with good supply grocery.

name: Sarah
text: I ❤ Trader Joe's! The food options are delicious and the employees already jot only knowledgeable but nice too

name: Michael Fairservice
text: Best grocery store in the state

name: Erin Holden
text: I really like their products.  Not a huge fan of actually shopping here.  The parking situation is ridiculous!  Once inside I felt like I was competing in a roller derby.  Not the chill shopping experience I had envisioned at all! I'm sure I'll be back...  It's Trader Joe's!  I'm not sure I'll like it any better though.

name: Peter Caron Sr.
text: The store was well stocked and they are limiting the number of customers they let in so it is not that crowded. The cashier did a great job keeping us safe from each other.

name: Cheryl Anderson
text: Of all the grocery stores in town, Trader Joe's is the best at keeping staff and customers safe during this pandemic.  Lots of staff regulating flow, disinfecting carts, lots of checkouts with baggers, constantly using hand sanitizer, and the customer stays away from the counter altogether until it is time to insert the credit card.  And of course all the great Trader Joe's special prepared foods.

name: Mac Coldwell
text: I always enjoy Trader Joe's mostly for the snacks. Their elote corn chips are amazing. And I can't think of a better combination then the garlic dip and their sweet potato tortilla chips. The store is well lit and there is a good amount of aisle space even when it's busy. The employees are pleasant and helpful. There is a sidewalk ramp and easy wheelchair access. I also found that it has the best price for sprouted tofu, and their flowers are the most beautiful bargain around.

name: Tom Sing
text: Great place to shop, even with a line it didn't take long to get in(there were 2 lines & both moved quickly !

name: Will Hodgkins
text: Although not my kind of place it offers nice looking and fresh fruits and vegetables and various other foods for the health conscious person

name: Chad Baynar
text: As always a love to get in, but this time for Covid☹️. They line moved, this was a much bigger store than the one I'm used to traveling to.

name: Paul Bennett
text: This is a great store for finding good food at affordable prices.  The wine selection is vast and very affordable.  I love the choice of frozen appetizers.  If you never been to TJ's in Portland, you're missing an experience.  The only complaint is that the parking lot could be a lot bigger.

name: Jen George
text: They really work hard to keep safe and sanitized. I appreciate that!

name: Claudia Salas Lyman
text: Great grocery story! Great variety and at a great price 😊

name: Fia Marquis
text: This place is so family-friendly that my kids beg to go even when we don't need anything, for the samples and the employees who make them feel special and noticed. There are also some staples to our household that are only or at least most readily available here, like applesauce pouches that my toddler can eat by himself without help because the ends are pinched, super affordable light roast ground coffee, frozen dim sum for fast and easy weekend lunches, and whole milk yogurt pouches (with fruits and veggies) for both kids to snack on, cheaper than the brand name version at the mainstream grocery store.

name: Kelsey Frost
text: Love Trader Joe's! I only am sad that it isn't closer to where I live so I can shop more frequently. We are big fans of the Trader Joe products, the cheese sticks are the best and my kids are SUPER picky. For sweets the chocolate covered coconut almonds are by far the best, I can't keep them in my house for more than a day. So many great options for gluten free diet as well.

name: Lauren Sterling
text: Extremely well-organized and safe for shopping during #COVID.

name: Romeo D
text: Lots of awesome variety, and decent prices.

name: Sam & Emily Charlton
text: All had masks, products are great

name: JP Keyser
text: They have Almond Kringle all the way from Racine, Wisconsin!

name: Rory Benjamin
text: There's a reason why Trader Joe's as a company has such a fantastic reputation. The food here is nothing short of outstanding and is priced very reasonably. The Portland location continues this tradition admirably. The only drawback to coming here is the parking. My goodness the parking lot is microscopic and is always nothing short of an absolute disaster to navigate and attempt to find parking in.

name: Patricia Keating
text: Great social distance rules an policy to get people inside

name: Brenda Giordano
text: Had the things I needed in stock. Had to wait outside maybe 10 minutes before entering the store.

name: jana profenno
text: I really love going to Trader Joe's, I really wish though they would open one closer to Brunswick.

name: Elisio Simoes
text: Best supermarket ever

name: Simon Snyder
text: TJ's offers reasonably priced, quality food and drink items. They feature mostly healthy offerings and provide some not- normally-offered-elsewhere,Trader Joe label items. The esprit-de-corps of the staff is certainly refreshing.

name: Christine McHale
text: Not a Maine Adventure like Renys, but always a good place to get food. I don't go too often because I hate. Trying to get across Marginal Way and it's really a long walk up a big hill for me

name: Kari Beaulieu
text: Trader Joe's is by the best store I've been in since covid started.

name: Katie Bearor
text: Very spacious, plenty of checkout lines, and very kind staff.

name: G Aquino
text: Spacious TJ's with the standard product offering. Wheelchair-friendly. Service was top-notch as expected. Free parking.

name: Danny Rowland
text: A pretty normal Trader Joe's. They proudly display declarations of Portland love in their decor. They have good prices and keep the store clean. The parking is shared with many other stores so it can be a little crowded, but it isn't too bad.

name: Nell Sullivan
text: A rare retail experience - I'm usually surprised at how low my bill total is rather than how high.  The staff is friendly, the flowers and plants are beautiful and often inexpensive.  I wish they had better, and local, produce but I go elsewhere for that.   Their grapefruit juice is simply the best.

name: scott concannon
text: Great selection of foods and polite staff. Only thing I ask is PLEASE build a store in Waterville or Augusta so those in the other half of the state wouldn't have to drive so far. Thank you.

name: Annette Koziol
text: I love everything about Trader Joe's. Not the least of which is their prices. Great cheeeses. Great wine. Love me my Triple Ginger cookies. My absolute favorite organic cottage cheese. And don't leave without Trader Joe's Handmade Flour Tortillas.not just flour tortillas but HANDMADE. How could they be different you ask. Don't know. Its flour and water, right. I don't know, but they're the best. I included a picture. 😊

name: Sue Quinlan
text: Good items, good pricing. Helpful staff. I drive a half hour each way at least once a month to shop there.

name: Shannon
text: Going from living in a neighborhood that had 3 TJ's to living in a state with 1 has been very difficult. Because TJ's has long been my primary food market, I continue to drive the 90-minutes required to continue purchasing all of the items I love. I look forward with the utmost optimism to their expansion north at some point in the not-so-distant future.

name: Marvin Ruiz
text: Great healthy produce

name: Barbara McPherson
text: The store is nice and clean. Employees are very nice and helpful and got checked out quickly. The parking lot is a disaster to navigate and is always packed. There is a nice variety of products and they are very fairly priced. My only complaint is the other customers shopping. They stand around in the middle of aisles and aimlessly wander, always in the way. They are also pretty pompous. The best time to go is in the middle of the week while everyone is at work, avoid the weekends.

name: Kim Rodriguez
text: This is the best place to buy wine!! Of course they also have great produce, all types of snacks, a nice variety of cheeses,  baked good, dairy, etc. The products are all high quality and a great value.

name: Karen A. Mittens
text: Good grocery store. Parking lot was completely full. They did not have pine nuts but the employee I asked for help was very kind.

name: Linda Paul
text: Great fresh veggies and cheeses!

name: Ian Redbeard
text: I frequent this TJ's 3-4 times a week. I've had friends who've worked here for years. Great spot. Employees are a great representation of the people of Portland. Quirky and unique if not a bit on the hippy side of life. 5 stars.

name: Lauren Cote
text: Fantastic place to shop!

name: Steven Horton
text: We look on going to Trader Joe's as an adventure. Always enjoy browsing through the store. Very friendly staff. Good selection and happy with the prices. Just wish it was closer to home. We'd go more often.

name: J M
text:
Less expensive than Whole Foods, but offering some of the same kind of thing (healthy options), but far less options.

The vibe here is laid back.  The check out can be a little confusing for first timers (and multi timers like me) as they have you line your cart up a little goofy.  But they're good about helping you.

name: David Markowitz
text: People who work here are fabulous, very helpful. Fantastic choice of wine. Foods, etc

name: J C
text: Trader Joe's is a great grocery store, with a solid selection of all natural foods, and excellent wine selection (with good inexpensive wines). The employees are always cheerful and helpful, I would fully recommend going. Fair warning though, the parking lot can be insanity during busy times of day.

name: Daniel Richman
text: Simply the best.

name: Jessica Kellett
text: I love this place! Just wish it wasn't always so busy!! Staff is so wonderful here, friendly and informed.

name: Jeanne Martin
text: Now this Grocery store has everything in it except curry powder! And bulk items in bins which was kind of surprising because it smells like a Canadian Bulk Barn! My Husband & I spoke to a GentClerk , his name was Chris and he was so helpful with all kinds of tidbits of information, for us of where to find what we're looking for. This store is Huge! And I love their brown paper bags!

name: Alissa Halloway
text: One of my all time favorite places! Great stuff for great prices, and they have some amazing potstickers!

name: Bill Strauser
text: We go for the meat and frozen Asian dumplings

name: mark diterlizzi
text: Great day at trader joes ,very safe

name: Robert Macdonald
text: Great food! Try the Cinnamon Roll bread. Best toast ever!

name: Erin Leonhard
text: Very friendly, very clean, customers please WEAR MASKS!! (all employees are wearing masks 👍)

name: Marilee Harris
text: Trader joe's ROCKS!

name: clinton french
text: A nice store with some good products, something different, some decent prices, some a bit pricey.

name: Phillip I.
text: Great and intelligent social distancing even tho the POTUS promotes mindless behavior.

name: Emily Taylor
text: Customer service is excellent. They bring us back to the golden age of capitalism, m'kay? Well done.

name: Eileen Clark
text: Love all the unique food choices! Always find favorites and something new! Staff is super helpful!

name: Stan Spilecki
text: This place is busy so probably hard to keep clean. I was thinking there would be more selection than the local chain but not much more and crazy expensive in some areas but surprisingly affordable in others. Worth a visit when I am in Portland.

name: sarah pinkham
text: So much selection and very inexpensive

name: Chad Churchill
text: Easy in and out!

name: Olivia Hamlin
text: Love this place!

name: Bill Goldstein
text: Good place to shop. Terrible parking anytime I go.  Try during the week before lunch to shop

name: just Doughty
text: The parking is horrible. I don't like the way the store is organized. It has great products. The wine connoisseur is excellent... Like what are you doing here? Level excellent.

name: Devyn Potter
text: in general I like Trader Joe's.  This one is clean and bright and everyone is really nice.  I really like their face wash and lotion.  It helps my acne and the lotion doesn't cause breakouts! I also really like all of their food and wine!

name: Lindsey Ross
text:
Nice spot, super busy on a Saturday!
The staff was really good and quick to get people through on a busy day.

name: Erin Ames
text: Always friendly even when it is crazy busy.  Everyone is always smiling and willing to take the extra step for you!

name: Daniel Sanborn
text: Parking is the worst ever! That being said, alot of unique products here. Good quality good value. I like Trader Joes.

name: Mark N
text: Tasty & healthy products with affordable wines and friendly service!

name: Breanna Kernick
text: I love trader joes but I will warn you that this parking lot is absolute hell.

name: Dan Cunliffe
text: Our first time here.  Prices seem reasonable and a good selection of items.  Staff was friendly asking if we need anything as we looked around.  I was taking some pictures for my review but one of the employees told me I was not allowed to take any more pictures in the store as it was their policy.

name: Susan Taylor
text: Great experience.  Godd selection. In and out in minutes. Cashier was very friendly. Pleasant smile.

name: Stephanie Allen-Perry
text: Love the selection. Love the prices. Wish there was on closer to home but will definitely drive to Portland just to go there again.

name: Rob Hickox
text: They have so many selections of good foods to choose from, it just gets very busy in there and the process are higher than other stores for the foods I am able to eat.

name: Mabel Eaton
text: I love this store. Unfortunately they are an hour and a half away so I only get here 3 or 4 times a year. If they put a store in mid NH I would go there for my regular shopping. The quality of food is super I and the prices are equal to what it costs elsewhere.

name: Jonathan VanOver
text: Great place to shop, fun finding new things to try

name: junkmonkeyZr0
text: Overwhelmingly nice.  The aisles go diagonal to the store which, to me, is weird.  Friendly atmosphere, but the customers, like much of other Maine residents, would push you out of the way before saying anything.

name: Thomas Saulnier
text: Solid business model. Great employees, and incredible selection. These notes should not surprise you. What might considering, is that the prices are actually better here than at the local Big stores. No reason for me to shop elsewhere now, phew

name: Brandon Hepler
text: It's a nice place for deals on cheeses or other individual items. If you're trying to put together a specific meal they might not have everything that you need... Their selection is very targeted for certain things.

name: 244 Main
text: This store is lacking in all the ways Trader Joe's usually stands out.

name: Accalia Elementia
text: Great selection. Great prices. Top notch service

name: Geoff K
text: This is the closest TJ's to midcoast Maine so we stop in here whenever we're near Portland. It's got all the TJ's goodies.

name: Diann Coyne
text: It's a love hate relationship ! Love the store and hate the parking and rude customers that always seem plentiful at this business. Don't know why but it just is

name: Neil Ashton
text: Nice stuff. Terrible parking. We avoid it most of the time. Maybe they could post parking vacancies on their website.

name: Valerie Sauda
text: Easy in and out- great staff

name: Cathy Stairs
text: Good variety of food..fresh..Frozen or package great seasonal options..enviro friendly

name: katie clarke
text: What a great selection.  Employees are so  friendly and helpfull.  Only problem is we need a T.Js in Augusta or Bangor.

name: James Ganley
text: I appreciate the small layout, don't have to walk all over to get the basics, and can get in and out quickly. Super friendly staff, good prices. Parking can be tricky at times.

name: Christen
text: Absolutely one of my fave grocery stores. We travel over an hour to get groceries here

name: Elizabeth Quinn-Robertson
text: Traders has so much to offer. A lot like a Sam’s club but with smaller portions for people who do not have large families.

name: albert webb
text: Very nice place to get food items, this was my first time shopping here. Everyone was helpful.

name: Yvette Dilallo
text: Great place to buy Foods and Wines. Great prices n choices. Always fun n I leave Happy

name: Bob Leger
text: It's nice to have a grocery store where you can be confident the food is natural and reasonably priced.  The staff is always available and helpful.   I appreciate that when I'm done shopping there are plenty of checkout lines open.

name: Steve P
text: Better than Whole Paycheck, but the same issues with the zombie privileged customers. Brain dead for the most part. But the store itself has some great products at good prices

name: Twanna Rampino
text:
I shop at Trader Joe's for their fair price and selection on nuts, energy bars, and flowers. However, with this being said, the shopping experience here is pure calamity . For one thing, the store is simply to small for the demand of the public. Their aisles are narrow and hard to get down, making you feel like you've just broken down in rush hour traffic. I would love to stop and read the labels,  but I have 30 people up my tailpipe trying to slit my achilles with their carts. They might try to go around me, but they can't because the other side of the aisle is just as packed.
I legit ride the outside of the store, grab what I need and get out. Their parking lot is a lot like the inside of their store. To small. They share it with two other stores which have signs threatening that your car will be towed should you even think about parking there. You might as well park in Westbrook and walk.
The whole Trader Joe's experience leaves you feeling like you have just survived being sucked up by a tornado blindfolded, and thrown back into your car.
Horrible.

name: Kristopher Thompson
text: I always thought trader Joe's was super fancy and expensive. Its not. Many of their items are cheaper than the equivalent at shaws or hannaford. Nice store. Lots of variety.

name: Merval Porter
text: The only Trader Joe's in Maine. The place is always clean, well stocked and staffed by some of the best people in greater Portland.

name: John Pentecost
text: Great prices, great selection, great staff

name: Jean Mooers
text: Wish they would move to my area. Our nearest is 80 miles away. Love the different fruits and vegetables. The prices are good also

name: Kerry B.
text: Excellent variety, prices,friendly staff. I drive almost 3 hours to go here!

name: Neil
text:
Trader Joe's is a remarkable little supermarket. I have found every time I buy their brand I am really impressed. They truly seem to be a healthier, more legitimate alternative to big brand names. The staff is friendly and they offer some really tasty foods you won't see too often.
Prices are averag for quality items.

name: Sarasota Photography
text: Love Trader Joes! :) am I ever gonna win the reusable grocery bag challenge? Lol

name: Ejs Attwin
text:
Portland Maines Trader Joes..great items ..good samples..great people. .fair price for quality items...can't wait to go back..got a list this time..
Oh yeah. .

name: Ronald Joseph
text: Finally! I have been looking for weeks ,it seems, for 1 item in every grocery store in my area and surrounding cities with NO luck. Today as a last ditch effort in finding what I've been looking for I drove by a Trader Joe's and saw a line outside for people to go so I investigated and found out that Trader Joe's was limiting the number of shoppers into their stores. I asked if they had a certain paper product and one of the customers waiting in line said, I just saw someone with some walk out. I waited in line and got my item and left. Happy... Thank-you, Trader Joe's...I will be back.

name: John Rice
text: Great place to shop! But, parking can be a challenge.

name: Tammy Holmes
text: Clean and plenty to look at but not our cup of tea.  It is really geared towards people who want organic foods and have allergies.  Great display of hand cut flowers to make your own bouquet.

name: Joe Roy
text: Great company that have a great reputation for treating their employees well and you can tell. I love getting the tomatoe soup, chinese in the frozen section and some new interesting things here and there. I'd suggest getting a bottle of their Arnold Palmer (half lemonade and half iced tea).

name: Ben Goff
text: The store itself is fine. However, the parking is a nightmare. I don't know what they could do about it but it's really bad

name: Michael Allison
text: I love Trader Joe's . . I wish they would come to Bangor!  We have to travel two hours south to Portland if we want to shop there.  Smaller than Whole Foods in Portland, I love their Trader Joe's brand items.  They have fresh produce, meats and a good selection of healthy frozen foods.  They have good alternatives to more mundane chips and candy and a nice selection of wine and coffees.  I love their condiments and jarred olives.  They make an excellent Dijon mustard.  They have a fine selection of cooking oils and spices.  The store is clean, they have mobility carts, the staff is friendly and helpful.  We have a natural food store in Bangor, but a Trader Joe's would do very well in Bangor.

name: Nate Gross
text:
I love Trader Joe's. It always surprises me that they can provide the quality of products they do with such great prices.
The parking here is ample (in CA where I moved from, it's a running joke that every new trader Joe's is required to have only half the needed parking space). The store is spacious and easy to shop as well.

name: Carol Oehlschlager
text: Attention vulnerable groups using EBT at TJ's, if you do not have bags or money for bags you should think twice before shopping there, I saw a customer spend 192.00 there the other day and was told if they did not have the .30 for the bags after the groceries were totaled that the store would not let them keep the groceries. It is good to know that Trader Joe's understands the plight of vulnerable groups and supports their needs. Perhaps Trader Joe's really needs that .30.

name: Maine Girl
text: Great selection. Wish there was one closer to mid coast maine.

name: Thad Perry
text: This place rocks has a great vibe and everything you need

name: Mike Jeansddgvhjj
text: Excellent place to forget which Subaru is yours in the parking lot.

name: klaryssa bryan
text: Love this place! Flowers are gorgeous and much cheaper than other stores. Lo e that you can get healthy snacks for the kids, fruits and veggies for good prices

name: Mike Mitchell
text: Love shopping here staff helpful and also I find what I need

name: Linda Morris
text: Excellent prices, good selections and they often have samples of items and coffee to try. Super friendly staff & clean restrooms. Produce isn’t always the best but great fresh flowers!

name: YANKEE GAMER

text: Trader Joe's has a unique selection of hard-to-find foodstuffs. One of our favorites is the two-kilogram dark chocolate bar, as well as their various other chocolate-covered products. They also have a nice selection of wines and the best prices on flowers in town. Everyone who works there seems to really enjoy their job. name: Ryan Kelley
text: Get the goods while the goods are good to be got. Also a one of a kind staff, they rock.

name: Stephen Arlaud
text:
My family loves this store. I gave it four stars only because we sometimes have a hard time finding parking in this relatively small lot on the site. There is however street parking and some lots not very far from the store. I always find quality items and very reasonably priced. This store has items I may not be able to find in other stores. They seem to cater to a green and healthy type life style. There is a pretty good selection of wines with some very reasonably priced. I find there produce and meat section to be excellent. I would highly recommend a visit here and parking seems to be better during the work week and that time of day.

Update: 5/28/2020 I just went back to Trader Joe’s during this pandemic and they have excellent safety procedures in place. When entering now they have 2 lines that enter alternately when shoppers exit the store. Masks are required to enter. Everybody in the store is wearing masks! The other thing I noticed that even during the pandemic the food choices are excellent and well stocked. There is an army of store associates stocking, bagging , checking you out and cleaning carts etc. I will be doing more of my shopping here, the Trader Joe’s brand foods are very unique and varied. I found meats in all different types and preparation from frozen, cooked, precut awesome! The produce is excellent and varied. The frozen foods are excellent and a lot are Trader Joe brand and price. I found prices very reasonable and found things that I don’t have at larger chain stores! The people are top notch and helpful. They only use nice Trader Joe’s paper bags with handles and double bagged which are awesome and are eco friendly in line with Portland ban on plastic bags! Checkout is much different than other stores, you wait at a line on the floor and the cashier comes to get your cart and scans your products and there is a separate bagger. The cashier will wave you up to checkout when he’s done scanning and your groceries are bagged. You grab your own receipt from the printer. Very nice experience! You’ll like it here doing your shopping! Remember if other stores don’t have your specific type and preparation Traders just might. Health foods are very abundant here! I went up to five stars on traders because they are just that good! I had no problem with parking during this pandemic!

Update 11/25/2020:  This place just amazes me every time I come here! I love the variety of frozen foods here. You can find all kinds of specialty frozen food entres that I can tell you that you won’t find these at Shaws, Hannaford and Walmart. If your looking for everyday typical frozen foods from known names, you won’t find them here! These are Trader Joe’s brand foods and everyone we try they are amazing, very good quality foods. Orange chicken is a favorite and Samosas, chicken or vegetable also a favorite they are excellent! I came here for a few things we have tried and wanted more and I ended up with quite a bit of frozen foods. I had enough cold or frozen foods I saw a Trader Joe’s insulated tote for $7 and I grabbed it. This tote fit a frozen pizza and numerous frozen foods easily with plenty of room for more.  I usually used an insulated tote I got at Walmart and this one was so much bigger and thick foam insulation and zippered up tight! The one from Walmart was like a reusable grocery bag with a zipper and foil type inside with thin insulation nothing like Trader Joe’s tote. You gotta get one of the Trader Joe’s insulated toes. My frozen foods were very cold and frozen when I got home as compared to the cold items I got at Walmart and used their tote. No comparison I love the Trader Joe’s tote it’s just excellent and huge. Traders has such a nice bread and dairy isle! There are tons of nice reasonable wines here! The deli meats area you will never find at local grocery stores.  There is so many snack type foods it’s amazing and all the prices are excellent. The staff associates are excellent and plentiful. Go to Shaws and your lucky if you find any associates on the floor they just aren’t there! Excellent store!

name: Jamie Lai
text: Helpful staff.  Spacious store space with all the reliable products expected from a TJ.

name: Ea Franz

text: Love Trader Joe's. Prices manageable. Brussel Sprouts were very tasty. Eggplant yummy. Chocolate always good.  Had no Brazil nuts.

name: Kate Savidge
text: It had been a while since I last shopped here and I don't know why I stopped going in the first place. There are so many great choices for foods here. I love the prepackaged fruits already cut up like mangos and pineapples. I prefer the skinnier green beans they sell as well as asparagus and the choices for premade salads was almost overwhelming. I also love the varieties of nuts all packaged out as well as the indulgences of candy varieties they have to satisfy my sweet tooth. I admit to being a lazy cook and love to have pre-cooked items like chicken and beef done for me so all I need to do is add veggies to reheat. Our household is always busy with everyone running around at various times so this makes it so much easier to throw together a healthier meal.

name: Courtney Clark
text:
"Yay! I'm a fan" perfectly describes Trader Joe's for me. It's not a must have, but I'm glad there's one close by my home. There are a few items that I buy at Joe's that I cannot get anywhere else, such as the roasted red pepper tomato soup. I also love the Trader Joe's brand Greek yogurt. I also cannot go to Joe's without swinging by the samples station to see what they are pushin! The employees are always friendly and seem to be happy doing their jobs. The fresh flowers are great and I love to stop and smell them. The frozen section is also top notch- I'm always finding something new to try when I peruse these aisles.

There are two reasons I cannot give Joe's five stars. The first reason is because the parking lot is a war zone! The spaces are way to small and just begging to have your doors dinged by parking in them. The lot itself is shared between multiple businesses and too small to begin with. The other reason I cannot give Joe's five stars is because it cannot be my one stop grocery store. I cannot go there to do all of my grocery shopping, mainly because the meat section does not have the variety or quantities that the mainstream grocery stores offer. The prices here are reasonable, more so I believe than their competitors.

name: Jeremy Grady
text: I was trying to locate a legible copy of their menu, but that seems to be an impossibility. There are pictures of meals such as drunken noodles but there is no description of what is in that and the printed menu is a very poor quality photograph of their menu which even with expanding it to the maximum capacity and wearing glasses and trying to use the part of Google that lets you identify what the text says but you can't read the menu. I am always looking for great Asian food, but I am unlikely to try Pom's Thai because there is no legible menu. I need to know what I'm ordering. If I order something and there is seafood in it then there is going to be heck to pay.  I hate seafood. Sure DRUNKEN NOODLES sounds like a good choice, but what if it has seafood or tofu in it? In either case I would be repulsed.

resp.text: Hi Jeremy, we appreciate the review. Our Drunken Noodles, listed under #.78 on our menu, contains the noodles, bell peppers, broccoli, carrots, basil,  and mushrooms as described. Our entree’s, excluding specialty items with the meat in the name, (i.e Orange Chicken, Tamarind Fish,) can come with any meat you choose. You are to choose the entree, and then the meat; the price will follow along accordingly. If you were to order 1 Drunken Noodle, with no meat specified, it would simply come as is: only broccoli, carrots, mushrooms, bell peppers and basil will be in the dish. Please give us a call during business hours, and we will be more than happy to assist in ordering.

name: Hugh Morrison
text: Awesome service, super personable and helpful in discussing menu and making a decision on dinner. “Open till 9, instead of closes at 9” attitude. Got me dinner right before they closed and wow was it delicious. Dumplings and sauce is amazing. Four star is nice and spicy. Killer Pad-Thai and the Garlic Duck w/ mushroom is amazing. Thanks for such a great take out experience. I’ll be back for sure!

name: Steven Jefairjian
text:
Any of Pom's eateries are just wonderful... I love having her Thai dishes... well thought, well made and really nice-sized portions. Always well worth the money in my opinion, and take out is excellent too.

She has wonderful employees, creative chefs/cooks that will take requests to customize your food as you like... never over-spiced and over-the-top HOT the way some establishments do..., with too much chili oil or seracha. You can always add more heat with the array of condiments on the table, or asking the chef to bump it up!

The Crispy Ginger Duck, fresh Summer Rolls and Crab Rangoon, are for me, the way to go for a delightful meal.

She's a long standing part of the Portland culinary scene... longevity is an indicator that it's being done right and customers keep coming back.

I've met and chatted with her many times and she's a delight to converse with, friendly, polite, sweet and she's adorable... very attractive and well spoken too.

She should be considered for entrepreneur and business owner of the decade...👸 you go girl!

Her restaurant on Congress St, just off Forest Ave is my first choice... conveniently located in Portland's Downtown and Arts District..., a great way to see what Portland has to offer and enjoy a fab meal.
WE ARE SO VERY GLAD TO HAVE YOU HERE!

text: Very nice staff, clean place and quiet atmosphere i.e. you could hear your conversation even though there were many other diners.  The Won Ton and Tom Yum soups were excellent and the Pad Thai--in my opinion the mark of a good Thai restaurant--was also very good.  BUT the Appetizer Sampler was terrible.  You couldn't find the cheese in the crab rangoon, the veggie roll was dry and tasteless, and barely any taste to the curry puff and veggie dumpling.  These last two were very tiny and tasted like they had come from the frozen food section of a supermarket.  The only items which had much flavor were the two chicken items and the onion rings. text:
OTTO is hands down my favorite pizza joint in Portland and I've visited all of their locations (even the one in Cambridge, Mass). When I used to live downtown in Portland, the Upper Congress location is where I went most often.

Thin crust, excellent and interesting flavor profile, and decent price. Great for grabbing a slice or for dining in. It's open late most of the time, too.

resp.text: Thanks for the kind words! Come back soon!

name: Breezy
text: AMAZING!  Some of the best pizza I've ever had (and I live in NY).  We had the tortellini pie and the mashed potato pie and both were perfect.  The crust is good on its own and then the toppings add so much more.  I've been craving their pizza every day since.  Can't wait to go back.

name: Rachel Gutekunst
text:
Full service disappointment. I ordered a regular cheese pizza to go. I wasn't expecting a magical pizza experience, but neither was I expecting the worst pizza I have actually ever had. I was trying treat my staff after a long week and sadly served them cold, burnt, flavorless pizza. It had the consistency of rubbery cardboard with hard blackened spots, and mostly splotches of red sauce.
I love pizza. I did not love this pizza. I never want to see this pizza again or any pizza like it.
This was hands down the absolute most terrible pizza I have ever had the displeasure of trying. I ended up throwing it away.
$17 in the trash. I tried calling to speak to someone and no one answered. I hate leaving negative reviews but do not waste your money here.

resp.text: Rachel, we are so sorry to hear about your experience.  We strive to provide an elevated pizza experience every time, and clearly we dropped the ball here.  Please feel free to email us here at our offices (contactus@ottoportland.com). We are sorry that you did not get through to staff, and we're sorry that we let you down.  Thanks for bringing this to our attention.  We hope to have an opportunity to serve you better in the future.

text:
Excellent pizza by the slice! And very friendly service!

Not so much for pizza to go or delivery...inconsistent from burned crust to barely any cheese.

Now I only get pizza by the slice and it’s always good!

resp.text: Thanks for the feedback, Jason.  We're sorry to hear that your delivery/takeout experiences have been spotty. We will pass along your feedback to our operations team to address.  We do appreciate your business, and we hope to serve you better in the future.  Thanks again!

text:
We like Otto (West-End) pizza for dine-in. Lately, take-out has been horrible! The pizzas have been very inconsistent; the person on the phone taking the orders never knows what's going on. It's very frustrating to have someone that is struggling to take your order, almost like they were not trained properly.

For pizza, it's on the pricey side, which I don't mind paying good money for good food, but when you've spent $27+ on two small pizzas AND had to be on the phone for 10 minutes with someone who is struggling with entering 2 toppings on 2 pizzas, AND then having to wait an hour for delivery, only to have a few measly toppings that you paid an extra $2.99 for each, really sucks.

Because of the inconsistencies, I'd recommend dine-in only or stop by to get a fresh, ready-made slice on the go. Delivery is a disaster!

name: Justin Vieira
text:
Finding a great coffee place is like finding a needle in a haystack. I found the needle!

I decided to get a fun drink for Easter, the "peep" latte and my boyfriend got a regular coffee in order to try their drip coffee. The coffee was a nice pick me upper and both the drip and peep coffees we're rich and full bodied. The staff here we're a joy, full of life, asking questions, overall they were engaged in their customers; something you don't get at Starbucks or Dunkin these days.

In closing. Amazing coffee and an amazing staff!

name: Nicola Isgro
text: The baristas are wonderful! The espresso is excellent,the atmosphere is very friendly, its clean and cozy. I go there 2 - 3 times a week and my coffee is usually ready when i get to the counter!

text:
They have the best iced lattes - get one to stay for sure, as they taste extra perfect when served in the fun glasses.

Even and nice light roast brings out the cereal flavors of a good ice latte. Friendly staff too.

It is 46 degrees outside (9:45 am 4/21) and you have your air conditioner blowing?
Yeah, I'll consider this next time walking down the street looking for a coffee house to hang out in. Do I want to get coffee at a place that doesn't know how to run their thermostat or not? Hmm... deep questions.

name: Mac Coldwell
text: I liked my first visit so much that I paid for a membership pretty much the next day. I hadn't been in the building before, and the door was open for November's first Friday. The library was open for a talk with a Maine author who writes mysteries, and as I walked to the ballroom on the next floor, I walked in a Naked Shakespeare production by Acorn. It feels like Mechanics Hall has a unique history and community outreach.

text:
I like grounded, well maintained old, historical, working class buildings!
Also, located in heart of downtown Portland, known as Portland's first "highrise"!
Understand, folks can become members for $50, with special organization rates!
Only thing missing is a common kitchen.

text: Alot of history here. It's an older building with somewhat funky floor plans, retrofitted bathrooms, etc.  As an event venue, I was disappointed how confusing it was to find where my function was being held. Also very disappointed with the temperature; the space was kept at 64 degrees on a cold Maine day. I wore my coat the entire time. This took alot away from my experience.
