text: One of the best breakfast sandwiches anywhere. Huge sandwich with an amazing homemade sausage patty and the best breakfast potatoes (I like them extra crispy). Easy to order and pay online. Absolutely worth the price. Their fried chicken is delicious as well as their burgers. Not a huge menu, but not a bad thing on it.

name: Thomas C. Jackson
text:
Excellent food and wonderful staff working in a small but authentic diner car.  Simply one of New England's best diners. Well worth the wait: there's a cute Park next door where you could sit and wait with a cup of coffee. You can park in the lot next door just be sure to pay at the kiosk. They are cash only but an ATM is nearby

I've been coming here since 2004, a few years before the current crew came on board. Here's what I found over several visits:

The Corned beef hash is outstanding as are the flapjacks.

The palace diner potatoes that come with eggs are a delight.  I don't know how they do it what they are perfection in a potato skin.

The eggs are phenomenally well seasoned and cooked perfectly.

And, if you ask nicely, they will put chocolate chips in the flapjacks. They come with real maple syrup.

What more could you ask?

name: Ryan Michaud
text: This place is awesome. The prices are a bit deceiving, but the amount of food and the quality of it is second to none. Highly recommend this place.

name: Janice Philbrook
text: The best little diner we’ve ever been to! Great breakfast options, try the flapjacks! They run out quickly so I suggest getting there early. Awesome service!

name: Rick
text: Awesome food. Everything is great

name: Andrew Elegante
text:
It's small and mighty and definitely worth the drive. I've been twice. Ordered the deluxe sandwich twice. Loved the sandwich and the potatoes, twice. Great service, fun vibe, welcoming staff, delicious food, reasonable prices (for the area/quality) and, perhaps most importantly, ladies are welcome :)

Tourist tip: Go for a walk up main Street after and enjoy the history markers, beautiful architecture and interesting shops

name: Madeline Carignan
text: Worth the stop in Biddeford for out of this world food. The French toast will make you never want to order it anywhere else, it’s that good. Everything our party ate was as delicious as advertised, and the atmosphere is perfect

name: J T
text: Unbelievable. Palace Dinner nails it on decor, food, service, atmosphere, etc. My buddy said this was a must do on my trip up north and boy was he right. I had the special breakfast sandwich and potatoes. I've been dreaming about them ever since. Do yourself a favor and go now.

text: Seriously, go. The wait is worth it. Or go right when they open. The French toast is gigantic and way better than any we found in the Portland area. Also the staff is great.

text: Great people. Super-friendly and efficient service. Hugely flavorful hot comfort food. A gem. Get the omelette and/or the flapjacks. This will be a place we return to again and again.

text: Small dinner (seats15) with simple traditional menu items with some updates (carmelzied grapefruit). Great pancakes, crispy bacon and awesome "palace potatoes" (whole new potatoes smashed, grilled crisp and salted). Cash only!

name: Joseph Howard
text:
Exemplary service, small menu but everything on it is perfection incarnate. Come early, seating is scarce and rightfully sought after. You'll love it.
Cash only, but there's an ATM right outside.

name: Thad Sharp
text: This was THE BEST BREAKFAST I've ever had. Everything was perfect. Don't let the small, old school decor fool you. The food is amazing. I got the lumberjack breakfast. Everything about this was amazing. The flapjacks were perfect with a hint of cinnamon and come perfectly. The roasted potatoes were to die for. There is limited seated but if you have to wait an hour for a seat, it's worth your time! Make the trip to Portland, Maine to try this little hidden gem!

name: James Siler
text:
Palace Diner, set in an old railway dining car in downtown Biddeford, is a quirky but not at all gimmicky local diner.  It has an incredibly hip (think East Village 1990's) vibe and is dead serious about providing excellent diner food elevated to a higher level.  Their Palais Royale and Fries was picked by Downeast Magazine as one of Maine's 25 best burgers, and with good reason.  Two ridiculously juicy patties cooked on the flat grill with all you might want on a traditional Cheeseburger Deluxe, served on a brioche bun with spectacular hand cut fries.  This is 50s nostalgia take to a high level.  It's really big though, so you can save four bucks by going for its smaller sibling, simply titled Cheeseburger and fries.

Hours are short, 8:00 to 2:00, serving both breakfast and lunch.

name: Just Me
text:
The 'Heart' of Downtown Portland.
This open air area has benches for sitting,  bike racks, and an enclosed city bus stop. The area is surrounded by a variety of establishments, including Longfellows, an award-winning bookstore that's both family and pet friendly. The store sells both new and used books, and offers downtown's largest and most diverse selection of magazines. Also in the immediate area: restaurants, a bakery, a two story mini-mall specializing in natural foods (with a natural foods court), a copy and UPS center, a Key Bank with an ATM, and the city library (with computers for public access).
Just up and down the street you'll find a post office, a CVS pharmacy, a Subway sandwich shop, multiple clubs and music halls, an Escape Room, an Arts & Crafts store, gently-used designer clothing stores, the Nickelodeon movie theater, historical houses, a parking garage... with much more to discover, explore and appreciate.
On Wednesdays, during fair weather seasons, the Square hosts a farmer's market...and throughout the year, various arts, business, and social service events are held here, including on the day after Thanksgiving, an evening ceremony ushering in the Holiday season, and lighting up Portland's official Christmas tree.
Plus, you can enjoy listening to the occasional busker musicians, and amateur orators compelled to share their views and concerns.

name: Michael Grochmal
text:
The seating in the theatre was very comfortable with a slight decline that didn't interfere with the person in front of me.  Audio was loud and clear and was enough to drown out other movies without being overwhelming.
Snacks included both standard fare and small meals (chips, chicken wings, sandwiches etc.) and were served by friendly, accommodating staff.  Overall, it's a great venue to see the latest blockbusters (as well as film festival-style vintage nights) in a comfortable environment.

If I go and complain, they do turn it up a little - but that means I have to miss a part of my movie. It's a stinky way to save money 🙁

name: John Vedral
text:
The screen was large and the seats are comfortable.
Don't sit too close to the screen, however, as the square pixels of the digital projector can be seen in the white areas. I sat in the middle of a row just forward of half way back and the pixels were still visible. In addition, there was some keystone distortion where the image was narrower towards the top of the screen.
The theater was a little bit humid, but not uncomfortable. The sound was excellent and there are multiple speakers providing not only a full spectrum of frequencies but also providing audio in a physical location that matched the location of the dialog or action on the screen.

name: The Maine Criminal Defense Group
text: Not all movie theaters are the same. Cinemagic has done a nice job with allowing you to reserve your specific seats out of time. That's especially important when you're trying to get into a movie on opening night on a busy weekend. That way, if you're diligent, you will get to see you were hoping for. Also, the seats are very comfortable the sound system is excellent and I feel like the amount of money for the tickets are appropriate. Popcorn is generally fresh although like some movie theaters, it may sit around for a little bit too long. But I guess that would be my only complaint. And really, it's an awesome theater.

text:
My go-to theater in the area.

Cinemagic in Westbrook is closer to me than some other theaters, but even if it wasn't, I'd probably still choose it aside from when I want to watch things in IMAX - as this location isn't equipped for that.

The location is clean, has a decent arcade, and the staff are generally enthusiastic and friendly. The food experience is lacking, but that's true of most theaters.

Would recommend as an alternative to the much busier Saco location unless you want IMAX.

name: Courtney Clark
text:
Cinemagic in Westbrook is my go to theater in the Portland area. It has its own parking lot, which you would think is a given for a movie theater (The theater in downtown Portland does not have its own lot. There is a garage next door which the theater will validate the parking, but you still end up having to pay something to park). There is no IMAX at this location, but they do offer some movies in 3D. I always buy my ticket at the self serve ticket KIOSK. This way you don't have to wait in line to buy a ticket and deal with the clerk.

The staff do a good job at keeping the showrooms clean. I've never gone into a theater and seen trash on the floor or on the chairs pre-movie. The bathrooms always seem fine, they are your typical public bathroom stalls. There are plenty of them, you'll never have to wait to use the bathroom.

The concessions are your typical movie theater foods (popcorn, candy, soda, nachos, hot dogs). There is a dippin dots ice cream vending machine in the hall way. I actually bought the dippin dots once, it comes out in a little packet and its basically a frozen mush at the bottom of the packet. Definitely not worth the $4 or whatever it costs! Are the concessions wicked expensive? Yes. Do I still want a giant tub of buttery popcorn and giant soda to munch on during the movie? Yes.

text: The atmosphere was great.  Had the grilled tuna. Way to dry for being local and fresh.  Substituted the broccoli for rice and beans.  The flavor was bland and tasted like mush.  Service was par, drinks were good. Should of just had drinks and enjoyed the atmosphere.

resp.text:
Thanks for the feedback! Looks like it was your first time here right?

We do get our fish fresh everyday from Harbor Fish and will cook it to order if so desired. This would help with the dry experience you had, next time try medium rare if you so fancy. It is unfortunate that you swapped out the broccoli for the rice and beans because if I had to guess you were having your meal after 9 o'clock and the rice is kind of a gamble around that time of night.

Not sure where you were sitting but I'd venture that it was either the bar or the lounge (seat yourself area) please correct me if I'm wrong so I can take the appropriate action for your "par service" which while still par is also just one away from bogey, and that is not acceptable for our personal standards of excellence.

Lastly it seems that you had nothing to say about the beer, which says to me that maybe the Bear isn't exactly what you are looking for and that might have contributed to you leaving us a two star review. In the future under better circumstances maybe you will have a change of heart, and throw some more support for our local establishment by updating your rating and review upon future visits.

Thank you for your time,
Dave Foster
GLB
bear@greatlostbear.com

name: J C
text:
The Great Lost Bear is an excellent, quirky, and fun restaurant on Forest Ave. in Portland. I have gone a few times recently as I work within walking distance. Be aware that the entrance may not be readily noticeable as the door is unmarked.

The food here is excellent and comes in a wide variety, from Mexican/American to a delicious Greek salad. The prices are reasonable and the services is prompt. For fellow gluten free folks, be aware that they do not have gluten free bread/hamburger buns. Overall I would recommend stopping in this great local restaurant.

name: cwalkenisgod
text:
A great place for burgers.

Great Lost Bear is a unique eatery with an interesting menu. Feel like wings? Theirs are great, but they are actual "wings" and not the tiny drumsticks we've come to know. Feel like a burger? They've got a bunch - most notably the "Almighty Cheezus" - which is essentially a burger with grilled cheese sandwiches replacing the buns.

The interior is warm and cozy, and the staff are all generally pretty upbeat and friendly. It's also roomy inside and can accommodate large parties.

However, it's located on busy Forest Ave and the parking situation is pretty terrible, almost nullifying their capacity for big parties in the first place, sometimes.

Still, would definitely recommend overall. Make sure to get cheese on your fries, and stay for dessert! You can get drinks here, too.

text: Great local pub. Huge beer selection. Strong drinks. Think they're getting a little on the pricey side for what it is but I guess all of Portland is.

name: Sean Banks
text: Just wow. The service was unreal. The food was unreal. The decor was fun. The beer was plentiful. All around an A+ visit.

name: Ryan Kelley
text: Been going here and touching the Tesla ball since I was 8 years old. Excellent food and service every time. Love the bear.

name: Rory Benjamin
text:
We've been going to GLB for years and have always been consistently pleased with the delicious food. Earlier tonight we visited and encountered our first ever issue with service.

We went during a slow dinner time (4PM) and were seated right next to another family, despite the rest of the entire dining section being completely empty. Both us and the table next to us waited 10 minutes without anyone coming over to even take a drink order. Finally someone from the other table went and found a person to take orders.

The food came out extremely quickly, making up for the unfortunate start to the dining experience. The food itself was great, but I don't think we saw our waitress again for the next 20+ minutes that we spent eating. My wife never received the water she asked for. We only ever saw a member of the wait staff again when it was time to pay. Hopefully this was a one-time issue.

name: Hunter Foote
text: Great Lost Bear never disappoints. The service is great, The location is really convenient off the highway. The food selection is creative and the menu is sizable. They have a great gluten free menu. The beer selection is really incredible with a ton of beers on tap. Nothing summarizes the spirit of Portland quite like this.

name: Helen Dillon
text: The Great Lost Bear has great atmosphere, great service and above all fabulous food.  Even when they are crowded, the wait for a table isn't bad.  I highly recommend them.

name: Joanie Naigle
text: Love the atmosphere and the food and beer choices are superior

name: Alyssa Louise
text: Love the atmosphere. Great selection of beers and full bar! Super yummy food. Something for everyone on the menu.

name: Vy O
text:
Wonderful service and friendly atmosphere.
Rodeo burger....SUPER YUM!

name: chris whitten
text: Had a burger and fries the burger was cooked just right the fries were good too great beer selection

name: Aimee Huard
text: The grilled mushrooms were great as an appetizer. We both ordered burgers - both were tasty, but mine was closer to well done than medium rare. The other was well cooked.

name: Hippiexchic
text: Busy place. Wait time is usually around 15-30  minutes, probably more for a bigger group. Good food and atmosphere. They have the biggest selection of beers on tap in Portland, Maine.

name: Mike LaBonte
text: Bear encounter never disappoints.

name: Kelly Petit
text: Good food. Huge drink selection. Great service

name: Michaele Rackliff
text: For the beer connoisseur, this place is the bomb.  They have an insane amount of options and are always switching them out to bring in new and different brews.  The food has been hit or miss for me.  I had a burger there once that was good but not worth the price for my taste.  And then I had nachos and deep fried veggies with cheese sauce that were out of this world.  More or less, when I go there, I'm not going because I'm craving their food, rather more because I really want the unique warm atmosphere and a really good brew.

resp.text: Right on! Thanks for stopping by!

name: Danielle F.
text:
Nice to find a fun pub in the area. Pretty standard pub fare, the beer list is great.
Fries are definitely not my favorite, but the hot sauce is good.

name: Keith Dubois
text: Best wings I've ever had!!

resp.text: Thanks Keith, we appreciate it!

name: Emily Smith
text: Best place in Portland for casual eats and comprehensive beer offerings. Environment is relaxed and service is excellent.

name: Orange Satyrsis
text:
Stellar selections of brews, cocktails, and food. Many different areas to sit in that offer different atmospheres. Knowledgeable staff with efficient service.
Went today and had Craig as a server and he is excellent!

name: james stockwell
text: There needs to be a rule where if it's your first time there, you have to eat the wings! There buffalo wings are the best I have ever had.

name: Christopher Kogut
text: The great lost bear is an awesome place to eat. The food is fantastic. I used to eat meat and when I did their burgers were amazing. Now that I don't their veggie burger is equally amazing! Their fries however are my favorite part. Round cut and flat but still plump and fresh. Also a really nice selection of local and craft brews.

name: Rhonda Marquis
text: Great relaxed atmosphere. Good food and pleasant staff.

name: Lindsey
text: TONS of options with a lot of variety! I had the tuna steak meal, and it was so fresh and delicious. This would be a great restaurant for a family with kids, couples, a group of adults, etc... Friendly and accommodating for every age. Has a great balance of healthy and fun foods. Highly recommend

name: Jonathan Payne
text: The beer selection is really good.  All of our food was great and the portions are HUGE.  Plan on splitting stuff or bringing food home.

name: Gregory Hogan
text: We took our grandchildren here, one a toddler and the other under one y.o and still had a great time. That tells you something about the staff and the food.

name: Jessica Reader
text: Large food and beer menu selections. There's something for everyone. There's a great kid menu too. All of our food tasted very good. The server was friendly, attentive and had helpful suggestions.

name: James Dixon
text: Great food and appnesfear. Very friendly and knowledgeable staff. Can't wait for the deck to open. The beverages were satisfying. Looking forward to our next  visit.

name: Ari Modugno
text: Off the beatentrack. Fast Friendly and consistently good comfort food. We go no where else for chicken wings. Unadulterated low salt extra crispy whole wings that satisfy in a relaxed atmosphere.

name: ron goodwin
text: I'm going to give them five stars! First of all you need to try their super nachos. They are the best by far. Also you have to have bear fries, and for dessert Snickers pie. The Snickers pie is out of this world.

name: Daniel Aho
text: One of my spots, I just recommend it. Though, again I like going there.

name: Jacob B
text: While their food menu is absurdly large, most of it is pretty good. I love their burgers and the French fries are always great. They've got a ton of beer, and the decor is unique. I'd avoid their fajita and go for something more along traditional pub fare as it's much better. Parking can be awful but honestly this place is worth a trip or two.

name: Jean Lorenz
text: We generally eat here at least once when we visit Portland. ME.  The food and service are pretty good, and it is pretty convenient to where we stay.

name: Kate Savidge
text: This was the first time in at least 20 years that I have been to the Great Lost Bear. We went to celebrate our twins graduating from high school. It was their choice to go for dinner here and we had the best time. Our waiter was great despite it being a very busy night. He was running all over but never forgot to check in on us. The food was delicious. I had the Woodford's Cheesesteak sandwich and a mini salad. We will be coming back. It was a great night out.

name: Ashley Abbott
text: Big food great beer selection and a friendly environment. One of my favorite spots in Portland for the relaxed, social environment and down east home feeling. Expect to share or have leftovers. The grub is definitely pub though their lighter fare is quite nice. Menu is large and beer specials are prime

name: brewandbbq
text: Great selection of beer and massive menu. Great service and big, tasty portions.

name: Nick Mahar
text: Homely tavern feel with a nice selection of bar food. Wings are a massive quantity, definitely worth the price!

name: Renee Carney
text: Love this place! Buffalo Cauliflower is so good! Vegetarian chili is the best I've had!

name: Calliope Simon
text: I always love the Bear!  Love the nachos and Thai tempura vegetable roll up.  Cheesy fries also make a great appetizer.  Tons of beers.  My personal favorite is the creamsicle.  Deliciousness in a glass.

name: Steve Koenemann
text: If you want/like great craft beer... this is the place to go... 80 taps. The food here is also excellent...

name: Janis McQuarrie
text: Friendly bar and restaurant with great specials.

name: Duncan Pfaehler
text: Great food, awesome variety of beers available.  They also do a lot of events throughout the week and their beer specials can be really great if you're on a budget.  Good atmosphere as well.  My girlfriend and I have been several times now and we've never had to wait for a table because they have a lounge area that normally has some open seats.  Quick service and friendly staff too!

name: Adam T
text: Always a good spot for some grub!  It's close to my work and easy enough for a pick-up or a drop in lunch.

name: Crystal Tibbetts
text:
Good food, great beer selection, fun atmosphere. The fried veggies are awesome, I never would have thought about frying a carrot, but more people should!
I love the Onion Gratin Burger and their nachos are awesome too. If you haven't been, you should.

resp.text: Thanks! Glad you enjoyed it!

name: Jeff Schneider
text: Cool bar with good food and service.

name: Bianca Oliva
text: Absolutely awesome. Great staff,  friendly servers and bartenders and a good beer selection. The food is fantastic as well. Definitely going to have to visit a few more times. Try the "BBQ Hot Mess" meal. So worth it.

name: Amanda Sepeda
text: Wings were amazing, service was amazing, and there were so many beer choices! Didnt care for my cheesesteak because the cheese sauce they use was almost a ricotta texture which I dislike but overall, extremely satisfied with this place.

name: jason haberstroh
text: This place is Fantastic

name: Lyndsey Cook
text: Absolutely LOVE this place!! Great food, service and environment! Thank you!

name: Matt Porter
text: We had a great time tonight.  The food was delicious and Craig is an excellent server.  Highly recommend you check this place out for!

name: Kevin Campbell
text: Great food.  Large menu.  Dozens of beer taps with many local brews.

name: David Hamel
text: American Bar and Grille...a must for a great BURGER AND Potatoe Slices...yummy slaw...and a FEW BEERS not to mention...AMERICANA!

name: Rick Farrar
text: You'd best make sure you are here for Thursday night's, showcase! For a taste of craft brews from around the country.

name: Carrie Ann Brown
text: Food is good here been here like 4 times. Wait staff is slacking for sure. Prices decent, nice interesting atmosphere.

name: Tessa Hathaway
text: A lot of menu options, and of course a lot of beer. Good variety, unique options, great decor and atmosphere. Definitely something to try out if you're in the area!

name: Jonathan Jameson
text: Cozy place with lots of hype surrounding it. I can see why, food was well made and the knowledge of beers and selection was great. Friendly staff, decent music ambiance.

name: Nicole Brown
text: Amazing food, great atmosphere! We had a party of 4 in a booth and we had great service! Beer and liquor selection very good and a wide selection of food as well! Will go again and would def recommend!

name: Shelly Laurich
text: Very intriguing place. The food was great and reasonably priced. Would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a place to eat.

name: Daniel Jandreau
text: Best BBQ boneless wings I've ever had in my life.

name: Joe Hezlep
text: GLB as it's called by locals has been a Portland landmark for years. It has been serving crafts beers, a large selection of them, since way before it was trendy. Get the wings or the Cajun burger.

name: Justin Look
text: Cozy, great food at reasonable prices. Homemade mac n cheese is amazing!

name: Jake Scott
text: I wish I could give this place 6 stars. Great drinks. Great food. I grew up in the northern Midwest and this place made me feel at home. It's a departure from the rest of the Portland food scene and really stands out. There are many varieties of drinks to choose and the staff is friendly. There are vegan options and hearty meals and everything else in between. Awesome place.

name: Samantha Ricker
text: Great food and service. Fun location. Great for kids.

name: John Poulin
text:
Owen is the best!!
Very good to our rowdy party and we thank him immensely. Love the Ball-chinian !!

name: Shea Murphy
text: It's not the most health-conscious food in the world, but it's all delicious in the microbrewery is fantastic! The service is always very friendly, and you can actually sit down and have a conversation with your friends in this place without a lot of distraction. By the way, save room for the cake in the Mason jar.

name: Kate Kosior
text: Fun atmosphere, really big menu. Good draft list. Like a nice diner with a more woodsy feel

name: Jen H.
text: Wings, Burgers, Beer!   A local favorite for just about everything.  Vegan friends are not left out of this hot spot.  Try the the daily beer special and you just might find your new favorite beer. Make a meal from the appetizer menu and you will not be disappointed. Daily food specials keep it new and intriguing.  Don't bother trying to leave room for dessert.  They will pack it up to go, so you don't miss out!

name: Terra Beasley
text: Great food at affordable prices & excellent service.

name: Cole Tuininga
text: Decent food though the service was a bit "iffy", especially since we went at a bit of an off time and it was slow. Prices were reasonable for the area and there was a really interesting selection of food choices.

name: Johnathan Emery
text: The Great Lost Bear is a Portland standard. If you came to Portland for beer you must stop by this place. They have an insane amount of taps and are doing events with local breweries nearly constantly. The food here is also top notch pub food and should not be missed. Get a side of cheese sauce with your fries!

name: Justin Gilmore
text: Absolutely love their food and service is amazing here. Good Service is hard to find in the portland

name: Drew Farrar
text: Lots of IPAs, if you like IPAs.  Fun atmosphere.

name: michelle amato
text: Fun familt bar scene, great selection of good drafts, and everyone is friendly.

name: Liz B.
text: Eclectic menu, great beer selection, friendly service. This place is a bit off the beaten path as far as Portland restaurants, but it was good with a small group. I had the thai chili chicken sandwich and the sauce was delicious but the chicken was a little dry. The bear fries were also average, but overall it was a good meal and a good time.

name: Pete Thiel
text: I've been going to GLB over 25 yesrs. Consistently great beer and food. All the other craft beer pubs can only aspire to walk in GLBs shoes.

name: Benjamin Helstrom
text: The food is great but the menu is staggeringly enormous. Be prepared to take a long time to figure out what you want to eat. Good portions and beer menu, they also have a lot of fun things on their menu. Great place to bring friends. HOWEVER; the parking is HORRIBLE during a busy night.

name: Damian D
text: The food was ok at best. I honestly think they're no more for their beer. The waiter was decent and is the reason why I didn't give them two stars.

name: Just And
text: I am batting 1000 on my visits here. The food is a lot of your standard pub grub with flair added. Fantastic beer selection. The bar has ample seating.

name: Bob Wooten
text:
Great beer selection. Good food. Fine service.
The better beers are a bit expensive, but if you love craft beer you can't beat the choices.

name: Kathryn Allenby
text: Fun and unique decor. Reminds me of Old Sacramento place called Fannie Ann's ( also known for great burgers)

name: Richard
text: Always have had a great time here... I've been going some 40 years now!

name: Matthew Campbell
text: Been going for years, and always solid. A tremendous selection of draft beers.

name: elizabeth curtis
text: Gone a few times. Enjoy the food, the music and attentiveness of the staff. Water low? These guys are ready to fill it! Food is priced well too. Only complaint is the chairs are kinda uncomfortable. :)

name: Daryn Daniluk
text: The Lewiston cheese steak is a solid choice.  Greg the server, was on point. Truly awe inspiring beer selection.  Gorgeous day to dine al fresco.

name: Kaia Palmer
text: Great bar and great PB&J boneless wings!

name: Christopher Julian
text: I love this place...one of the only places I've ever been anywhere that serves the best blue cheese hamburger ever! From first bite to last it's the best hamburger I have ever tried. Not to mention the atmosphere is just completely layed back and none judgemental . The price of food and drink is extremely reasonable and well worth it. Enjoy

name: LL Ouellette
text:
Had the teriyaki grilled mushrooms and vegan chili. The mushrooms were flavorful and best eaten when very hot. They would pair well with the streak tips. (Not on the menu but available upon request.) The vegan chili was strong on the cumin but had a pleasing kick that compelled me to keep dipping my spoon. Tortilla chips were delightfully light and crunchy and had either no salt or very light salt.
The missing 5th star? The hostess sat us between a wall and the only other occupied table, replete with wailing kid, in an otherwise empty room.

name: Clara Jacobs
text: I've been coming here for many years and they always blow me out of the water. Staff is great, I love the atmosphere and the food is amazing. I personally love the BBQ Hot Mess. 10/5 this place is a must to go to.

name: Ben W.
text:
Always exceptional, never had an issue with anything here, service or food.

Menu is insane, must be a 100 different items!

name: Vincent Grassi
text: Very eclectic atmosphere, unique menu, service is hit or miss (more often a miss).  Good fried chicken breast sandwiches, cheese sauce for fries, and seafood.  Stay away from burgers; they are like hockey pucks.

name: Seamus McGrath
text: Great beer selection, and the $2.99 pint special is usually a pretty good beer. Food is good, with the more outlandish and wild choices being the best of the bunch. And get the Snicker Pie.

name: Lynn Hady
text: Love the atmosphere--especialy the mini dining rooms that make the whole place feel like it's really cozy.

name: alison parker
text: Local brew pub good food drinks and specials

name: C B
text: HUGE selection of beer, interesting menu options (including a burger whose buns 😉 are grilled cheese sandies), and extremely friendly staff. Welcoming atmosphere; a cozy Portland establishment.

name: Jay Binnion
text: The Great Lost Bear. I have spent many a dollar and time in this establishment. It is a place to contemplate your life. Woo the woman or man of your dreams. Or just simply get some nourishment because you're famished and parched. The staff are nice enough. Few wander into the Great Lost Bear and leave disappointed. Good luck finding the bear.

name: Melissa Lauckner
text: Great food, casual atmosphere.  Slow, spotty service.  Their fries aren't actual fries like you might expect.  Delicious, but if you're looking for chili cheese fries, they're more like thick cut chips/ steak fries.

name: Johanna Jackson
text: Huge establishment with a fantastic beer list. My crab roll was fresh and tasty, but the baked beans were probably my favorite part of the meal.

name: Bradley Dubois
text: The veggie burger with Thai peanut sauce is my favorite and I get it every time I come here with extra sauce. I jokingly asked the server for the recipe and joked that it's like crack. Their fries are thick cut and worth the caloric indulgence. They've got tons of beer on tap if beer is your fancy. Love this place for its quirky environment and good food without the pretentious hipster qualities of some of the restaurants of downtown Portland. Prices are also super reasonable. I've never had bad service.

name: Giffy
text: I've been going here for 10+ years. You can't do better than the bear. Most beers on tap in Portland and their menu would satisfy an Alaskan grizzly

name: Arthur Bennett III
text: Food is always amazing and the environment is always relaxing.

name: Mike Twitchell
text: Food was good, facility was clean. Waitress had an attitude and not friendly whatsoever. Kept going out back to staff area.

name: TJ Arnold
text: Great service. Great for larger groups. Good menu. Huge craft beer selection.

name: Mark Sweeney
text: Love this place.  Huge selection of beers on tap at decent prices.  Menu is very large as are the portions.  I always visit here a couple of times each time I come to Portland.

name: Jamie Juenemann
text: This place was jammed when we gort here.  My party had to sit all the way in the back.  The room was supposed to be closed.  We lucked out with a fantastic waiter who told us to sit and he would serve us.  (i think his name was steve.)  Food and everything was great.  They have TONS of draft beers and a HUGE menu.  I keep coming back to this place.

name: William Andrews
text: Nice atmosphere. So so food. Fried chicken sandwich not that good. Stringy maybe freezer burnt. A bit chewy

name: Sarah Dee
text: Great food, great service, small bathroom but manageable, found parking across the street no problem.

name: Steve D
text: Love the food.  Love the beer selection.  Love the atmosphere.  Pretty much just love the place.

name: Theodore Wilbar
text: This is a great local joint that has never disappointed me in the 2 years I've been going. The menu is like a fold out map and has tons of options. The beer selection is top notch and will please even the most picky of beer snobs. You can't go wrong coming here. People I've brought here always ask to go again.

name: Pamela Rawson
text: Comfortable after work gathering place. Huge selection of draft beverages, mostly local microbrews. Extensive menu of pub favorites.

name: Christopher Lee
text: Server was kinda rude. Criticized us for seating ourselves even though we were sat by the hostess.

name: Lainey Cross
text: Extensive menu. Great food

name: Patricia Lamy
text: Easy to find with a great menu and beer selection. Large portions and great service.

name: Ken Moulton Jr.
text: If you like reading for ten minutes before you order a drink, and choosing between hundreds of options before you even think about getting your food, then this place may be for you! The wings are amazing though, and I've heard they have some pretty good lunch/dinner options too. There is a good amount of regulars who frequent the establishment,  and the owner frequently can be found behind the bar, so that's nice to see. All in all, if you're planning a night out with your chums, or meeting some fellow employees after work, the place offers a good chance to relax and get something you'll like.

name: Rich Stevens
text: Love this place. The hardest part is figuring out what to order as it is all good and they have so many great beers!!!

name: Chris Webb
text:
Sat down for a beer, and the bartender was complaining to a coworker that he had a 103 temperature and only came in because he couldn’t find anyone to take his shift.
103 is still contagious. I left immediately.

resp.text:
Thanks for bringing this to our attention Chris!

I've spent the last 24 hours researching the incident you described and based on multiple eyewitness reports we have identified the bartender in question and he has since been terminated. Not fired, but actually he died. Not from a 103 temperature, but from the shock of reading your review that is based loosely on an event from a Thursday over a month ago where he was having a quick gripe session with a fellow employee about trouble with shift coverage when he was feeling under the weather.

When he found out from your review that he had had a 103 fever that day and realized how contagious he was he proceeded to die from the shame of not being able to find someone to work for him.

We are all very shaken up right now, but we still very much appreciate your feedback, and hope that you will find the courage to venture out into the world in the future.

Best Wishes,
Dave Foster
GLB

name: Victoria Roth
text: Great service, friendly staff and very accommodating to my gluten allergy!

name: sam tarbox
text:
Super long time fan of the GLB.  I've been going there since I was eighteen years old.
This is a landmark restaurant of the Maine craft beer movement.  They were one of the first to tote more than 50+ beers on tap.
The food is fantastic, you can go wrong with any of the burgers or the sandwich selections. If you're a serious beer fan this your place.

name: Stephen Fernald
text: Best beer bar in America! Amazing selection of craft beer and a really nice food menu. The staff is super friendly and knowledgeable.

name: Amanda Arris
text: Huge menu. Be prepared for possible long waits. Food is great and something for everyone. Lots of things to look at around the restaurant

name: John Turnmire
text: A long-standing pillar of the Portland craft beer scene, this restaurant and bar prides itself by almost exclusively serving beers from Maine.  Great prices and over 30 taps with daily specials.  A beer head's delight.   On the restaurant side expect friendly service and a diverse menu, and kid friendly options.

name: Johnny McKee
text:
Our waiter was fantastic, some of our food was too spicy. We ordered " dirty wings". On the same plate some were just right and some were way overpowered. One of 2  bowls of the chilly was the same. Somebody in the kitchen last Friday night thought everyone liked Xxxx heat.
If you like medium to mild...stress it when you order.

name: Lynne Holland
text: Great burger options but also enlightened healthy options

name: Michael Matis
text: Delicious, wide variety of food, huge craft beer selection, lots of seating options, and very friendly staff.

name: David Harlor
text:
Great lost bear is a staple for me. I review places I go to often and really enjoy. I think GLB is second to none if you are looking for:

A lowkey, casual bar with an enormous draft beer selection. While they have many Maine beers available, they also have classics from all over the country, and the world.

It's usually a little busy, but never feels loud. The staff knowledgeable and friendly, and most importantly, consistent.

A portland classic.

name: Jaime Maresh
text: Food and service was amazing!  My step son had the Almighty Cheesus burger and we had the Loaded Steakbomb

name: Mike Whalen
text: This place is awesome! Great food, fantastic service and a cool restaurant! I will definitely come back

name: Kait Micks
text: French onion soup is amazing, if only their tap lines were clean... 😕

name: Dennis Harris
text: I have been coming here FOREVER and never disappointed. Fish and chips  is outstanding. Super fresh. The chicken fajita is the size of a football and cooked perfectly. Rice and beans is my favorite side YUM

name: Garett Lefebvre
text: Great beer selection,  huge menu, comfortable place to catch up with old friends.

name: Charles Foss
text: Great salad. Great beer selection. Great customer service.

name: Jordan T Peters
text: Service is slow sometimes, but always friendly. Like 50+ beers on tap, great food selection and quality is always great! Gets busy for donner, especially on weekends. Get there early!

name: Bretton Wolff
text: Great burger with grilled cheese sandwiches instead of bun!! Delicious.  And 80 taps, great selection of beers

name: Cynthia Pagiatakis
text: Just as good as I remembered from years ago!

name: Emily Blood
text: Fast service, good food and drinks

name: Daisy Doo Farm
text: Amazing food, and atmosphere!!! Great place for date night!!!

name: fdrlq
text: Amazing food and great service!

name: Jasmin Lyn Richards
text: Huge menu with options for all palettes and dietary needs, all locally sourced, plus a full page of drinks. The staff were friendly and the food came out quickly. Everything was delicious!

name: Peyton Curran
text: The service is always great. The decor is fantastic. I recommend the burgers, or maybe their Almighty Cheezus, if you dare. Huge beer/drink selection. Definitely one of Portland's go to spots.

name: Jenna Carlson
text:
Love this place.  Huge beer selection.  The decor here is neat, staff are awesome.
Must try the chicken wings (ranch and blue cheese dressings are amazing and made here), fried veggies are my favorite and the mason jar with mac n cheese, pulled pork, beans and slaw is amazing!!!

name: Ishmeel Daniels
text: I love the bear and she gets every bit of five stars!!

name: Dragon Quang
text: They have lots of good food, the dirty wings is way better the stock house. The environment in there are really great

name: Teri Zrioka
text: Great selection of beer, really good burgers. Polite, attentive service. Parking can be an issue.

name: Joe C
text: Great wings

resp.text: Cheers!

name: Nathan Confer
text: Great food and a great beer selection!  I am picky about the beers I drink, but the Bear always has something I like.  The food is good as well.  I recommend the Mother and Child Reunion.

name: Christopher Clayton
text: A massive beer selection, great food, and great staff.  They are also great with kids and have crayons and kids mats available.

name: RACHAEL CONNER
text: It's got an extensive beer and sandwich menu. Open late. Good service.

name: Kathleen Leggett
text: The food was super yummy. But parking was  tough to find. Over all I recommend this restaurant.

name: Ben Djarin-Link
text: Just fantastic. Endless beer selection, great food. Just hope the great bear will come home one day.

name: Andreas Schöllmann
text: Great food and atmosphere!

name: Rebecca Berry
text: Wow so tonight was the worst yet. Seriously I'm not sure if I'm going to make it over there again. There inexperienced and have no core values when it comes to service. So many things to rate horrible 😫 I'm not picky whatsoever. I have 2  boys that are 10 years old with me... Like if anything we are the ones usually picked out the croud lol but the service is not working. There standing around on there phones. There trying to determine who's order is who's , going from table to table.  The food is good for the rich. So for two kids an two adults it's $102.00 to eat . But the buffalo mac 'n cheese is the smallest size for 10.99 for AN APPITIZER !!  N just the list goes on. Plus my best friend is just telling me she works for -maid for you - in Gorham and was part of the cleaning crew who has cleaned this place and there's a reason why there's a low light in this place. It was so nasty. So isent the owners house. They used all there rags and had to dig into anther crews bag. I even confirmed this with anther crew member of the cleaning crew who has been there n seen the whole o'rdeal. So I'm going to have to take a look at the rest of the facts that are posted below because I CANT judge by the first time here.......

resp.text:
Thanks for the feedback Rebecca!

Looks like you had a bad first time experience at the Bear. We are sorry to hear this and hope that you do consider us in the future for our fun and laid back atmosphere, and quirky staff! A lot of places treat their staff like indentured servants, but our staff is our family and we love our family! I read all the reviews that are posted on this platform and have discovered that a segment of first time Bear-goers have fallen through the cracks in an otherwise well accommodating customer service environment. Perhaps you will take a chance on us in the future and your experience will be better. If not the best of luck to you and your future restaurant-ing experiences!

Thanks again for sharing your personal GLB dining experience!

When our food finally came it was very good, wings were large and a side of blue cheese complimented them very well. Next, my burger which was over cooked, I ordered a medium rare and it came out medium well. Overall it was an ok experience, but I probably won’t return.

resp.text:
Thanks for the feedback!

We will use this information to help us continue in our quest for perfection in food preparation and service. We don't always get everything perfect, but we always strive to, sometimes in the face of overwhelming odds. We do apologize for the twenty  minute wait, but Saturday lunch does tend to be a busy time for us, and we are unfortunately limited to the amount of chairs that are available in the building, as we have not committed to having stand up service at our sit down restaurant.

About that burger...

Mistakes do happen when we are at capacity, and although our cooks are the best in the business, sometimes a temp on a burger will err on the more cooked side of caution. The chances of this happening are certainly greater when there are thirty plus tickets in the window, but again our apologies for the miss step on that temp.

About your waitress...

I think I know who you might be talking about, but I'm not going to assume too much. Let's just say that for every good customer there are ten bad ones, and that kind of constant abuse from the sort of self satisfied, universe revolves around me individuals, possibly created from our narcissistic social media obsessed culture, can lead even our most patient servers to have micro breakdowns occasionally. We do apologize again that you happened to be on the receiving end of that snap.

In closing I just want to again thank you for your feedback on your experience today.

Sincerely,
Dave Foster
GLB

I totally agree with you that the menu is very confusing. The next time we do a menu update we will make sure to post it for all the staff to read over and double check for at least two weeks before we send it over to the printers. The vegetarian chilli has always been vegan, and we wanted to make note of that option in the nacho descriptions, but it would help if there was at least a comma in there somewhere to differentiate between the nachos being vegan (which they are not) and the chilli being vegan (which we have both varieties meat and vegan).

Dave Foster

text: I've been coming to the Bear for years, and all the comments about great quality of food and VAST selection of beers are accurate. My perennial complaint is poor customer service. Their are various local nicknames for this restaurant including, "Great Lost Waitress", "Great Lost Meal", Great Lost Beer", you get the idea. So my recommendations, definitely try this place, but have plenty of time. Don't eat here right before the show, movie, etc. Carpool, Uber, Lyft during busy, peak hours to avoid parking challenges. Lastly, don't be afraid to track a waitperson down if they haven't taken your drink order within the first 15 mins. They're pretty gracious about it, the place is just disorganized (but darn I love that Buffalo chicken sandwich!) So hopefully this information will help you enjoy a Portland fav.

This place is my jam! I legit love it every time I go there, from the inventive bands that play to the fantastic cocktails. It's a great place for anything, from lounging with friends to a first or second date to whatever else.

PS: Tell me when the Devil Moon is back!

name: Mac Coldwell
text: Blue is one of the most supportive live venues I've performed at. Even though it's donation, they do a very good job at communicating, musicians can't work for free. The menu is small, but there is a great rotation of specials so it doesn't get stale. There is a good selection of beer and wine, and they know how to steep a good cup of tea. The staff has always been helpful and good natured. It's also a great venue to watch live acts. They bring in a a good variety of bands and interesting events like naked Shakespeare. There is no parking, but on most nights, you can find on street parking within a 5-10 minute walk.

name: Matt Kennedy
text: Intimate place to see some of the most original music in Portland on a nightly basis. Bring cash as the performances are all "pay what you can" and they pass the basket - the shows are always worth anything you can spend though. Probably the best place in Portland to just pop in to hear music if you're not looking to catch a specific show (though you can do that too).

resp.text: Thanks so much for your review, Matt!  We feel the same way :)

Literally the best Sunday evening in memory, sitting alone at the back of the room, eating pumpkin soup and fresh bread, drinking red wine, and listening to two women making beautiful sounds. Excellent service- very mindful of respecting the music while still being attentive. REALLY tasty soup and wine. Artists- Sorcha Cribben-Merrill and Monique Barrett. Look them up.

name: Jenna
text: I give 2 stars for a couple different reasons. One being the female waitress rushed our orders. She actually said after us ordering a appetizer and then oysters that if we could just order everything together that would be better because the kitchen did not like her coming back and forth. I did not get that because you would think the more we ordered the more money you would get. Also we felt overly rushed. Then we both had the steak with lobster. She did not explain how the surf and turf worked and added it to the order without telling us the upcharge! Needless to say two people eating the bill came to 156.00 and the steak was horribly tough. Never again !

resp.text:
TO READERS OF THIS REVIEW - We encourage you to read other reviews left by Jenna and the responses by those business' owners, as it appears that she has created a hobby out of leaving extreme and vitriolic reviews of other businesses, sometimes even threatening legal action.

With that said - Hi, Jenna - I must admit that I am completely baffled by your harsh review, and I have a completely different account of your experience with us Saturday night. Allow me to present my recollection of the experience. This is going to be a long read, so you may want to grab a snack (might I suggest the leftovers you took with you):

1. Saturday night, 5pm - You and a friend arrived at our restaurant asking for a table for 2. You explained that you had just come from another restaurant but had to leave because that restaurant's atmosphere triggered your vertigo. I explained that we were fully booked for the evening, but I would be happy to make room for you provided that I could have the table back in  1 1/2 hours to seat another reservation.

2.  We had a lovely chat as I sat you, and I showed you how to use our digital menu.

3. When you ordered, your server explained that if you would like to order your full meal, our kitchen would time out the courses so that you would not have to wait too long in between courses. She never rushed you.

4. Your server absolutely divulged the price of lobster added to your steak. I 100% believe this because I have never had a complaint from other guests stating that we do not divulge our prices.

5. I checked in with you during your meal, and you said it was one of the best you've had. No complaints about the food or service.

6. Again, you had an opportunity to complain about your experience as you were leaving when you and I said goodbye. Instead, you repeated that it was an incredible experience and that you couldn't wait to come back.

7. Your final bill was $156.33 for an order of calamari, oysters, 2 steaks with lobster, and extra side of cole slaw, and an extra side of Brussels sprouts. You left a $20 tip, or approximately 12.5%.

I am not sure what happened between the time you left our restaurant and the time you wrote your review, but you had ample opportunity to let us know if you were dissatisfied with your experience and give us a chance to make it better. Given the vitriolic tone of reviews you have left for other businesses, including threatening legal action, I 100% dispute the voracity of your review about us. Your account of what happened is unwarranted and unfair. Considering the slanderous nature of your review, I would highly suggest that you rethink what you write on the internet about other businesses.

name: Andy Martin
text:
I used to frequent this place on a regular basis when I lived in Portland, it was one of my favorite places.

I went about eight months ago which was the first time in about a year. It was a disappointment. I got a burger which uses to be the best in the city, it was raw. The bartender never came back to ask if everything was alright so most of it was in my plate uneaten before I asked for the check, never asked if anything was wrong.

The other day my friend wanted to go there for happy hour, I was hesitant but decided to give it another chance.

The food was on point this time and the bartender was more attentive. I got the crab cakes they were excellent. My friend and I split some shrimp cocktail, we ended ordering more because they were so good.

I will say the happy hour prices were not as good as they used to be, it ended up being very expensive, but that seems to be the norm for Portland restaurants now.

resp.text:
Hi, Andy! Thankful for your thoughtful review. I am so happy to hear that we have redeemed ourselves with you. Guest feedback is important, and we listen!

Great, attentive service and quality food are the cornerstones of our restaurant - if we ever fall short, we want to know so we can make it better!

As far as Happy Hour, yup, some of the prices have increased. That is due to the increase in the quality of our craft beers and wine selection. Our oyster deals during Happy Hour remain the same, as well as our $5 Happy Hour Cosmos and Manhattans. While we don't give deep discounts on a single item during Happy Hour (ie/ some restaurants offer $1 oysters but no other specials), we try to diversify the discounts among many items so that we can accommodate all sorts of tastes.

I am so glad you gave us another shot. The next time you are in, please introduce yourself to me (my name is Justin - ask for me!) I would love to meet you, shake your hand, and personnally take care of you! Cheers!

name: Rachelle Webster
text: Very average lobster rolls.  Roll was like a cheap hotdog bun and the meat was not as tender or flavorful as one would expect.  Good crab cakes and crispy brussel sprouts.  Wait staff seemed irritated at times with our large party.  Service overall ok.

resp.text:
Hi, Rachelle, thanks for your review. I am sorry that we did not exceed your expectations this time. I don't know the difference between "average" and "very average"  but I can tell you that I believe our lobster rolls are one of the best in town. The lobster portions are prepared daily, and we do use en entire lobster for each roll. With that said, the meat is chilled, so perhaps that is where you are missing some of the tenderness. As far as the actual bun, we use Italian rolls that are baked fresh daily from Botto's Italian Bakery.

I regards to the service aspect, I assure you that your server was not irritated. We are grateful for every single guest that visits. I will definitely share your review with my staff.

Your feedback is valuable. Thank you again for taking the time to write the review and for visiting.

Hi, David! Firstly, thank you for the 2-star review - that's one more star than you gave local favorites Duckfat, Local 188, the Cookie Jar, and the Portland Museum of Art, so I guess we are doing ok. I've enjoyed reading your other reviews and would like to take a moment to share some of the highlights with our guests:

Willows Pizza & Restaurant - 1-star: "It sucks you're better off to go to Pizza Joint."

Pizza Joint -  1-star: "Do not go to Pizza Joint very very very expensive."

Amato's and Dunkin Donuts - 1-star - (I can't decide which of the DOZEN negative reviews to post here... I am just curious as to why you keep going back if you hate them so much.)

The Portland Players - 1-star: "The parking is terrible at Portland Players you may go in and when you come out the car might be gone probably been towed." (That's right - you gave a poor review to a volunteer-based community theater solely because you did not read the parking signs.)

Eastview Motel - 1-star: "Never been there." (I am at a loss for words on this one...)

Best of luck to you. I look forward to reading future reviews from you about places you may (or may not) visit.  Cheers.

And try a little of everything, even beers you might not think you’d like.

text: Awesome brewery. Second visit, did not do the tour, but they offer reasonably priced tastings, flight samplers, half pours, full pours. name: Justin Vieira
text: The allagash brewing company is a must check out while in Portland. The tour is engaging and informative without going too deep into the details as to not bore you. Additionally, being able to have tastes of the product along the tour is a nice touch that keeps you engaged the entire time. The beers are brewed with a fine attention to detail that you would come to expect. The inside tasting room is on the small side, but the outdoor patio makes up for this. Overall, if you're in the Portland area, stop in for a tour. You won't be disappointed.

text: Staff is extremely friendly and helpful. Immaculate brewery making world class beer. Well worth the visit.

name: Katie Gauthier
text: We did the beer flight sampler. The bourbon one was good, all the others were too light for me. I didn’t like how you were locked in to their choice of four flights. So I couldn’t even choose the ones I would personally like and more annoying is how you have to pay for them. We left not even finishing three of the four. Whomp whomp.

resp.text: Hi Katie, thanks for your review. We offer a preset flight, but we also now offer half pours of every beer on the menu at a reduced cost. We've also eliminated the drink cards and have introduced a "pay as you go" system that we feel will work much better for everyone. We're sorry you didn't enjoy the beers you had, but we have a lot of stronger beers if you'd like to come back and try them out!

text: My favorite brewery in Maine and a great spot to rent for a unique event.

name: IsItFridayYet
text: Great time! I took the tour with a group of people from work, it was a blast! Great information on their brewing process and company history, with samples as you go

name: Orlando Mansur, Jr.
text: Service is wonderful and beer was excellent. Great place for a beer!

name: Mary Penny
text: Awesome space, even better beer. Super reasonably priced. Not to be missed if in the area.

name: James Parker
text: What a fantastic take on Belgian beer here in the states.

name: Breezy
text:
Great brewery!  Have loved their beer for years and finally made it to the brewery.  They have a ton of drafts on tap, beer in cases, and lots of merch to choose from.  Indoor and outdoor seating.  Bars in both areas.
Can't wait to go back.

name: Kris Howes
text: My favorite beer and brewery hands down. Between Merch and beer and new releases, I don't think I've ever gone without spending under $100.  Flights are cheap and great. The tour and bottling plant is cool. Plenty of seating outside, events all the time, did I mention kickass beer? Love it.

name: Walter Bowne
text: Went once last year. Loved it. Loved the Lobster BLTs at Bite into Maine food truck. Came back again this year. Barrel and Bean is one of the most complex beers we have had. Brought a four pack home to Jersey. Wish I brought a case. Two Lights and Sixteen Counties are also excellent. Two Lights was as our gateway to Brut IPAs.

name: Sukh Sanghera
text: Fantastic tour. Fantastic beer. The guide was very engaging. Staff were very hospitable.

name: Owen DeWindt Jr.
text: Unfortunately they don't have an area to hang out and drink beer. And all the surrounding breweries do

name: Catherine Bellavance
text: Our favorite brewery! We will go back for a your. The staff was super helpful and passionate about what they do!

name: A1K9 LLC
text:
Amazing place, incredible beer & the best part is ... well behaved dogs ARE allowed on the patio! Understandably though.. Dogs are NOT allowed on tours if I remember correctly.

Highly recommend to friends and family!

name: William Horst
text: Everything there is top notch. Worth the visit

name: Ben Zimmerman
text: Ah this place is the best! Carlyle Street right now (4/18/19) is PERFECT - very cidery, wish they could brew it. Bingo was a delight, nice community and plenty of dogs.

name: Elizabeth Eubanks
text: Fantastic tour of the brewery. The guide was knowledgeable and outgoing. We tried four samples of beer and got to take as many pictures as we wanted along the way. Lots of merchandise available for sale too.

name: Harleigh Clukey
text: Great beer, great tour.

name: Marit Ivory
text: Nice brewery. All Belgian brews so avoid if you want more traditional American beer. Cash only tips.

name: Joshua Clark
text: Visited the tasting room and it was quite nice! A nice spot to sample some of their beers. They also have a cool selection of merchandise. Next time I go will definitely have to do a (free) brewery tour, but we just walked in and they were all booked for the day.

name: Tim G
text: Great place! Staff is amazing and very knowledgeable

name: Jeff
text: Beautiful property, tasty beers, fun & free tour by one of the many friendly staff members. This was our first stop in the area upon arriving in Portland, and it was also one of our favorites. The tour itself was an hour, and highlighted how beer was made as well as the history of Allagash. The prices were fair for their beers too. I would suggest scheduling your tour ahead of time. The one last star is withheld because the place closed at 6pm, which seemed early.

name: Rocco Mandaglio
text:
Nice tour and tasting room.  Great way to rate beers that you could not normally get in your market.

A piece of advice-- make a reservation for the tour online.

name: C g
text: Great place with great beer and friendly staff.

name: Rebecca whitney
text: Excellent Curbside Pickup Experience

name: b s
text: Take a tour and either come early or stay after and hang out . Had a great time and they have food truck

name: Mac Coldwell
text: I attended one of the 8 plate events and it was really fun. The trap room and the food area is all on the ground floor so it is wheelchair accessible. There trap room outdoor patio look like a great place to hang out, and I haven't had a bad beer there.

name: Valerie Margaret
text: I love their summer beers, but I wish they had 8oz cans.

resp.text: Hi Valerie, thanks very much for the kind words about our beer and tasting room. We honestly didn’t know people were on the lookout for 8 oz. beers. Thanks very much for taking the time to let us know, and we’ll definitely think about offering that can size in the future.

name: Dale Schultz
text: Interesting tour with beer at 4 stages of the tour.

name: Rebecca Lanefski
text: The staff was friendly, and the beers are great. The seating is a little rickety/crowded.

name: MARK MULLICAN
text: Great brewery, great atmosphere. Belgian beer done right in the U.S.

name: James Bacon
text: Was one of the best brewery tours I've been on. Super friendly and informative staff. Looks like they treat people really well. We had Hannah as our guide, and she was a great mix of information, stories, and positive energy - too bad it was her last tour before moving back to Paris. Beers were tasty too.

name: Chris Saccardi
text: Such a fun place to visit!! The beer is free, people are friendly, there's always a great food truck, the tours a fun (if you can get in - be sure to reserve ahead of time), and they even have free juice boxes for the kids. Oh, and the beer is amazing, especially the unusual ones you can only get at the brewery.

name: Daniel Coes
text: It's easy to get overloaded on delicious IPAs in Portland, which makes Allagash a welcome counterpoint as they feature many different styles of beer. Always a great experience.

name: Daniel DeNinno
text: Allagash never lets me down. The beer is phenomenal, the space is amazing, tours are so cool, you can't go wrong with these guys. This is the pinnacle of all craft brewing. This is it.

name: just Doughty
text: Tour was fun, staff was knowledgeable and open to questions. The beer is quite good, and different from other beers in the area. Atmosphere is good. Prices are high, but honestly the beer is good so it's alright. Lines alsoove quite quickly.

name: Tim
text: Spacious tasting room with many beers available. Great tacos at the food truck.

name: Trevor Chenoweth
text:
Great tour with a fair amount of tastings of their specialty offerings. The barrel room for wild and sour beers was especially cool. Super friendly tour guides who seemed to really care.

Sole problem: they're only licensed as a "tasting room"  so we couldn't hang out and drink at the bar afterward.

name: Ben Lord
text: Such an impressive brewery! Consistency, quality, nice people, and an incredible commitment to the region! Sour beer! a campus of wonderful, craft beer! So cool, such an incredible treasure!

name: Chris Seewald
text: Awesome experience taking the tour. Great beer and our tour guide Leah could not have been better. Definitely will be recommending to anyone visiting the area.

name: Matt C
text: Some of the best Belgian inspired beers in the country.  free tour (make sure you reserve a spot online) wonderful gift shop and tasting room. Insanely friendly staff.

name: Seth Lockman
text: Great beer, great service. I do wish they had 8oz cans tho

resp.text: Hey Seth, thanks very much for the kind words about our beer and tasting room. We honestly didn’t know people were on the lookout for 8 oz. beers. Thanks very much for taking the time to let us know, and we’ll definitely think about offering that can size in the future.

name: Keith Johnson
text: Great Belgian inspired beers.  Barrel-aged and sours are especially good.

name: R Wu
text: Make sure you come for the tour and book it well in advance. You get their rotational pours on the tour and there's always refills. Plus, it was a great learning experience if you've never heard about brewing. James bean, buddy. Delightful.

name: Tiffanie Taylor
text: Fantastically awesome. Plus there was dogs every where which makes them even better.

name: Mark Boutilier
text: Stopped by last night with family from away and missed the last tasting pour by five minutes.  We decided to still go into the store for some swag and to pick up some of the delicious One T.  We were met at the door by an Allagash employee with a cold four pack of Allagash White at no charge and an apology that we couldn't enjoy their beer from the tap.  Now my Connecticut family want to know how come everybody is so friendly in Maine . . . . and they brew such great beer!   Kudos Allagashers!

name: Nick
text: Love the beer but their website is not updated with what they actually have in stock. Came looking for Nancy and Uncommon Crow and they were completely out. Pretty disappointing

name: Rhonda Baumann
text: Not really thrilled with brewery. Over-hyped. Crazy crowded and not a fan of any of the beers on the flight. The food truck Bite of Maine on the other hand deserves 5 stars.

resp.text: Hi Rhonda, thanks for the review. We do get more crowded in summer, as do most other spots in Maine, but we're sorry to hear that you weren't a fan of the beers on the flight. We usually have 17 beers on tap and we hope you make a return trip to find other beers that might suit you. We're always happy to provide some guidance based on your tastes. And we agree that Bite Into Maine deserves five stars!

name: Heather Peatman
text: I've never visited the city, but it's on my to-do list when I am in the area. This is the brew that made me like beers. I had it all over Maine and now it's come to my home state of Vermont. I'd love to do a tour!

name: Allen Adams
text: Love Alagash, but not what I thought.  Still a great beer company though.

name: Devon Rauth
text: One of the best breweries with some of the best brews around, I've yet to have anything but a good time here!

name: Marguerite Sullivan
text: Love it here.  Great atmosphere, service and beer.  You must visit when in Portland.

name: Nick Roberts
text: We came on a brewery tour as a group of 10 and the service and knowledge of staff was incredible. If you're in Portland and looking for another brewery to add to your brew tour, this is a definite. Allagash white gets my thumbs up.

name: Michael Picher
text: Large scale operation. Good beer (natch). Wish they  had Four...

name: Michael S
text:
Great place for tasting all types of Allagash brews.

Indoor & outdoor tasting rooms and always a food truck on site.

Friendly & clean.

name: Rob Neuhaus
text: Surprise, surprise, Rob rates another brewery 5 stars.  Allagash is a great brewery, I love their tripel, and they make the best white that I've had.  I wish they should beer for consumption at the brewery, but the free tasting and tour is awesome.  Though you might need to schedule your tour days in advance.

name: Rebecca Masterjohn-Gowell
text: Such a great place to visit anytime of the year. The beer is delicious, the environment is comfortable and visually  pleasing and staff are always friendly and welcoming. A must visit place for anyone new in town

name: Connor Capizzano
text: Allagash provides a quality tour of their facility that is both fun and interesting. The tour guides and bartenders were awesome. Cannot complain with a free tasting either!

name: Kit Wang
text: Great beer, knowledgeable and friendly staff. Excellent swag.

name: Sam Erde
text: Great beer for all tastes. Beautiful tasting room, beer garden, and retail shop. Free tours and samples.

name: Peter Proach
text: Great vibe, awesome beers. Can't wait to go back!

name: Courtney Smith
text: One of the best brewery tours I’ve ever been on! Very informative for a beer nerd like me!

name: Corey Bradford
text: Took the tour and did a tasting. The tour is well orchestrated with headsets for easy listening to the guide. You get to see all of the workings of the brewery, including their sours section and barrels.  Cool, new tasting room, although I would've liked to see a few more things on tap (there were only 4), especially some experimental brews perhaps.

name: BitX BreDrin
text: Cool brewery, welcoming atmosphere

name: Ian Gillespie
text: Great beers and Chris was a great tour guide!

name: BENCHIE'S BARNYARD
text: The tour was very informative.. The beer was great. Stop here and take it all in .. You'll be glad you did..

name: Nicole D
text: Nice patio, nice people and dogs are welcome 👍 Great beer too

name: Justin Webster
text: Fantastic brewery. Friendly staff, tasty beer and great atmosphere.

name: Ira Moss
text: Great beer 🍺, and very fun and informative tour!!

name: Jessica
text: Great atmosphere and tour

name: Julie C
text: Amazing beer, friendly staff, awesome ambiance with outdoor section, beers are very affordable as well

name: Linda Dyer
text: I love going to Allagash Brewing Co.  The staff is super chill and nice.  Plus you get to try some pretty unique beers.

name: Ride Hard
text: Great tour and presentation of a local Maine brewery! The tastings dont hurt either!

name: C Bas
text: My favorite American witbier. Great place to visit if you are in Portland.

name: kathy michaud
text: Clean, need more toilets, good products, good atmosphere, loud

resp.text: Hi Kathy, thanks for your review! We did have a super busy day yesterday and things do get a bit louder than usual on those days. We also have quite a few porta-johns near the outside patio available on busy weekends to alleviate the bathroom situation, so please let us know if you have any issues in the future and we'll make sure you're satisfied.

name: Tom Provencal
text: Good beer, clean, great place to get a flute of samplers and support a local brewery!

name: Ken Alden
text: Still THE classic brewery in beer park. Pity that they charg now for a flight, but we all knew that wouldn't last...

name: Nancy Lacroix-Britton
text: Fantastic!

name: Ryan Fortman
text: Great beer flights

name: Eric Mulvihill
text: Good tour. Tasty beer.

name: Sage Naka
text: Great Beer!

name: Brendan O'Brien
text: Best brewery tour experience in Maine. START HERE!

name: Chris Pesotski
text: Always amazing beer and a fun, informative tour

name: Kelly Green
text: Nice experience!

name: Andrew M. Robitaille
text: Delicious brew, awesome people, and a great tasting room.

name: Cooper Fauvelle
text: Great tour, great beer!

name: Patti Mattson
text: Best. Brewery. Ever.

name: Pat Simpson
text: Brewery Tour was Very Cool, and the samples were great

name: Mike Gregory
text: Unfortunate flight cost money now... Great tour though!

resp.text: Hi Mgiii, thanks for chiming in! Our flights for those on tour continue to be free; were you able to take the tour recently? For those on tour, we only charge for additional pours. For those who don't take the tour, we have decided to implement a small charge for flights and pours due to the significant increase in volume of visitors we've had in the last few years. We've also taken the opportunity to expand the selection of beers we've made available on draft in the tasting room, largely due to customer requests. We hope you return to try some of these additional options!

name: Chris Wirth
text: The free tour was a great learning experience.

name: ronald miller
text: If you go here the warhouse is just west of Riverside on warren ave turn right first Street go to back whs

name: louis masi
text: Great atmosphere, quality beer, happy customers!

name: Gerry Doyon
text: Great tour, great beer--win!

name: Mark LoGiurato
text: Very good beer!  Worth the visit!

name: Parker Roberts
text: Great people and beer.

name: David Kennedy
text: Great tasting experience

name: David Prentiss
text: I don't understand how it could be so popular you can't even go inside.

name: Val Slobodyan
text: Allagash White is something special.

name: Matthew Campbell
text: Beer!

name: J Clar
text: Its illegal to give free alcohol last I knew

resp.text: Hi J Clar, we possess a license which grants us the legal right to provide free samples to our visitors, provided they are of legal drinking age. We take this issue seriously and would never consider acting out of compliance with Maine law. If you would like to discuss this issue in person, feel free to stop in whenever you'd like and we can explain our policy in detail.

name: andrew fairbairn
text: Happiest place on earth!

name: Timmy Whitman
text: Free flights!!!

name: Kyle Newton
text: Free tasting, what's not to love

name: Alex Funicello-Paul
text: Everyone is friendly and the beer is free!

name: Stephen Goss
text: Fun place to visit!

name: j.p. connolly
text: A free flight with Fluxus?!

name: Jacob Mulligan
text: Beer tasting is free!

name: David Nowell
text: good brewery tour.

name: Jean-pierre Drouin
text:
(Translated by Google) A must in Portland!

(Original)
Un incontournable à Portland !

resp.text:
(Translated by Google) Thank you so much!

Merci beaucoup!

text:
(Translated by Google) Excellent
