resp.text:
Inna,
Thanks for visiting us and your positive review! We are sorry that you didn't love your lobster roll--we do serve our roll "Maine style" with lightly dressed chilled lobster meat. While that's the most common preparation in Maine (versus Connecticut style with warm butter) we are going to update our menu to make sure customers are aware of which style we serve. Thanks again for your business.

name: Amanda Johnson
text: So delicious and amazing service. I can't wait to go back!

resp.text: Thank you!  We will be here!

name: Zachary Patterson
text: Don’t be late! If you arrive at 9:45 and your waitress gets to your table at 9:46 don’t expect to get dinner. Horrible experience, greeted by an overly rude waitress that said the kitchen closed one minute show. She offered to ask the restaurant next door if they would serve us food instead of going to ask the kitchen if they could do fries at 9:47 at night. If you are in Old Port, avoid this place at all costs! Do yourself a favor and head to Mash Tun for a better vibe, better food, and better staff.

resp.text:
Zach,

Not sure if this is a negative review or an advertisement for a neighboring bar? I'll assume it's a review for purposes of this response. Look, we shut down our kitchen every night and we have to decide what time that occurs. We could have shut it down at 10pm and you might have come in at 10:01. I get that you were angry that you missed the cut-off by 1 minute but that happens every night at every establishment. At some point restaurants have to tell customers that the kitchen is closed. I think the real issue here is your perception of discrete time intensity. The number of time measurements between two points is infinite, and clearly you viewed the time between 9:45 and 9:46 as such instead of two discrete points that don't share the same value set. Without being too nuanced I would highly recommend reading "Discrete-Time Signal Processing" by Alan V. Oppenheim, Ronald W. Schafer. It's available online and you probably want to buy an extra copy. After I read it, I wanted to lend one out to my friends!

On another note, it might be a good thing you didn't eat fries that late at night. Based on your review and reaction to our kitchen being closed...well, I'm not a doctor, but that may be signs of hypertension: irritability, quickness to anger and a need for retaliation. So, hey, you may want to check that out!

As far as the rest of your "review/advertisement"--we get it. given the fact that you didn't order any drinks or food or even stay, I think that invalidates any commentary on our food or drink. As far as our staff, our waitress offered to check with nearby establishments to see if they were still cooking food--we see that as a positive customer service endeavor that you somehow twisted into a negative? It sounds like you ended up down the street at a nearby bar.  You like them better. You wrote them a 5 star review the same time you wrote our 1 star.  We view all of the food and beverage establishments on Wharf St as part of the same community, destination and neighborhood. You don't have to like them all--or even any of them. We go to your "favorite bar" too. I'm glad you had a great experience there, and it's unfortunate you didn't get a chance to actually experience our food, beverage or service program. Maybe, before you publicly blast a business, you actually make it a point to come during regular kitchen hours, order something and actually have a customer experience.

name: Stefanie Wozniak
text: Pricey cocktails but excellent product. Cheese board was generous and worth the price! Bourbon sangria was top notch and service was very friendly.

name: Kate Castonguay
text: I had the bourbon sangria which may have been a special. Food was limited so I didn't eat there. I'm giving this 4/5 because while draft cocktails are some kind of wonderful it takes away from the creativity and wonder of an amazing bartender. However their cocktails are not all on draft. It's w cool thing if you're in a hurry to get your drink on.

name: Jeff Slaton
text: Awesome place to meet up with friends. Great atmosphere and service.

name: Joseph Howard
text: Easily the best whisky selection anywhere in the state, with elegant small plates at a reasonable price and clever takes on classic cocktails.

name: Andrew Shortill
text: I am not a "bar" kind of guy. This place was pretty much perfect. It's not too big but not cramped either. It's also not too loud and I did not have to shout to have a pleasant conversation with someone next to me. The bar stuff was knowledgeable and friendly, but also knew when to leave us alone so we could enjoy our drinks and company. We had burgers and fries, both of which were very good. I like that it is a bar with some food and not a restaurant with some alcohol. Finally, I went for the whiskey. I have a fairly advanced whiskey pallette and I found drams from all over the world and from less than $10 to over $130. They had bottles I'd never heard of and many I had. This is a place I will return to.

name: Dustin Bonk
text: Best veggie burger I've ever had! Great atmosphere inside and outside.

name: Garrett Grasshoff
text: Cool atmosphere and delicious food. My wife and I really enjoyed the lobster roll and the independent burger. Oh and the fries are really good! Would definitely recommend!

name: Matthew Calder
text: Had the Rooster. Was really good. Wish it had a little more kick. Frozen Margarita was delicious! Fries were great! Ate outside on a beautiful warm afternoon. Would definitely go back! Staff was great! Wanted to try pimento and cheese but they were out. Will be back to try it.

name: Molly Bryant Roberts
text:
loved the adherence to covid-19 requirements. it means a lot to us, as locals, to see establishments respecting local ordinances.

beyond that, the drinks were outstanding! we tried the on-tap manhattan and sangria. both were delicious and a good value.

we look forward to going again SOON!

name: Nickki T
text: Great atmosphere! Great drinks and friendly bartenders who are very easy to converse with. I'm only giving 4 out of 5 stars because we only had drinks and didn't try out their food menu. Maybe next time we will eat instead of drink. Lol. Will give a review when this happens.

name: Sean Banks
text: The food was very good. It was a fairly small menu but what they did was top notch. The drinks were good. Fine selection and great atmosphere. Our server was probably one of the best I've ever had. Fantastic service. Really no criticisms I can think of!

name: Rachael Mack
text: The bar setting and drinks are great - upscale and intimate. The food was on par with what I'd expect for a downtown location. We had the charcuterie, chicken Caesar salad, and fries and had no complaints. Just wish there were a few more options, especially on the appetizer side.

name: Kira MacDougall
text: Great frozen drinks and kale and arugula salad!

name: Noah Dew
text:
Gary is the best. Excellent whiskey bar. Solid beer list. Food is beautiful. A must in Portland.

***Update***

Had wedding after party here. Phenomenal! Be sure to ask them about hosting events, their service is over the top! Thank you for so many wonderful times!

name: Benjamin Downs
text: Excellent drinks and food. Great atmosphere. Recommend highly. Try the smoked Manhattan. You won't be disappointed.

name: Douglas Leonard
text: Nice place, get the Irish coffee.

name: Celia Mawhinney
text: Kristal was very friendly and knowledgeable.  She also made the best Old Fashioned I've ever had. We were sad to learn this is her last week there. However, we will be back.

name: Bt Schwartz
text: On a cold day there was nothing better than a warmed Old-fashioned and spicy fries. Highly recommended

name: Will Akin
text: This is one of my favorite, go-to bars in downtown Portland. They have an impressive collection of whiskeys in addition to signature whiskey-based cocktails (e.g., a chocolate bourbon martini!). They also serve food to order; I wouldn’t call it a full-service kitchen, but the menu will definitely fill you up - not to mention it’s absolutely delicious. I recommend  visiting to anyone who will listen.

resp.text:
Will,

Thank your being our customer and leaving this nice review.  Our menu is indeed focused, not overly broad, but are derived from the freshest ingredients brought in daily and in many cases sourced right here in Maine.  We take as much pride in our fresh food as we do our Whiskey.  See you again soon!

name: Richard Abbondanza
text: Amazing selection of bourbons and ryes. Food was very good. Great staff.

name: L B
text: Friendly service. They were very busy but staff made sure to check in on us. I had a burger and it was delicious. They're cocktails were yummy and creative as well. Highly recommend.

name: Benjamin Crocker
text: Dark candlelit atmosphere. Cozy and warm; perfect for date night. The meatloaf sliders are delicious. I've been waiting to visit since I saw that a new restaurant was coming to the location. It did not disappoint!

name: Adrian Kessler
text: Extremely knowledgeable staff. The apple cider mule is unbelievable. They have knob creek as the base. Soo good.

name: Christine Baptista
text: Great drinks ambiance and wonderful, simple menu offerings. Plentiful portions and they have a really great patio seating area which is fun for people watching.

resp.text: Christine, Thank you so much for taking the time to write this kind review.  We look forward to seeing you again soon.

name: Daniel Laskey
text: Great whiskey recommendation by waiter

name: marco litalien
text: Great whiskey selection and service

name: Charles Foss
text: Beautiful bar. Great ambience. Unnecessarily expensive. Short pours on beer.

resp.text:
Charles,

Thanks for giving the Independent Ice Company a try. We are sorry you were disappointed with our beer pricing and pours, but we were a bit surprised by your comments. Except for Guinness and Allagash White all of our Maine Craft Beers on draft are served in a 13oz libby glass which isn't considered a "short pour".  (The Allagash and Guinness beers are served in a 16oz pint).  Additional our beer prices are well in line with other establishments and the market overall and during happy hour from 4-6 all draft beers are only $5.

If you want to provide more specific feedback to help us improve our operation please feel free to email me directly at Larry@Independentice.com

name: joel simons
text: A Fantastic Whisk(e)y bar. Intimate atmosphere and great fries. Went there for my birthday party.

name: francis figueroa
text: Great selection and awesome selection of whiskey

name: Sarah Dee
text: Yummy drinks!! Very upscale. The owners were very friendly and down to earth.

resp.text: Sarah,   Thank you for coming in and taking the time to post this review.  We greatly appreciate the business and look forward to seeing you again soon.

name: Hal Incandenza
text: Awesome whiskey selection. Friendly staff and cool atmosphere. Food is good too.

name: Scott Payson
text: Ridiculously great selection of top-shelf whiskeys and awesome, knowledgeable service.

name: A. K. Jones
text: Alex the bartender was awesome. And the food was delish.

name: Denise Hodgkins
text: Amazing food,  fantastic atmosphere....the staff was the best they make you want to hang out all night!  Did a flight of Maine whiskeys and found a new favorite.  It's going to be a regular place for us...

name: Rick Vizcarra
text: Good selection

name: Jim Wallace
text: Comfortable, but classy, bar. Attractive bience and decor.

resp.text: Thank you Jim for the kind review   Hope to see you again soon !

name: Jeff H
text: Don't have all whiskey/whisky but what they do have is excellent. Be sure to ask how the name of the bar came about.

resp.text: Jeff, Thank you for your review.  Since Maine is a controlled liquor state it is common that some of the liquors people may see out of state are just not available in the State of Maine.  Was there something in particular  you'd like to see us carry?  If it's available in Maine we can certainly add it to our next list.

name: Zach Houdek
text: Stumbled upon this Old Port restaurant on a Saturday night, and we couldn't be more pleased with the experience. It really is an experience. From the moment you walk in the door, you are welcomed by a staff that makes you feel as if you are a regular. The whiskey and bourbon wall is immaculate for even the most selective, while craft beer drinkers have an appropriate selection. We ordered the cutting board (charcuterie), split a burger and side of fries. Gary, who recommended the cutting board, did state it was the best charcuterie board in Portland... Hard for us to argue that one. Burger.. we'd vote the best in Portland when compared to the handful we've had in the city. Atmosphere 5 stars. Service 5+ stars. Food 5 stars. We have been transplanted to Portland for the past 3 months, and I can tell you that we will certainly be back with some friends and family when they visit.

resp.text:
Zach,
Thank you so much for this glowing review.  We are so pleased to serve our local community and the many visitors of our great city.  It is our focus to deliver an outstanding experience that goes far beyond just amazing drinks and fresh food.  To your point it is the total picture that we are aiming for and are most proud of our staff for sharing these beliefs, naturally and with pleasure!  Thank you so much for taking the time to write this review with such detail. We are humbled and greatly appreciate your business.  We looking forward to seeing you again real soon.

name: Dylan Agosta
text: I don't really drink, but this place has a great atmosphere (and cool ice!)

name: Andrew Berdell
text: Nice place missing a few key whisky's and scotch's other then that pretty nifty

name: Doug Lauver
text: Great whiskey bar in old Port! 👍

resp.text: Thank you Doug for being our customer.  We look forward to seeing you again soon.

name: Mike B
text: Great selection of beers and spirits. Warm and cosy but make sure you hang your coat on the coat rail!

name: Bettina Pearson
text: Classy, extensive inventory and priced as such. Great event space too.

name: David Carr
text: Great spot for cocktails and craft beer, management is very hands-on and working to improve the area.

name: Robert Guy
text: Great shaved steak and bourbon sangria

name: Jerry close
text: The decor is very nice. The whiskey list is above average hut average for a whiskey bar. The house cocktails were uninspired.

name: Allyson Wyand
text: The fries are delicious and they have great happy hour deals!

resp.text: Thank you Allyson for visiting and trying our menu. We are very proud of our food offering and take great pride in turning those Fresh Maine Potatoes into our delicious fries with dipping sauces.  Never frozen and always cooked to order for our customers!

name: Joel Sherman
text: Good drinks. Good location

name: tom hedge
text: Best bourbon selection in Portland.

name: Vantiel Elizabeth Duncan
text: Rosemary sour is so yummy!

name: Kathy Sylvia
text: Menu was lite

name: Anthony Stohlberg
text: Great atmosphere. Awesome taste in music. Food impeccable. Only small complaint, the ice was too cold. Must have been below freezing?! Easily overlooked for the great service. 100% would recommend.

resp.text: Mr. Demly- we cannot locate you in any of our databases nor our Maine CDC contact tracing log.  We don't have any record of you ever visiting us or being a customer of ours.  Additionally you provided the same one star review to our other restaurant at the same exact time, where we also could not locate you. We have to assume this was an accident.  Thank you in advance

name: Jess O'Brien
text: Such a beautiful and creative place. Warm and inviting, Fiber and Vine is the perfect place to practice your craft or learn a completely new skill. I highly recommend this establishment for all your knitting, crocheting, and felting notions. The extensive and carefully curated wine selection is impressive too. Check out the variety of intimately sized classes they offer from local and visiting fiber artists - you will not be disappointed.

name: Susan Estes
text: Great selection of fine wines, yarn and other items.  Owner has a great personality and helps you find exactly what you are looking for. Thank you for the assistance. I certainly will return and shop here!

name: Kimberly Carnello
text: I've always wanted to learn to learn to knit in now I have a one-on-one couple of sessions with great a teacher! They have a fantastic selection of all types of fibers and wine. They also offer many different classes.

name: Suzette Moulton
text: Kim is a wonderful teacher and so very creative. She makes everyone feel welcome and gently encourages them to bringout their inner creativity

resp.text: Thanks Suzette! Great to see you!

name: Katie Meyer
text: Lovely store, friendly staff, beautiful yarns!

name: Laurie Ellis
text: This is NOT just any knitting store! Although the materials are first class (wool batts of many, and some rare breeds of sheep, knitting supplies (amazing hand died skeins), spinning supplies....the wonderful aspect of this place is it's knowledgeable staff, it's classes and most of all, the fact that it's fast becoming a locus for a creative community of all kinds of fiber artists, both beginner and accomplished. And the wine! WHAT better combination of joys could there be? :-D

name: Marigrace O'Brien
text: Love the people who work at F&V! Helpful and patient. Great when asked about recommendations and technical questions! Keep it up!

name: betty hayes
text: Love, love, love this yarn and wine shop. Best staff and great products

name: Carol Pesti
text: Beautiful handcrafted wares!

name: RenaeIsa Toadkisser
text: Beautiful place. You feel welcomed and at home the second you walk in.

resp.text: Thanks for visiting Renee! (And also for your kind review.) Hope to see you again soon.

name: Gina Harlow
text: Nice selection of yarn and wine.  It's so great that classes are also offered here.

name: Traci Schilling
text: Lovely shop, helpful and friendly staff

name: Marcia Mitchell
text: Love Fiber & Vine! Great yarn choices, interesting patterns and phenomenal customer service. And a great selection of wines, especially Pinot Noirs.

name: shellie leger
text: Exotic wines and lovely yarns.

name: Bruce Little
text: Thank you, Kim and friends. Advice and selections always spot on!

name: Christa Langbehn
text: Knowledgeable staff, quality products and a fun environment, they even host wine tastings occasionally!

name: Scott Berk
text: Situated in a beautifully restored historic building, Fiber & Vine has one of the best boutique selections of wine in Maine, and a wonderful selection of local fiber and quality yarns. Many different classes are available as well.

name: Rachel Gutekunst
text: Kim is wonderful.

name: Brian Brinegar
text: Great store, wonderful staff!

name: A. Sheehan
text: Good selection

name: Sandi R.
text:
Really kewl atmosphere. As I sat drinking my coffee with my friend Gaby, the aromas of some wonderful smelling food permeated the space. I couldn't decide what to order.
I decided on a bagel with cream cheese, avocado and lox ... I thought a bit pricey until I saw it loaded with lox❗I could only eat a quarter of it at a time ... it was Devine❗❗💯
In this photo I had already picked off several pieces of lox as it was to high for me to bite❗🍴🍔

name: E Robinson
text: So much nicer since the new owner upgraded the shop.  I had a toasted sesame bagel with cream cheese, avocado and lots of smoked salmon for lunch - it was scrumptious!  Highly recommended.

name: Geoff K
text: Excellent coffee; clean, safe & conscientious environment; pleasant place to enjoy a cup-o in Brunswick. Baked goods looked amazing!

name: Amber Pepin
text: Great place things are clearly labeled lots of vegan options great coffee selection!

name: Camerashy
text: Stopped in Brunswick on a drive this afternoon and wanted to grab coffee here. Haven't been to little dog in ages and glad they haven't changed quaint on the outside and in lots of open seating but don't forget to bring your mask. Prices are not out of this world either and little dog makes a great cup of joe

name: Jennifer
text: It was ok. Good place to get coffee.

name: Christopher Gurney
text: I love this place it's a cool relaxing area and they have nice menu I got a peach mango smoothie and yes u can mix the smoothie flavors so again it's a nice area to just relax as long as you have your mask.

name: Robert Daffin
text: My first time here and it was great. Friendly staff and nice customers . Nice  spot for a Bagel and coffee

name: Amy Monahan
text: First time visit today. Had a slice of the Southwest quiche. It was delicious and a very good sized portion. I would have given it 5 stars but we had to send it back once to warm it all the way through. Otherwise everything was good! I will visit again.

name: Amanda Greenlaw
text: Never had a bad cup of coffee out of there.

name: Helen Forgrave
text: Coffee was great and the food was good. Employees were very friendly and kind.

name: Lisa Lane
text: Lovely spot with a sunny sidewalk area with tables. The Little Dog blend coffee was very nice and I usually give for the darkest coffee. This coffee was smooth and roasty and a little sweet,and I drink it black! Enjoyed my breakfast sandwich. The egg was fluffy,and the service was very polite.

name: Jay Seiler
text:
The Little Dog is great!  Very good place to sit and use the laptop or just read the paper and have coffee and a bagel.  They serve Coffee By Design which is an excellent local roaster.  Recently they underwent a renovation and though the service area is definitely improved I miss the couch and chairs.  It's still a great spot in Brunswick.  Highly recommend.

UPDATE:  Maybe I missed them last time I was in but I went into The Dog recently and the couch and chairs had returned!  Yay! Excellent Coffee shop.

name: Nancy Briand
text: Quick service and great iced Chai tea

name: Amanda Goodall
text: Best of the best of the best of Maine. Period. A must visit. One of my fav places to grab a coffee and hang or work for a bit. Friendly staff and a great selection of drinks and food and events too!

name: Shawn Butler
text: Pretty cool little spot. Coffee was good and the brownie was well very chocolatey... Others loved just too much for me.

name: Jonathan Miles
text: Really good coffee and cocoa

name: Butch Dawbin
text: Excellent place to meet with friends to catch up on life and have a few pastries.   Quality service, quality location.

name: Off The Boat
text: They have the best vegan breakfast burrito! Even if they don't have any made or missing an ingredient they will still make it if you want. Love the art they have there as well.

name: Ben Gross
text:
Super tasty baked goods,  possibly the best home made veggie cream cheese in the galaxy, and really fresh foods make this place a must stop in Brunswick. That's even before you get to the staff and place itself!

Very kind and patient staff, plus a fun setup up. I really like the environmental concern in the offerings too!

name: Carolee Harper
text: Super coffee shop.

name: steve stockford
text: 1st rate coffees and pastries. Nice couches. Relaxed atmosphere.

name: Stacey Mcmahan
text: Good ,fresh food! Mostly sandwiches. I had quiche and tried one of their very giant homemade oatmeal cookies. Really tasty . Very college ,urban coffee house oriented. Fun place!

name: Brandon Goding
text: I enjoy the drinks, and baked goods.  Sometimes the wait can be a little long, but the crew is always working quickly to get you your order inspite if the backlog.

name: PatriciaRileySmith BalancedLifestyleSolutions
text: The service was good but a little bit slow for only one drink that needed to be prepared, they had a good selection of self serve coffee but we're out of more than half of them.  Cute environment with decent amount of tables and a few food options.

name: Tyler LeBlanc
text:
The coffee is great, the food on the other hand is not worth what is being charged. For two coffees and two breakfast sandwiches our bill was 26 dollars. The sandwiches weren't bad, I mean they we're better than something you could get at McDonald's, but you can definitely find better food around for this price.

In response to the owner reply: yes I did get some extra tomatoes on the sandwich that were not actually put on said sandwich, I was saying that your cafe is better than the typical  morning food joint. Our coffees were 16oz so around 5 a piece  with tax. But thanks for the well wishes!

resp.text: Hi Tyler, sorry you didn't like the food.  By the price, looks like you got them both loaded with extras, which gets pricy.  Can't imagine why you paid $26 for two sandwiches and two coffees, unless they were larger espresso drinks.  Never had someone compare our food to MacDonalds, though.  You are the first.  Better luck with the next place. Paul

name: Katy Petrie
text: Such a cute place. The face lift has made it modern and efficient. The staff is friendly and the coffee is delicious.

name: Halsey Payne
text: So you walk in, and it's an empty room with a miniature poodle in the middle and a mug of coffee at the far end. It's pretty straightforward, unlike these new-fangled coffee stores with the fancy drinks. The dog is mean, but as advertised it's little, so it's not hard to get past the tiny fella. Once you circumvent the pooch, you leave a few bucks and take the mug. Easy. The coffee's alright, too.

name: Deb Krieger
text: Miss the cinnamon rolls and hummus. Really need to rethink the menu. New decor isn't bad but not as homey as it was.

name: c sterling
text: havent been in sometime. the renovations look great!

name: Jeremy Hawkins
text: Friendly staff, good food, great coffee, and a perfect place to meet a friend.

name: Benjamin Bernier
text:
The staff earned the stars as they were friendly and polite but the espresso tasted burnt and overly bitter to me.  Maybe it was just my palate.

Edit 4/18/19: A friendly reply from the Little Dog Team about recent evaluation and an unexpected apology has convinced me to visit back in the future

resp.text: Hi Benjamin, thanks for stopping by! We're sorry your espresso was bitter. We're always appreciative of feedback---always striving to improve. Last week our staff attended a conference for continued education, and we recently underwent a barista evaluation from Coffee By Design. Hope you'll stop in again!

name: Andy Winslow
text: Good food and drinks, nice people. Good location with lots of parking in the rear. Newly renovated.

resp.text: Hi Andy, we're sorry that your experience was less than stellar. We're really excited about our upcoming renovations--including a freshly redesigned interior and a self-checkout POS to help alleviate those long lines/free up staff members. Hope you'll be back!

name: Dave Vendetti
text: Never have I felt a more uncomfortable feeling then when I walked into this place. My family and I stopped in for coffee and it was like I was on the set of a new "hipster's only" sitcom. The looks from the other customers and a woman in her mid 40's (behind the counter, dark hair) were less then inviting, like as if we were lost and they were confused on why we were there. Did not feel welcomed in any way shape or form. We will not be going back.

resp.text: Hi Dave, so sorry it's taken me so long to respond.  If you ever want to share your experience with me, please come in and ask to speak with me.  Paul

name: Thomas Whittingham
text: Great place to relax and enjoy a cup of coffee and or a pastry

name: mark diterlizzi
text: The cappuccino was very good and the place had a comfortable atmosphere

name: Valerie Flanagan
text: Cafe... Awkward seating, open kitchen area, few work stations.

name: Anita Alef
text: Open Mic tonight was a great time second Thursday of every month

name: eddie carliell
text: Between my girlfriend and I were here daily. Never had an issue, they even secured a pair of expensive  sunglasses for my girlfriend when she left them there. It's usually pretty busy but they handle the rush smoothly and get orders correct.

name: Lynne Holland
text: The usual slow service,  3 people ahead of me= 15 minute wait.  The drinks are well made though.

name: David Knowland
text: Decided to stop by Brunswick after a nice walk at Bradbury. Stopped in here for some hot cocoa. Man o man, definitely go for the mint if you're here... definitely some of the best hot cocoa around!

resp.text: Hi David, we're glad you stopped in.  Thanks for taking some time to let us know how your time here was.  Paul

name: BirthME Maine's premier doula service
text: Love the new decor and the self serve coffe kiosk is life changing!

name: Scott Anderson
text: Great little coffee shop, great coffee, great atmosphere with a very friendly staff.  Will definitely return.

resp.text: Hi Scott, thanks for taking the time to write a review! In case you haven't heard, we're now open late on Thursdays for our Late Night Lit series, 7-9pm.

name: Cole Crawford
text: Not a fan of this place. Always too crowded and overpriced. Not good for meeting people nor doing work.

name: Erin Vandine
text: Oh. My. God. Soooooooo good - food & service is exceptional! Highly highly recommend!!

name: Robert Bisson
text: A great place for coffee and spirits.

resp.text: Hi Robert, thanks for the review.  You have so many options in Brunswick these days.  We really appreciate you choosing the Little Dog.  Paul

name: Travis Landry
text: This is a great spot to get coffee!

name: J Knox
text: I don't know why I haven't tried this place before but now that I have I'll definitely be back (I have to try all the quiches after all). There is plenty of seating inside including a few couches. All the staff that I encountered were very nice and eager to help with any questions. The coffee is Coffee by Design.

name: Mark Rafferty
text: I love going here whenever I'm in Brunswick, ME. Cool place with good coffee and treats.

name: Jean-Marie Haas
text: Nice variety of beverages & treats; found the staff personable. Seems to be a popular hangout for the college crowd as ALL the seating was occupied by young people with the computers and textbooks. Luckily, it was a warm day and we found a bench up the block where we could enjoy our coffees.

resp.text: Hi Jean-Marie, thanks for your nice comments.  Our tables and chairs are outside now, with umbrellas soon to follow, so, hopefully that will help the next time you come in.  Either way, thanks for taking the time to let  us hear your thoughts on the shop.  Paul

name: Apollo Orlando
text: Sitting here with my coffee and muffin makes me ponder why anyone would go to Starbucks. The experience here makes the coffee taste better. I want to stay here when I finish my coffee. I just want sit here and relax. The coffee and food are excellent  by the way

name: Brogan Teel
text: Love the food and drinks! Super friendly staff, too. Always busy!

resp.text: Hi Brogan, thanks so much for coming in & for taking the time to write a review! Hope to see you again soon. -Meg

name: M T
text: Coffee is delicious. I appreciate that they offer a selection of gluten-free baked goods. They keep the music in the shop at a low volume, which is nice. Staff are friendly and helpful.

resp.text:
Hey Matt,
Thanks for the nice words and for coming in.  This kind of response to what we do makes a tremendous difference to all of us who work here.  Paul H.

name: Dean Emmerson
text: Always excellent. Great coffee and food. Comfortable space with interesting artwork displayed. The owner and staff are tops.

resp.text: Hey Dean, sorry it's taken so long to reply.  I remember this day, though, and we were slammed.  We really appreciated your patience that day and for being such a loyal customer.  Paul

name: Marianna Sargent
text: Best black and white mocha! Staff is always friendly and fast.

resp.text: Thanks Marianna! That's one of my favorite drinks, too.

name: Karl Maria Fattig
text: Little Dog is one of the local coffee shops Brunswick is lucky to have. They do Coffee by Design roasts and have the primo location on Maine Street. Espresso drinks are well made and they have some great food choices. Of course it's dog friendly with some of the best outdoor seating in the town. Hours are better than some of the other options. You'll run into lots of friends here. Excellent WiFi as well as comfy couches.

Atmosphere can be noisy, but it's a nice large space with comfortable seating. My main issue was the service. Barista didn't pay attention to me or my order. I ordered a chicken salad panini, she asked me to repeat my order and then gave me a coffee cup. Maybe I misunderstood cafe au lait but I don't know why I would pay extra for a regular coffee. The sandwich was a hot mess and lacked flavor, but the coffee was delicious and that's a little more important

I might not order food here again, and don't really trust the baristas to make me a prepared drink, but I'd certainly come back for a simple delicious cup of coffee.

text: DaVinci's is an absolutely wonderful all-around satisfying Italian Eatery. I love to treat myself there when I just want some comfort food that tastes great and satisfies you're craving to be cosseted. The staff is always friendly and welcoming. The draft beers are delicious and different throughout the year. I thoroughly enjoy getting a flight and sampling a variety. I highly recommend this wonderful Italian restaurant.

name: Ari Weisman
text: I came in for a pizza and they delivered me a round of dough with sauce and piled high with cheese. It was fantastic and the ambiance of the restaurant was quiet and covid safe. Pizza was pricey but tasted great, the waiters were attentive and always kept my water full.

name: Paul Nickerson
text: Fairly expensive, but the food quality matches the price. I've gotten several dishes, and none have disappointed yet.

name: Davina Poulin
text: We had a birthday dinner at DaVinci's on a Saturday afternoon. We got in before the dinner rush (it was 3:45pm)and didn't have to wait for a table. As always, the food was superb and the waitstaff was attentive. The drinks are a tad bit small for what you're paying but the entrées are delicious. I had the steak and portobello ravioli and he had something with a bunch of seafood in it (it looked fancy and delightful for someone who likes that sort of thing.... Obviously not me.) I definitely recommend DaVinci's to anyone looking for a good place for a celebratory meal; this is THE place to go.

text: I ordered food for the 1st and last time spend 50$for my toddler to get food poisoning from their so called stir fry she was the only one who got very sick hrs after eating it!all the veggies were extremely overdone as if it had been pre made  n just sitting for God know how many days or more.i let her eat it since I have a picky eater was suprised...I tasted n very overdone but she ate it so...I'm from Chicago n have been in the restaurant industry a long time and know very well what fresh and old food taste like...I got a salad...had I known my bby would get sick from unsanitary food conditions that I mistook for really overdone food I would have never ordered from here and would have stuck to the normal place I order from cowbell...me and my child has never gotten sick and always have fresh food coming from this place

text: Finally found a place that has creme brulee on the menu. Great atmosphere, and really great food. Our waitress was fabulous, and our drinks stayed full. It was our first time here. Me and my fiance are getting married this Friday and plan to come here again for the creme brulee.

name: Davi Smitti
text: For lunch and dinner, this is a go-to highly recommended spot... I've been a big fan for 20 or so years. Breakfast was good, food made to order, a good variety of hot food choices, breakfast sandwiches and wraps, 2 or 3 kinds of muffins as well as scones.

name: Jason Rand
text: Great place for the family service was great very friendly and the food was absolutely delicious along with very generous portions. We will definitely be making a trip back next time we are in town.

name: Carley
text: So Good and a must go!!

name: Camerashy
text: Lasanga was amazing as is thier ravioli. Very large family style helpings and don't forget dessert as the cheese cake ranks up there

name: Catherine Merrill
text: Sandwiches were. Delish

name: Dana Little
text: This is my family's favorite place to eat.  The garlic rolls come out first and taste fantastic.  They have cut down the size of their side salads which is disappointing.  The main meals for me are large enough to take home for a second meal the next day.  Too noisy for me at popular times, my recent visit at 5pm on a weekday was quiet enough to enjoy a good conversation.

name: Nicole Pare
text: Amazing experience. Kiley was amazing, and the food was fantastic.

name: Nickki T
text: My first time here and I'm glad I tried it. The atmosphere is very warm and welcoming and the drinks and meals aren't overpriced. Will be visiting again the next time we are over that way.

name: David Allen
text: If you haven't been your missing out! Great atmosphere, great look, great staff, and absolutely the best Italian restaurant I've been to here in Maine so far in five years!! I'd give it a ten if i could!

name: Christopher King
text: Davincis has been a reliable dinner option for years. Recently went for my birthday and the food was very good. We had the calamari appetizer and I had Salmon on the beet salad for dinner. Glad I went, I had not been in a while and eating there helped me remember how much I like Davincis.

name: Nellie Davidson
text: Great Italian food. Great outdoor seating.

name: YANKEE GAMER
text: One of my all time favorite restaurants! They NEVER disappoint. Highly recommend!! 👍❤

name: Elaine LaBelle
text: Always delish and great atmosphere..

name: A A
text: Best eggplant parmigiana I have ever had!

name: Bruce
text: Great food and atmosphere!!

name: Copperwolf gaming
text: Food is excellent!! Service is slow but its super crowded so possibly understaffed. I would definitely go back!

name: Joan Brooks
text: DAVINCI'S is awesome. Great atmosphere. Wonder helpful people. Great service.

name: Bobbi Jo Griffin
text: love the food!

name: Terry Clancy
text: Great Italian food... The garlic knots are the best!!! Friendly staff

name: James Koester
text: As always, DaVincis delivers. Small menu...but every item on it is made as if you were in one of the best Italian restaurants in N.Y.. good service, reasonable prices, and a beautiful atmosphere. You won't be disappointed.

name: Downeast BBQ
text: Very nice atmosphere. Love what they did with the building. I ate the baked manicotti and ordered a pizza. It was good. The garlic knots we're burned and hard. No garlic or topping on them. Maybe a new cook. Usually the food is 5star. Last visit the food was 2star. Maybe next time...

name: Susan McNally
text: The Garlic Knots are the best nothing compares. There is not much on the menu that I don't love. Best Lasagna I have ever had. The atmosphere of this restaurant is amazing! I love that they restored part of the Bates Mill for this amazing restaurant. If you love Vespa scooters you should really check this place out, the scooters are on the walls as part of the decor.

name: Paul Dececco
text: Great service and amazing tastes. Definitely worth taking the time to visit and eagerly awaiting the next chance to revisit when I'm in the Lewiston area.

name: Doug Pinkham
text: We drive almost 100 miles to eat here. The garlic knots are to die for and all the meals are awesome. There beer and wine list is excellent. We used to live in the area and now come as a treat. So treat your self to great food and wonderful atmosphere.

name: Penelope Cyr-Lorenson
text: Always a great food experience! Great service, too! Garlic Knots...need I say more! 😉

name: Twanna Rampino
text:
Really fun atmosphere at this place. Great service, excellent coffee. The reason that I am lacking with the additional star is their pizza buffet.
Love the salad bar, love the homemade soups, but the pizza selection is terrible. Cheese, pepperoni, and sausage. Come on, it's a PIZZA buffet!
I'm comparing them to Ricetta's that has one of the best pizza- buffet- pizza selections ever.
This place, eh.

name: Dana Lyon
text: Garlic knots are amazing. And the decor is beautiful. Not too loud not stone cold silent

name: Terry Drake
text: Food was good. Service was a little slow. Overall a nice outside dining experience.

name: Kate Kerrigan
text: Had an amazing dinner, first timers too! Great atmosphere, and loved how they used the old mill building. Heather was a true pleasure!

name: Adam Brown
text: If you want a real nice restaurant in  Lewiston this is kind of your only option but dam is it good

name: Bobbigirl photography
text: Excellent Italian restaurant with a lunch Buffet..pizza ,salad and soup

name: Richard Ferrara
text: Garlic knots-- what else need I say.  Great food at a good price, Tuesday pizza and salad buffet is a great value

name: Linda Whitcomb
text: The food was excellent and service great. Good price too.  Will be going back again.

name: Bill & Viera Vahey
text: Absolutely the best Italian dishes in the midcoast!!  Service impeccable!!  Food many choices!!  Great place

name: Sandie Spear
text: Busy but service was still on point and food was delicious!

name: Richard Gallant
text: THE best, wood fired, brick oven pizza I've ever had the pleasure to experience. Nice selection of local craft beers on tap.

name: Trina
text: Good food and service.. environment is just a little loud for me for this type of restaurant. Otherwise it's a fine dinning experience.🙂

name: James Robbins
text: Fantastic Italian restaurant !! The place smells so good as soon as you come thru the door. Food is incredible ! The garlic rolls that come while you while you wait for your food are both delicious and warm The wait staff  are both very nice and helpful. Prices are fair and the selections of desserts are awesome. Lots of free parking in the lot across the street. Both dine in and take out. A must stop especially if in the area

name: Bonnie Creech
text: Great food and atmosphere at a great price

name: Pamela Price Wharff
text: Great atmosphere, whether you are looking for casual lunch or romantic dinner.  Food is fabulous and moderately priced.  Anything from pizza to more exotic pasta dishes.  If nothing else, you have to have a garlic knot!

name: Brendan Akers
text: People look like they're having a good time. I looked at a menu. Even with a good job, I can't see myself paying that much for a meal.

name: Jacob Neal
text: One of the best dining experiences in lewiston auburn area. I would say that the kitchen staff has a keen idea of what folks have come to enjoy for Italian cuisine. Atmosphere is more than comfortable and very pleasant to experience.

name: Nicalena Neary
text: Davinci,s Eatery is a large Italian restaurant located in Auburn ME. There is a separate Dining room, Bar and Private rooms for functions. The food is typical Italian: pizza, pasta, meat and fish entrees etc. The staff is efficient. The Manager gave me a brief tour. Worth a visit.

name: Hadassah Rea
text:
Good food, fun atmosphere and staff

Get your Italian fix here

Avoiding pasta? Ask them sub for a bed of steamed broccoli!

name: Janis Moore
text: Early bird special was great. Just the right amount of food, and delicious. Service was good and fun.

name: Christie Wessels
text: One of my favorite places to eat locally.  Food is superb.  Atmosphere is great.  I recommend the pizza.

name: Joey Hall
text: This place is amazing. The pizza is amazing. Lunch buffet is all you can eat with drink it was 15. Salad bar is hugely stocked. Great food.

name: Sharlena Biron

name: Lily duvall
text: Not bad. Some days excellent, other days not bad

name: Steve D
text: Great place to get some delicious food.  Great for dinner for two or a big party.  No need for reservations, but I would suggest calling ahead during the weekends as they can get pretty busy. Great selection of local beer on tap as well.

name: Robin Couture

name: Alan Theberge

name: Joe Bagodonuts

name: Carrie Tracy

name: Andy Roy

name: Marta Gaines

First visit in a couple years. I was excited  to eat here again,  but the entres were bland. Also,  they don't serve whole wheat pasta.
Sent my food back,  as not worth the fat, calories and carbs!
Rolls were delicious, and Cesar salad was good. Oil for rolls was also bland.
Sadly disappointed.

name: Theresa Byras
text: Omg... I am sooooo full. Had to have dessert, too..... Positively yummy

name: Bruce Austin

name: Melissa Anne

name: Roger Latulippe
text: Always the best Italian food in town! We tried their unlimited pasta and salad. Delicious! Hope they have that again soon!

name: Mikayla Welch
text:
Awesome atmosphere and vibe easily one of the most beautiful  restaurants on the inside in Lewiston. However overall very standard low level Italian food and cocktails very underwhelming.
Garlic knots are the only reason to give this more than a 2☆

name: Peggy May
text: It was calming and refreshing,  had the soup,  salad, and pizza bar. It was very nice and the food was delicious

name: Katie Farr
text: BEST IN TOWN

name: April Kerr
text: The food was really good as was the service. It was amazing to see the transformation of the inside of this old mill and the pieces of memorabilia that has been refurbished. Then enjoying the water fountain outside, WoW! Great anniversary dinner for my husband and I.

name: Bryan Spellman
text: Amazing service with a great atmosphere. Some of the best pizza I've had, and the salad bar is spectacular!

name: Daniel Tanguay
text: Great food, pleasant atmosphere and friendly service. I prefer to sit in the bar area. My friends and I always celebrate our birthdays here. The steak and mushroom raviolis are the best.

name: Stephanie Thomas
text: Was so excited to try this place, heard such good things. So disappointed in my experience.  Service was horrible.  It was more like self service. Was with 2 other people. We had to ask for water. We had to ask for bread (garlic knots). We had to get a bus boy to clear appetizer/salad plates AFTER our meals were served. I filled out the comment card and spoke with manager on duty. Told her of our experience. I used a MA mailing address and she said you're not local so we normally send a gift card but that won't help you. I suggested she send it to my family who lives in Auburn. She agreed and I gave her the local address. She also said the owner would review my comments. 10 days later and not one word from anyone at Davinci's. This just reinforces how bad the customer service is, apparently from the top down. 2 stars because the food is good and the busboy did his job. Can't see myself returning to support a place that doesn't care about their

name: Fran White
text: Great local Italian food

name: Kyle M
text: Absolutely delicious Italian food.  Their garlic knots are to die for (especially if you're a vampire!).  It's got an awesome vintage atmosphere, and it's always fun to watch the conveyor belt spin around when someone from their "mug club" comes in and orders a drink (at least I think that's what's going on).  Easy parking right across the street.  This is easily my favorite restaurant in L/A.

name: Danny Alexander
text: Very Good and Friendly Service! Karen was very nice and friendly!

name: Lori Banks
text: I've never had anything I didn't like from the menu. Very tasty sophisticated food.

name: Kimberly and James Melanson

name: Paul Farley

resp.text: Thank you for the review, Paul!  We are so glad you enjoyed the charm of the old mill!

name: Kevin Breton
text: Awesome waitstaff! Delicious food! As far as Italian food goes this is one of the best places I've ever visited. Pizzas are okay. I'm a fan of thick crust and theirs is thin. Great topping choices though.

name: Jason Levandoski
text: Excellent service, food and vibes. Not to mention a never-ending supply of their famous garlic knots. Every experience I've had there has been exceptional.

name: EJ Fortin

name: K Meadows
text: When I found this one I thought "where have you been hiding???" Even though it seems in plain sight..this is a treasure behind those doors! I loved the retro decor! name: Dean Rider
text: Food was great service was as well all in all a great experience

name: Austin B

name: Scott Lowell

resp.text:
Hi Cynthia,
Thank you for the review.  We strive to provide an elevated experience and are sorry to hear that we missed the mark this past weekend.  If you'd like to email us at info@davinciseatery.com to tell us more about your visit, we're listening!

name: RV Man

name: Misty Deraps
text: Very good food, great ambiance and wonderful wait staff😊

resp.text: Thank you for the review, Misty!

name: Debra Hyde
text: Loved the pizza and salad bar! The chili bean soup was on fire!! We had a super friendly waitress who we enjoyed talking to.

name: chris lawrence

name: C Jinx

name: Robert Kelly
text: Great Italian comfort food! Try the stuffed mushrooms!

name: Marge Kilkelly
text: Love this place. Quiet enough to chat and busy enough to be fun.  Food is always delightful. Salad was crispy and fresh served with sumptuous Bleu cheese dressing on the side. Haddock was done perfectly. Friend had a Margarita pizza, she says she always goes for that one. Servers are friendly, well timed and knowledgeable.

name: JA Shaw
text: One of my favorite local eateries. Everything is yummy! Family loves it. Staff were helpful with my dietary restrictions.

name: Shawn C
text: Love Davinci's great food and atmosphere and beautiful use of the space.

name: Jonathan VanOver

name: Derek Potter

name: Chris MacMahon

resp.text: Thank you for the review!  We are so glad to hear you enjoyed your child's first "date" night with us!

name: Bob Dunham

resp.text: Thank you for the kind words, Robert!  We hope to see you again soon!

name: Gosh Darn

Garlic knots are the main attraction!

text:
A really well-maintained and managed Italian Restaurant, that also rejuvenates the mill buildings! The food is fairly standard Italian food, nothing really out of the ordinary, however it is all very good. They do offer free garlic knots before the meal and they are absolutely delicious, especially when dipped into a plate of their homemade olive oil.

Also a decent selection of microbrews from the surrounding areas!

name: Bradford Sprague
text: Big, nice place.  The food was great with reasonable prices. Our server was very nice and personable.  Great beer selection!

name: Anthony Gallo

name: Thomas Farrington
text: Great food and service

name: Ashley Malinowski
text: My family loves eating here but I'm not sure why. It has a nicely decorated atmosphere and lots of space. Wait staff are always friendly. I think they must've changed the recipe for the garlic knots, so they're no longer something to write home about and the prices are exorbitant for meal size. Meals themselves are hit or miss, some are great (specifically the mushroom and steak ravioli) but others, like the melanzana are very much subpar (I've never seen eggplant that color, or taste so awful).

name: Maizie Lathrop
text: First time eating there the other day and we had a great experience. The food is delicious. :)

name: Kimberly Melanson

name: Marcel Aube

name: Kristopher Petrolini

name: J S
text: Extremely expensive, especially the beer.  Food was nothing special.  This place is huge and there is no way they can prepare that much fresh food on such a massive scale without short cuts.  The place is so big and open plan that in the area we were sat you couldn't even think straight, let alone hold a conversation.  Got an upset stomach eating here.

name: Ebony Doucette
text: I, of course, ordered the seafood Pomodoro again I'm telling you if you read this review and you love Seafood you have to order the seafood pomodoro! Amazing food and amazing service! The seafood Pomodoro was absolutely the best and freshest seafood I have ever had and highly recommend it and the restaurant to anyone. You certainly get what you pay for and our waitress was exceptionally efficient and not over the top or over bearing. Thank you! We will return very soon! 3rd time I have dined here and I ordered the seafood Pomodoro again! If you love Seafood this is where to get it at its freshest and most delicious! Seafood pomodoro!

name: Helen Moulton
text: My 5-year-old loves the rolls here...I love the pizza! Always good food, always friendly service.

name: Matthew Smith
text: Great food and a great staff. Very happy with the service everytime  we go

name: Glenn Thomas
text:
Amazing place! First time customer I was so amazed
At the perfection from the bread to the meal. But what really blew my mind is our party had over 30 people and we had 1 waitress Denese. She was a pro!
Delivered all the meals, refills, in Flawless fashion! Empressed is an understatement! Try this place next time your in Lewiston!

name: Foster McLaughlin

I wont eat there again,  not after what i heard the owner saying,  or rather screaming at staff

resp.text:
Tim,
We are so sorry to hear that you did not enjoy your salad.  We do our best to make sure all of our guests are happy with their meals when dining in with us or ordering take-out. If you are ever not completely satisfied with your meal, please let your server know immediately or give us a call so we can correct the issue right away. We appreciate your honest feedback and hope that you will dine with us again soon!

name: Debra Shannon

Overall, the menu is made up of italian-american standards which are prepared and served without pretense. Some of the offerings stand out as high notes amongst the rest. I'm partial to the mussels myself. I'm also a fan of the italian wedding soup. The soup is a solid interpretation of a classic; it's not a re-invention or an attempt to suprise---and that's just right for a good, old-fashioned comfort food. That could be said for much of the menu.
The service has always been great, and the atmosphere is welcoming and easy.

name: Chris Slesarchik
text: Good food but atmosphere seems to have an identity crisis. I couldn't tell if it was trying to be a casual bistro or a more upscale place. The menu offered both hearty pub fare and pricier dishes including Asian fusion tacos and pastas. Prices were not outrageous but also more expensive than a regular pub-type joint. There were both people in snowpants grabbing food after a day on the mountain and people in formal attire sipping wine. This didn't bother me, but in choosing a place I'd be confused on whether Homestead was suited for a fancy date night or a casual burger.

name: Jon & Debbie Cota
text: It was a variety of experiences. The restaurant seems to think they are better than they really are. The dining room is shabby at best, and wait staff was mediocre. She spilled my drink all over the table and never apologized or brought napkins. Nor did she ever ask if we wanted another round of drinks. Just went my husband and I were thinking we had picked a truly dismal place for our anniversary weekend, they brought dinner. And dinner was AMAZING. My husband had a tortellini dish which appeared handmade and tasted amazing. I had a blueberry browned butter salmon that I am still thinking about. So delicious.  So depending on what you are looking for in a dining experience this might be your place.

text:
My wife and I both ordered prime rib.  I wanted mine to be med rare, it was perfect.  My wife ordered medium and hers was more rare than med.  We told the waitress which was willing to take it back but my wife chose to eat some and to take the rest home.  The waitress complimented my wife in being gracious.  That was nice of the waitress.  Then we had desert and when the waitress brought the bill, she had taken the dessert off because of the rare meat.  She was very sweet and professional with us.  A great waitress!
Plus, they had a musician that night and he was excellent!  We even got a dance in:)

3 of us arrived at 6:30 and were seated very quickly. Our waitress gave us water and disappeared for 20 minutes. Once she returned we ordered our meals and a cup of seafood chowder as an appetizer. I ordered the teriyaki tips, I asked to substitute my vegetable for a salad with ranch dressing. Our waitress said no problem and put our orders in. The seafood chowder arrived after our dinner and my dinner came with veggies..no salad. I asked the waitress about the salad and she came back with a salad with a vinagrette dressing on it. I politely asked her for a salad with ranch, like I had originally asked for. She brought back my salad drenched in ranch dressing. Very disappointing and not worth the $5.50 EXTRA I paid for a salad as a substitute, overall the prices are pretty steep for mediocre food and service. Maybe service would have been better on a busier night? We obviously were not a priority.. and there were 4 tables being served including ours.

The best part of the meal was the bread served before dinner.

name: Zac Cornish
text: Maine lobster fest is an iconic mid coast Maine festival. Don't expect grand and flashy, but rather quaint with lots of local flavor.The prices aren't good for the food, but the point is to have a lot of good seafood, Maine artists, and other fun concentrated into a small area for your convenience. If you came to Maine just for lobster, go find an off main street lobster shack. The lobster fest celebrates the lives of the locals that surround these tasty creatures. Now... Saw a comment about lobster rolls... I'm from Texas, and it's sacrilege to grind up lobster and mix it with mayo on a bun. The lobster roll is very maine because these good folks have eaten so much lobster they are bored of it. If you aren't bored of lobster yet, don't get the roll. In short, you won't regret what the lobster fest can teach you about the Maine experience.

name: Neil Ashton
text: We've been visiting this restaurant for 50 years or so. While it can be a delicious tourist trap in the summer, it is the place for outstanding food when they've gone home. Not that the food isn't great all year round. In the summer, many people land here because it's on a boat. Well, most people who have grown up in Maine have been on a boat, so it really is the food that keeps us going back. Once upon a time, DiMillo's was spaghetti and seafood. Now, the seafood and a few landlubber entrees are reigning. We ordered steamers to start along with some great beverages. We could have stopped there! There were a lot of clams in the pot they brought. Lobster stew is fabulous! This was rich and creamy and maybe the best I've had in a restaurant in years. The onion soup was excellent as well. I usually get whole lobsters but went with the Lazy Lobster tonight. Wow! It was great. Tasty, sweet, cooked perfectly and no shells to get rid of. They brought me some french fries too. I think I ate 4. I was full with no room for trimmings. Was it expensive? The check was about $50 less than I thought it would be, so pricey but NOT expensive. We also had a great time talking with the owner as he stopped by to make sure everything was meeting our expectations and we ended up reminiscing about how the restaurant had changed and improved over the years! Don't miss it if you're going to Portland. And if you've been there before, the menu gets freshened regularly.

name: Tim McClure
text:
I ordered the Short Rib Tagliatelle. It was absolutely delicious. The tomatoe sauce was incredible.

We were seated on the veranda with great view of  sail boats and harbor. Our waiter was attentive without being a nusance.

name: Boots Mahgoots
text: Always 5 stars. This time it was fresh, pecan crusted haddock, stuffed with butternut squash & cornbread with a maple gravy on top that was out of this world!  Cheesy polenta on the side, cooked perfectly. Get it while its still on the menu! Merry Christmas!

name: Vivian Pratte
text:
I recently went here for the third time with my family and it was different.

Parking is validated, this restaurant is on a ship and the atmosphere is wonderful!

When things were normal, the menu was plentiful. Since the Corona Virus hit, the menu is limited and so is staff.

When we were sat we waited 10-12 minutes before our waitress came to the table. Thankfully we knew what we wanted so we ordered drinks, appetizer and food right away. While we sat waiting for our meal, we got to see some fisherman taking a leak off his boat... that was pleasant to see - so if you're into that kind of entertainment make sure to dine in the evening.

The meals we ordered tasted wonderful and portion sizes were large. One sad note, my haddock sandwich was greasy and made my bun soggy. I couldn't pick up the sandwich without it falling apart. No worries, I sliced and diced that bad boy to pieces and enjoyed it.

It's worth the wait so make sure you get a reservation! During summer months it gets packed!

name: Matt Stone
text: Nice ambience. Great food. Was there for happy hour (4-6pm). $5 wine and $7 Vittles (go for the haddock bites or the buffalo shrimp if they have them). Brandon the bartender was awesome. Quick to serve and was good fun. The other bartender, Sydney, was really nice as well. Always running to clean the bar and make sure everyone was happy. It's been about 3 years since I was last there, and never just to sit at the bar. I never would have thought about stopping here for a local drink, but will definitely come again.

name: Ron Mosocco
text: We stopped in here for late afternoon/early dinner a couple October's ago as we were traveling throughout wonderful New England and stayed near downtown Portland. The waterfront is gorgeous and DiMillo's on the Water on the old ship was quite enjoyable. It was a warm, peaceful and sunny day as our server was attentive, courteous and friendly. Doris started with a glass of white wine I went with a tall cold Pilsner Beer. We shared an order of fried calamari then Doris had a cup of their delicious New England Clam Chowder, followed by their baked haddock dinner while I went with a 2 pound lobster dinner. Everything was very well prepared and mouth watering. Our total bill came to $ 140. We look forward to our return. Simply beautiful here.

text: Beautiful experience. Pricey but worth it. I would go back for the right occasion. Food was delicious Keep up the good work!

text:
We went here on the first night of our honeymoon. We got an OK bottle of "Bordeaux." The server was efficient. I had a stuffed lobster and my new hubs got some fish and we enjoyed both meals. The crab cakes were good too!

The main reasons I'm giving 5 stars are 1) there was no wait and 2) we got to sit outside.

name: jon labelle
text: Amazing food and service worth every penny and the views of the harbor were amazing nice to watch thr planes fly by to land aswell.

name: Vincent Aceto
text: From the phone reservation to leaving with dessert, you are treated like royalty. Everyone involved in your dining experience is extremely devoted to making sure you enjoy your time there. Steve DiMillo stops by each table to ensure that everything goes well. Our waitress Katherine was amazing. She made sure we had what we needed, checking in here and there allowing us to enjoy our meal. The scallops and risotto, calemari, lobster mac and cheese was our choice. By far the best caesar's salad I have ever had. A Portland staple since the 50's, DiMillo's never fails to disappoint.

text: Broiled scallops were excellent! Staff was pleasant and the facility was clean.

text: DiMillo’s was a perfect meal! We had the lazy lobster and it was tender and delicious. Wine selection complimented the dinner. Desserts were terrific. Unique menu item was a different take on a wedge salad with apples instead of tomatoes and bacon with a vinaigrette dressing. A delicious combination of fresh flavors.

text: I ordered the sirloin with scallops, they were fantastic.  The customer service was top notch and the food came out in a timely manner.  The decor and view were lovely, though I should warn that since this was on a boat, the rocking from the tide changing did feel a little disoriented.  Otherwise a wonderful dining experience.

name: Anil Singh
text: A must visit for dinner when in downtown Portland. We tried calling up for to make reservations and the person who answered the phone said they don’t do reservations during their busy time (5-8pm). I asked how busy the restaurant was at that moment in time and they said not too busy and they try to seat guests as promptly as possible. With that said we left our hotel room and make the trek from Westbrook into downtown Portland. We parked the car off in a public parking lot and while walking to DiMillo’s realized there is a parking lot directly in front of the restaurant and they validate parking tickets. So we pressed on. Upon arriving the main desk said we have two options we can seat ourself on the left at an open table or go to the right and wait for the dining staff to seat us. We peeked into the left and didn’t see any open tables so we decided to go right and her seated. We were seated immediately at a great table. Waitress was very attentive. Drinks, appetizer, and meal was absolutely delicious. My wife had a small lobster and loved it. I would definitely visit again.

text: For one of these longstanding touristy spots, this place was solid. The staff were really attentive and great, and the food was pretty good. Our space was on the second floor, though, and for those with mobility issues the only option is a chair lift that rides up. Still, the space felt like it was entirely ours and as a result was more quiet and accommodating.

name: R. From BS
