text:
Our favorite restaurant in Portland.  The fare tends to towards Italian and - of course - seafood.  The menu is slightly fluid but a perennial joy is the Caesar salad; the difference is the fresh, mild anchovies.
At least as much of a draw as the food is the view.  DeMillo's is on a decommissioned ferry parked at a Pier just off Portland Harbor.  (The hull is filled with concrete so she barely moves in any wave action).  You can watch lobster boats, sailboats, freighters, and all manner of pleasure craft going by.
Dress is casual but t-shirts would rather stick out; polos, button-down shirts, and sweaters are more appropriate.
Highly recommended.

name: Paul Mccarthy
text: One of the best Prime Ribs, I ve ever had. Wife had a delicious  baked stuffed lobster

name: Pamela Gagne
text: Always good food but haven't been in many years

name: Brian Tucker
text: Lobster mac&cheese on the deck overlooking Portland Harbor. Not bad.

name: Daniel Sanborn
text: Very good except the crab club. Good service.  Nice atmosphere

name: Roberta Philbrook Tooley
text: Enjoyable atmosphere.  Good food. Plenty of parking. Family and friends enjoy.

name: Christine McHale
text: I've gone to dimillo's since they were in their old location, on dry land. Okay, just across commercial Street. We went for happy hour. Sat in the bar. The hours were very liberal the drinks were good and happy hour offerings great. Their ad said it's the locals season and I think there were mostly locals in the bar. Everyone seemed to be having a good time and enjoying their snacks. I do recommend it. I haven't been in the dining room in years, but I'm sure it's fine.

name: Harry Callahan
text: I have eaten here probably a dozen times. The food is always good. Drinks are cold. Atmosphere is great!! And I like being around all those fancy yachts that are moored there. Very cool to see up close.

name: Kathy Wahl
text: Service exceptional! Seafood combo I  had was perfect. Very relaxing.

name: Daisy Parker
text: Friday, at 12:30 pm without reservations we were seated quickly on outside deck. Fun atmosphere overlooking the harbor.  Food was great. Staff was friendly and attentive. A bit expensive but well worth the cost. Highly recommend.

name: Judy Robbins
text: Arrived at Dimillo's.  Retired female. Standing at bar having a drink, awaiting a friend for dinner.  3 gents arrive behind me. Owner is present and speaks with them. They order drinks after me. 5 minutes go by. Bartender comes over and directs them to 3  bar seats that are becoming available.  I asked her about it. She said owner told her to seat them.  Rude! about it

name: David Friedlander
text: A staple of downtown Portland, DiMillo's has been around for many years. Their steaks are wonderful and even the salads are very tasty. Reservations are a good idea. Free off-street parking, good for several hours at the lot in front if their restaurant; but it's only free if you get your parking stub validated at the restaurant. A great place for that special occasion.

name: K Gil
text: Good beers very clean great staff

name: Tiffany Marie
text: Intimate setting, amazing views, great fresh seafood options and YOU ARE ON THE WATER! Definitely worth several returns.

name: L Jack
text: Local for my whole life, never been here before tonight. Entertaining a group of 14, half from away.  Got there early and seated quickly. Service was excellent. Everyone loved the food.  Salads, soups, entrees....there were no complaints. I heard particular high praise for the pecan crusted haddock and the cran ginger salmon.

name: Chris and Amy Boivin
text: Delicious food and drink, wonderful customer service and ocean views.

name: Justine Wood
text: Nice place wright on the water.  Million dollar view but seriously your food is not worth the price.  Prices are ridicules.

name: Erin Leonhard
text: It's a fun venue, great for kids. But the food is only fair & it's not vegetarian friendly. Glad I experienced it but no need to return.

name: DebKen Gagnon
text: Okay, the food is already famous but they have an outstanding bar. Go for the full boat Bloody Mary filled with veggies and a jumbo shrimp!

name: Melinda Parker
text: One of the greatest places on earth! Lobster stew is to die for. Perfect atmosphere - beautiful views, incredibly friendly staff, and they host an amazing wedding!

name: Michael Interbartolo
text: Was there for a graduation party. Helpful valet staff for a busy Saturday parking lot. Food was good though we just had a bunch of appetizers for the function. Attentive serving staff kept the chafing dishes full and circulated with other picky food. Bar staff was split between our function and the rest of the upper deck needs so sometimes there was a wait. Overall enjoyable time.

name: billy 4
text: Food and atmosphere is fantastic.

name: Christine Baptista
text: A long time family favorite, we love sitting out on the deck. The service is great and the atmosphere is spectacular, especially the view but the food is really the main attraction! I'm getting hungry just thinking about it.

name: William O
text: A bit of snootiness and airs and graces from the receptionist but our server shone.  Good food with a subdued ambiance. I will call back.

name: Jeanette Dantuono
text: Had a very good dinner. Lobster was delicious the seafood platter was fantastic. All in all a very enjoyable day.

name: Jennifer Pendell
text: Make reservations! Yes they will seat you without, but you'll wait an hour or more. Prices are for a very nice restaurant, but food  is rather plain. It's right in the water, but surrounded by boats, buildings and very limited views of the water. Overall, it's just okay.

name: Francis Duffy
text: In a city now famous for it's restaurants DiMillos is a institution.... serving great food and drink in a great waterfront location..... AND the parking is free!!

name: Joseph Gaudet
text: Great atmosphere to bring folks from out of town. Showcase local seafood on a novel floating restaurant. Staff are friendly and welcoming, beer selection is below par for connoisseurs.

name: griffin gribbel
text: If you haven't been to Dimillo's before then it can come off as a tourist trap. It's a big ferry turned into a restaurant. But as a local I can tell you it is definitely not a tourist trap. Far from it. Their food is very good, the staff is incredibly friendly, and the views are some of the best in Portland. I'm a fan of Dimillo's and I've happily sent a lot of friends and family their way.

name: Josh Therrien
text: A bit pricey but great atmosphere and the seafood pasta was perfectly prepared

name: autumn Hackett
text: Waiter was really nice and funny. Our food was amazing and you could definitely tell everything was fresh. For a Friday night we got in pretty quick and our food came quick as well. Will definitely be returning.

name: Michelle Lemay
text: After a short wait , just enough time to grab a drink from the bar, we got a great seat out side on the front deck. Nancy our server was great. As was the food. 😎

name: Arline Mues
text: Excellent food and drink. Great service. DeMillo's is a yearly tradition for us.

name: Mark Johnston
text: Great seafood -outstanding staff.

name: J J
text: I first visited DiMillo's 4 years ago when I was in town on business. This time here on vacation and I brought the family. Everyone truly enjoyed their meals. There were seven of us and we ordered five different appetizers to share and seven different entrees, so we tried a lot of different menu items.  The food and service here are excellent. Yes there is a wait, and no it isnt the least expensive meal. But I travel for a living and one thing seems to always be true, you get what you pay for. The value is in the ambiance, the view, the service, the food, and the experience. Well done Dimillos and thanks Andy.

name: Mel B
text: I don't think dirty trays with half eaten food should be placed on top of the water station or next to my table.  We were there for two hours and for two hours a tray of food that was bussed from a table sat across from us.  The waitress seemed to be having a sad day but wasn't sure if she was sad or hated her job. You can't order off a large portion of the menu after 4, so if you want a fish sandwich etc you'll have to take your large party to the bar area instead of dining room.  Two of us had the clams and the both of us was up sick all night.  The valet attendant was extremely friendly and helpful. The bread and butter was very good.

name: Slagre P
text: Its fine..not sure anyone goes for the food...the food is passable but $$.  #touristtrap

name: Kelly Dyer
text: True to it's down east tradition the best Maine Lobstah around town .

name: Cynthia Ladd
text: Sisters weekend and we enjoyed walking around Portland shopping and had a great lunch at DiMillo’s very nice . Have eaten here before and will be back . The food was plenty and homemade which is a wonderful thing these days! Service excellent.. Thank you

name: Nancy Pare
text: Always a great experience.  Food was delicious.  Polenta is so delicious I order it as an appetizer even though it's in the menu as a side dish.  Service tonight by Bob, a veteran of the restaurant was top notch.

name: Meredith Treat
text: Dimillo's is one of our favorite places. We sit in the bar area, and you can order sandwiches from the lunch menu for reasonable prices at dinner. There is a fireplace, and views of the water. The atmosphere is great. Not too loud, so you can hear your company talk, unlike a lot of the newer trendy places in Scarborough.  And always good service. :)

name: Erin Morin
text: I had the most incredible fried seafood platter that I've ever had at DiMillos. It could have fed a family of four. That's a little exaggeration, and the platter was seconded only by their lobster stew and steamed clams. This place is a jem and a gold mine. I almost hate telling people because I don't want it to be crowded. Very, very good management.

name: Bill Solly
text: Great food and friendly staff

name: Dexter Elsemore
text: Ate in the bar. Very good service. Appitizers were wonderful scallops were great.

name: Joe Hall
text: Loved the tasty seafood and cocktails - wow! So fresh and good. Joshua was a spectacular server and took care of our group in first class style. Would recommend DiMillo's on the Water to anyone looking for a fantastic meal in Maine along the Downtown Portland waterfront.

name: Terry Brearley
text: Fabulous lunch outside this afternoon. Great service. Out of this world food! Highly recommend  making this a "have to" when in Portland. Oh & free parking while you're there.

name: Gilz T
text: I love this place due to the fact that it is a restaurant in a vessel. The inside is very nice and clean. The food is great because all I order is the twin lobsters. One is steamed & the other is baked and stuffed with breading. They taste great to me. Staff members are nice, which is a good thing to know if ya are wondering.

name: Karen McIver
text: Excellent food, excellent service, only drawback is limited vegan options. You make do.

name: Haley Carleton
text: Excellent food, nice staff. You seem to wait a little longer for your food, but I think that just goes to show how fresh it is. I wouldn't eat here if you're in any sort of a rush. But definitely a very nice place to eat, and the food was to die for. Even the simplest of foods were amazing.

name: Sean Stockard
text: Excellent ambience. Beautiful restaurant actually floating on the water. The service is outstanding. The fish and seafood is as fresh and well prepared as found in any NYC, SFO, Chicago or other big city restaurant. I had fresh broiled haddock, polenta and a cup of clam chowder. All of it was delicious. They have a terrific wine list as well. Its a $$ to $$$ restaurant but would be a $$$$ in any other larger city! Very romantic. Good for business dinners and entertaining clients as well.

name: Evan Spoerl
text: Wonderful atmosphere, great food and service.  You can't beat the view over the water either!

name: Kate Savidge
text: The attitude of the hostess last night was condescending and borderline rude. We had a party of 7 coming for dinner. I tried making a reservation but was told they don't do that anymore. I was also told if the restaurant did take reservations, "people like me would not ever be able to eat there." I believe that is the whole reason for having a reservation....and how rude that was to say to me.

name: Clean Car
text: Very pricey.  Service not all that special,    food is great.

name: Garrett Grasshoff
text: Really cool and unique dining experience. Really enjoyed spending our anniversary there.

name: Kimberly and James Melanson
text: We  ate at the bar. The bartenders were friendly and the food was so fresh and delicious

name: Jason St Pierre
text: Great place. Fun theme and view of marina.

name: Joey Grenier
text: We had a sever named Nick and he was such an amazing waiter. His tag said he has worked there for 20 years. He definitely knows what he's doing and is great at it. Not to mention the great food.

name: Douglas Goodman
text: A great place to eat.  The resureant is a ship and has a wonderful view of the harbor.  A place for seaford with other items too.  A bit pricey but well worth it.

name: Lime Green
text: Always enjoyable. We often go for lunch and like to sit at the bar overlooking the marina. Service is always attentive. Good bloody Mary's and fried clams.

name: George Stacey
text: Phenomenal setting and location love the top deck of the boat restaurant. The only thing that was a tad frustrating it seemed like our waitress was so busy we never got to ask for refills etc.

name: pamela rasmuson
text: The food was excellent and the wait staff was so attentive.. it was a great experience for my mother's 87th birthday.. thank you

name: Michele Dixon
text: Pretty good food. Great service. Clean bathrooms.  Excellent coffee and desserts

name: ImTheDJ •net
text: Loved my scallops. Our family ordered the clam chowder, lobster and multiple other seafood items and they were all fabulous. Cooked to perfection. I'm from Maine and most of the others were not, we're still talking about our lunch time on the outdoor deck. They want to go back every time we visit Maine. Friendly staff and A+ atmosphere too!

name: Robert Dominick
text: Great choices for seafood.  The serving sizes are on the bigger side (not a bad thing!).  Being on the boat creates a very cool atmosphere. Quite a variety of bar/drink selections.

name: Brenda Dufour
text: Parking. Good food. Friendly  staff. Clean. Boat so can sit outside too and watch Casco Bay

name: Kay Hansen
text: Great views. Lovely, engaging waitress. Good food. Enjoyed potato salad.

name: Bruno Coppola
text: Awesome Restaurant! When ever in Portland Maine we always stop here for Lunch or Dinner! Family owned and run very well! Steve Dimillio is always available and makes sure you have a great Dining experience!

name: Jim Hutchins
text: Excellent food and service. Great beer selection and great food.  The scallops wrapped in bacon were heavenly.

name: Diane Correia
text: Great food and wonderful views!!

name: Sara Mason
text: Great food. Very busy. Don't take reservations. Had an hour wait last time but went to the bar for drinks. Can eat there or in the lounge if you want but usually packed. Took a while to get our food but worth it.

name: Peter Anderson
text: I tend to count Dimillo's out for being too touristy, then I go there and have a wonderful meal in an elegant setting and wonder why I don't come more often. The parking is another huge plus.

name: Kelly Ripley
text: Staff seemed annoyed, food was good. Nice atmosphere. I feel like DiMillo's is great for tourists but as a local there are different places around for seafood I'd prefer.

name: Andre Ricarte
text:
Located at the end of the Long Wharf, DiMillo's is a restaurant in a large boat. It is literally on water. There is parking inside, you just have to have it validated by the front desk after your meal. Otherwise, it's $6/hr.

We ordered the Jumbo Shrimp (which is sold by piece! Be warned!), the mussels, clam chowder, the Lazy Lobster (Admiral's portion), and the fried Fisherman's platter. We all shared the food, except for the shrimp.

The clam chowder was pretty good, very creamy. The Lazy Lobster was expensive and very disappointing. It was a lobster taken out of the shell served in butter. It was small, and not worth the hefty price. The Fried Fisherman's platter was filled with many fried seafood, but it seemed misleading to add fried lemon to make it look more than it was.

DiMillo's was expensive. The food was okay, and it was at least worth a try for it's environment and ambiance.

name: Nick Moir
text: food was amazing . service was good. although you do pay a lot for the view and the name.

name: Ernie Buckley
text: Best food ever also the best happy hour buffet I have ever seen

name: Tom O'Dell
text: Beautiful setting! Food was very good.

name: Harris
text: Excellent food, the staff is so nice and friendly. The boat is awesome and the view is spectacular

name: Don Chamberlain
text: Love this place. A floating restaurant. I especially like the upper deck in summer. The food is excellent. For my liking the menu is limited, but everything on it is excellent. My favorite is the Macadamia nut crusted Haddock.

name: Pat L.
text: Great food.  Great views.  Great staff.

name: Nivette Jackaway
text: food was just ok...lobster on the club sandwich didnt really tast like fresh lobster should taste.

name: Matt Finder
text: The waitstaff was great, the hostess was not that impressive. The food was great, crab cakes were very good, calamari was fresh. We went at Christmas time and the had a quartet singing that was great

name: R G
text: Best lobster stew hands down on my trip to Maine. Went to 10 plus places to have lobster stew.

name: Sandy Bryant
text: Great food and service

name: Drew Mittelstaedt
text: Beautiful place, but the help struggled with our group (I know groups can be a pain, but really). Slow and inattentive service, seafood selections were enjoyed by all, beef selections were Sizzler quality, drink service was poor. Will give them another shot, but not with a group.

name: Tim Dexter
text: Free parking, very friendly staff and great menu!

name: Nancy Blaisdell
text: Great atmosphere and the best food and the prices are great.

name: Joe Nastri
text: Longtime seafood restaurant by the waterfront docks in downtown Portland. Food is good quality especially the seafood (as it should be in this region). Prices are elevated but it is downtown and the waterfront. Nice walk to the restaurant, passing by many of the docked boats. Staff is pleasant.

name: Diarmaid O'Donoghue
text: Here on a sunny Friday afternoon in September having lunch outside. Just had the mussels for an appetizer. I've had many Mussel dishes, and this is the best. Overall experience is great. Reasonably priced. A must-do place to eat while in the Old Port.

name: George Barber
text:
Always great quality and options for Seaford and other options. Fresh, well made, and served well.
Bread and dipping sauce as well. Hmmmm!
Don't just take out of town guests here. Free, easy parking as well. The view at my last visit was a plane landing nearby and a container ship passing within 150 yards of our window-on-the-water view.

name: Edward DuGay
text: Easy docking for fuel. Great prices and high quality workers.

name: Maureen Alsheimer
text: Great food and service

name: Lee Hoyt
text: Food and service is always excellent.

name: Christine Ylonen
text:
Love this place!!
French onion soup and a ceasar salad was great!!
Bartenders not so much!! Way too much talking among themselves.
Never came back to see how everything was or asked if I wanted another drink...bad!!

name: K. Nakanishi
text: Probably the best place to get a true fine dining + Maine seafood experience. It's a restaurant on a boat, so it's a meal like no other. Great staff, fresh seafood, very reasonable prices, and excellent quality. Whenever my grandfather would visit, this was his favorite place to go.

name: Sue Clifford
text: Always a fun place to visit - a real boat that has been docked at the wharf for many years. DEPENDING on the height at the tide, the ramp entrance could be a little difficult to manage. At high tide the ramp is quite level; at low tide the ramp can have a very steep decline from the parking lot and very steep incline when exiting the restaurant. I attended a business dinner with about 50 people attending. The food was excellent and and the service was impeccable.

name: Jane Croston
text: One of the best all around good and moderately priced restaurant in Portland. Stayed far away for years as it was not known for great food, and I'm glad to say I feel like it's a new discovery. Not just one of the greatest views, but the menu is varied and fresh. Love the mussels with touch of Eastport mustard, and best onion soup around... Staff is helpful and friendly . Always come away feeling satisfied and love sitting in the lounge by the fire on a grey winter day.

name: Virginia Curit
text: Very comfortable. Wait staff is excellent. They can seat large parties.awesome place.

name: Becky S
text: Great organic Pinot Grigio!!

name: brenton whitten
text: Expensive, slow,  crowded,  mostly a tourist trap. The so so food isn't worth the hassle or the price.

name: Tom Sing
text: Had a great lunch & service was great !

name: Kenneth Jones
text: Love the food love the service

name: Chris Fuselier
text: Had lobster on the shell for first time. It was excellent. Atmosphere is good. Restaurant is actually a boat in dock. We sat in the lounge section which was very comfortable.

name: RV Man
text:
Nice atmosphere, nice variety on the menu, good beer selection. Waiter was very pleasant and well informed about selections.
Excellent choice for a laid back day.

name: SAM Dalfonso
text: First class..great seafood and excellent staff

name: Patty Marquis
text: Excellent food and service!

name: Patricia Lamy
text: Had a delicious meal outside on the deck overlooking the water. The fish sandwiches we had were the best.

name: Anna Warner
text: Not good for the price. Tourist trap. Much better restaurants in the area at lower prices and better food.

name: Tom Haight
text: They've gone way down hill in the past years. It's now a sad imitation of what they were 25 years ago. They've become so popular they operate more like a cafeteria with servers now. No personal attention anymore. Demilo's used to be a high class establishment where you could get an exceptional dinner. Now it just overpriced food and a staff that could use some civility lessons.

name: Chris Jacques
text: Causal but elegant dining at this Portland Landmark restaurant.  Had my wedding rehearsal dinner here 24 years ago and still just as good this many years later.  Tons of free parking as well when visiting the old port!

name: Ryan Gipson
text: Beautiful location on water in the Old Port! Friendly staff,  and the food is respectable.  I've been here for a few functions, and they have all been very good.

name: Michele James
text: Spectacular views and great food.  Service was on spot

name: Kim Knowles
text: Ben our waiter was terrific and the food was delicious!

name: Mr. Ages
text: Great service, great food, relaxed during the day, stepped up semi-formal evening.  Pricey for the average Joe.  Comfortable and pleasant environment.

name: Ben Sullivan
text: There's a beautiful nautical ambiance to this place. The food is top notch too. Presentation is excellent. Much of the seafood is actually from Maine, which is refreshing to see. You'll be able to watch ships come in as you eat. Note: it's literally a cruise ship so it rocks some times - there's nothing wrong with you. :)

name: John Chrissikos
text: Five star restaurant. Entirely classy place on the water. This is actually a boat so it is a floating restaurant. Whenever I go to a special outing in Portland I always stop at Dimillo's. Hands down the classiest place in Portland and superb prices for superb food and service. Only thing...Please stop using the word tapas. We're in America and it is appetizers

resp.text: Thank you John for sharing your kind words and you'll never catch us using that term.

name: Bruce Lesperance
text: It was amazing  never been before was not sure what was happening at first when the boat started to move but is well the food was great the waiter was awsome my sister is allergic to seafood was going to get something he can back and let her know it was cooked in the juice

name: Sterling Musholt
text: Awesome sea food.  Great views of the port while eating outside.  Very good service.

name: James Denz
text: Good food and friendly staff. Free parking. The food is pricey but it was worth it. We will be back. I just wish they had a better beer selection.

name: Sherri McInnis
text: My husband brought me here for my birthday. Dinner was great.  The atmosphere was lovely.

name: Andy Martin
text: I would probably be more inclined towards a 3.5 rating but it's not possible. I love the beer glasses here, they improve the drink ability of any beer. The fried shrimp are my most favorite around and the lobster stew is packed with lobster, it's absolutely delicious. Service is always good here. The only real problem I have is the prices. They really target tourist, and being a local I'm not inclined to be a regular because there a bunch of places that are more reasonably priced. I still love the atmosphere of being on a boat in the water and the nautical theme of the restaurant make for a nice experience.

name: Joshua Jones
text: It's was okay, service was good but the food was missing that something special to make this a 5 star rating

name: Jane Taylor
text: Beautiful place, wonderful food and great service!

name: Tony Blevins
text: One of the best restaurants in America!

name: tom gioia
text: I am a local Mainer. It may not be trendy but the food and service is always a home run

name: Kathy Lee Cook
text: Had an awesome dinner! Seafood scampi and fried lobster were delicious!

name: Steve Lerman
text: Good food and service.

name: Bill Taylor
text: Delicious and delicious 😋 cool place 👌

name: Jed Nickerson
text: Family owned and operated, it shows with a boat load of awesomeness!

name: Paul Carney
text: Always an excellent experience here. Blake was an amazing server, and the meal was delicious.

name: Kelly McCarthy
text: The hostess said the wait was an hour, I walked thru the restaurant (having been in the business, I know how a hostess can make or break an establishment) and discovered at least 10 soon to be bussed tables and many almost done guests and decided her wait time was likely grossly exaggerated. Sure enough our table was ready in 10 minutes. Food was good. Service was very slow. Another thing the restaurant should do is have a designated bartender or two for the restaurant. Important to get cocktails out immediately! Customers will relax and enjoy their drink and patiently wait for their food! The restaurant was clean and good but could definitely improve with minor tweaks!

name: Toni MacQuinn
text: Outstanding as always. Scallops wrapped Bacon👍

name: Bruce Nelson
text: When spending time in Portland make it a point to plan one evening at DiMillo's.  Then go home and tell all your friends about the great place you discovered.

name: Joseph Bissell
text: The food and atmosphere were excellent.  It is a little pricey, but overall outstanding

name: Rob Koenig
text: Great food....super service

name: Crystal Merriman
text: Lovely atmosphere and bar. Great place for seafood. Definitely will be going there again.

name: P Creamer
text: Excellent  seafood platters,Authentic Maine taste.

name: Gestler Mendoza
text:
We ordered the lobster roll and alfredo pasta.
New England chowder and clams appetizers

Love it! With bloody Mary!

I recommend this place.

name: Nancy Keast
text: Dinner on a boat ? You've got it in Portland Maine. Free parking in the Old Port and a gift shop too.

name: Steve Steve
text: Fried lobster. The best.

name: Gustavo Jimenez
text: Awesome food right off the boat! Great views and lovely service...

name: Charles Berry
text: Best seafood in Portland. Prime rib friday and sat night.

name: b s
text: No wait for outdoor seat for lunch. Steamers were incredible and clam chowder was very good

name: Michele Boisgilbody
text: DiMillo's has a great happy hour menu and lovely deck seating overlooking Casco Bay

name: Joe Eragitano
text: Great service and food.

name: Sue R
text: Always do a great job with hors d'oeuvres and desserts. Wide entree selection; suggest sticking with the basics. One of the few places in the Old Port that isn't pretentious.

name: Ralph Valente
text: I was skeptical that this would be a tourist  trap,  but the food was outstanding and the martinis generous!

name: Pleasant Mountain Organics
text: Treated like royalty

name: James Lincoln
text: Great Happy Hour... Wonderful waitress...

name: Patty Falls

name: Jay Tarbox
text: I was there for a party and hors d'oeuvres the bacon-wrapped scallops are excellent

name: Nancy Elliott
text: Calamari and clam chowder is absolutely delicious!  Best in Maine!!!!

name: Lainey Cross
text: One of our favorite places to have lunch in Portland.

name: Cheryl Doubleday
text: Best clam chowder I have ever had, huge chunks of clam! Lobster club was amazing also. And everything was fairly priced , plus we sat on the outside of the boat which had a pretty view of the shipyard

name: Desiree C
text: Best clam chowder I've ever had hands down. Definite stop when visiting Portland.

name: Mark Phillips
text: Love this gem.  Food is always amazing.  Happy hour specials.

name: Paul
text: You're paying for the location at this restaurant. Food is good, not great and overpriced.  Of the many fine restaurants in the Portland area, Dimmilo,s is a 4 on a scale of 10 but just my opinion.    If you want the ambiance of eating on a boat thats fine,  go here for expensive average quality food. If you want better tasting food for less money, look elsewhere and you don't have to look far. There are just so many more finer restaurants nearby.

name: Rick. Schencks
text: Very nice atmosphere, excellent  service ! The bacon wrapped  scallops  was delicious ,an the Boston  Cobb salad also

name: Jose Duddy
text: Awesome as always

name: Genanne Brandon

name: RON CZIKOWSKY
text: Excellent dining experience

name: Jeff Hawkins
text: After 12 years living in southern Maine we finally visited the restaurant for a family dinner. The restaurant and staff were pleasant enough, but the reality is that this place is for the tourists. Portland has so many amazing restaurants, and this place is not really in the same league when it comes to food quality.

name: Kathy D
text: Food was very good.  Steamers were not gritty and lobster roll was full of lobster and no fillers.  I give a 3 because service was not great.  We waited quite a while for our appetizers and when I asked our waitress she said we are busy today.  No sorry, no I will check.  I am not used to going to touristy restaurants but if this is what they are like I will stay away.

name: Barry Russo
text: Very accommidating, great newengland menu and excellent service.

text: Normally we enjoy going to Dimillos for dinner. Unfortunately our last experience wasn't stellar. My husband, daughter and myself sat in the lounge area and our server was less than attentive, granted that the restaurant was not busy at allu. We waited 15 minutes for our drinks and had to ask to see a children's menu. We ordered our daughters meal and then a cup of lobster stew and a ceasar salad as starters. We were planning on having dinner as well. I ended up with a bowl instead of a cup. Their lobster stew is usually my favorite in all of Portland but unfortunately this time it turned me off. The lobster was mushy and seemed to be undercooked. I tried to inform our server that I had ordered a cup but could not get his attention away from wiping down empty dirty tables. I waited about 10 minutes to eat it as I wanted a cup so I would have room for dinner, but our server never came back. Thankfully my daughter ordered two kids meals because my husband and myself ended up eating her food since our server did not come back to get a dinner order. Finally fed up over trying to get his attention and being overlooked, we called over the other server in the room and asked to have our check. We dont go out to eat very often and was really looking forward to dinner that night but instead we ended up having appetizers and left over kids meals.

name: Elizabeth Grenier
text: DeMillo's is one of our most favorite places to dine! From the staff to the food and everything in between, it's simply one of the best for fine dining. The Atmosphere can be anything you want or need it to be, from romantic to celebratory, to semi-casual or social. It's a great place for couples or small groups of adults . I don't recommend it for families with small children or infants, as it disturbs the entire ambiance of the experience. We've dined here countless times and there's been a few times that toddlers & infants have caused huge disruptions, taking away from that very special & intimate ambiance. Other than that, there's never been any complaints about service or food. The toddlers & infants are of no fault of DeMillo's, so if I had to grade them, I would give them  stars all around! SUGGESTION, in July & August, MAKE RESERVATIONS! :))

(Translated by Google) Very nice restaurant, which was built in an old ship. The ambience seems uplifted. Prices are around $ 30 per entree. Wine is available from $ 10 per glass. We had the lazy lobster and mixed mussel, fish and shrimp platter. Both were delicious. The portion sizes are fine. If you are hungry you should order a side dish as a side dish. Without reservation, it may be that you have to wait quite a long time (we waited 45min), but it is worth it absolutely to wait for a table in the back (more beautiful) restaurant area.

Sehr schönes Restaurant, das in einem altem Schiff gebaut wurde. Das Ambiente erscheint gehoben. Die Preise bewegen sich um die 30 Dollar pro Hauptgericht. Wein gibt es ab 10 Dollar pro Glas. Wir hatten den Lazy Hummer und den gemischten Muschel, Fisch und Garnelenteller. Beides war super lecker. Die Portionsgrößen sind in Ordnung. text: They sat four of us (two adults and two young kiddos) in the back where the people who want quiet sit. The service was mediocre at best. My oldest and husband never got their drinks refilled. We had to ask for silverware AFTER our food was served, which my husband ended up just walking over and picking up off a station. The oysters were NOT fresh, and not served with any kind of sauce. The lobster mac n cheese was dry. The fish and chips were  soggy and the fish breading literally fell off in a glob. On the positive... the steamed broccoli and clam chowder bread bowl were on point. Oh, and the five dollar margaritas are worth every penny.

text:
The weather vane has excellent fish, shell fish entrees in its menu. Selection of appetizers is numerous.  They have a lot of fruity  alcohol and regular drinks.

One last note, service and prices are second to none.  e.g. 2 whole Maine lobsters for $22-$24.  Of market price is a factor.

name: Ann Cummings
text:
The Weathervane is one of the local seafood restaurants we like going to. Always fresh fish here, clean and friendly staff.  I've been coming to this restaurant for over 30 years.  The last 2-3 times we've been there, the dining room was quite chilly., uncomfortably so. We noticed several people putting their jackets on while eating so we knew it wasn't just us.  Our most recent meal we had last week was really good for my husband and just so-so for me. I had a half & half dinner - native shrimp and haddock nuggets with fries. My fries were lukewarm as was the shrimp. The haddock nuggets were really hot.  My husband's meal was "perfect" as he put it.  He had bay scallops and fries.  The waitress for our section offered us and the tables around us 'warm rolls' and none of us got rolls anywhere close to warm. We could hear people at each of the tables commenting about them as they were dropped at each table.

We're hoping the last couple of times we were there are just an aberration because it's always been so good until recently. We'll definitely go back and see how things go.

I rattled off what l wanted and got mashed instead of baked potato. I just ate it but mentioned it at the end, so he brought me a baked potato to take home, which I was not asking for. Cheerful and accommodating young man, just not very careful at the beginning.

text: Had a coupon from The Anchorage for discounted apps. Clam Chowder was OKAY, garlic bread and truffle fries were tasty. Fried clams and haddock sandwich were EXCELLENT. DEF sub fries for rings and you're good. Great service, Covid precautions and friendly staff. I heard breakfast is incredible but tomorrow morning were onto the next....

name: david gutowski
text: Restaurant sits right on the ocean.  Has Beautiful views, including a distant view of Nubble Light House.  Nice selection of mixed drinks and some local beers on tap.  Menu has a nice selection of Seafood and also includes burger, steak and chicken.  Love sitting on the outdoor patio right on the ocean.

name: Michaela Davenport
text: This place has AMAZING FOOD, Great view, and nice atmosphere. I would have given this restaurant 5stars but our waiter SUCKED!! He barely spoke english, He was rude, and we got there at about 7:15 and they were closing at 8 and he kept trying to rush us out of there when all we wanted to do was relax,look at the view,and enjoy our meal!!! Its really too bad because its a great place. We'll definitely be back but WILL request for a different server!!! Of all GREAT PLACE!!!!! IF it was nicer out we would have sat outside to eat!!!!

name: Chris Boule
text: We come here every year during our week in York. Breakfast here is a must, food is good, they give you good portions and it is reasonably priced. I suggest lunch from the walk up window especially if you are close by on the beach. As for dinner, I think there are better choices in town. The dinner prices and the quality/options just don't seem to stack up against your Lobster Cove's and Fox's etc... not saying they are a bad dinner just that your money can be better spent elsewhere.

name: Piner
text: Horrible food, poor service, and unknowledgeable staff with rude manager. Went there a couple weeks ago to get some lobster rolls. Was told that you get 2 lobster rolls with chips for the 22 bucks you have to pay. We specifically bought the lobster roll plate because we thought it was a fair price for the 2 lobster roll plate. Waited for our food for a long while. First meal came out 15 mins before our other one. When we got the lobster roll plate it was a sad small portion of lobster soaked in mayo... We went and asked if the second one was coming out because we were specifically told it came with 2 rolls. Turns out it doesn't and we were lied to. (The bag of chips was tiny as  well) after bringing up the fact that we were misinformed so much so that it would of changed our order I was asked if I wanted a refund by the counter worker. I went and spoke with my partner and she decided to go talk to them. She spoke with a manager (a very rude one) and was refused a refund or any type of helpful information. The manager told us that she would be happy to give us two if we paid for it. (Seriously?) It was too bad it was such a bad experience, the location is nice. The location is all they have going for them... Over priced and low quality food, rude management, workers who have no clue what the food looks like or how it comes, and just a real day ruining place... Save yourself from s loss of smile and find another place for seafood.

text: Good food, good service and great atmosphere. being right on the water during the summer, there's nothing better.

name: Justin Obie
text: If your in the area and hungry.. this place won't disappoint. One thing that really stuck out was the waiter was so knowledagable about the menu any questions I had were precisely answered. The food was delicious. And I have a new favorite beer from there. They craft their own beers too. Good stuff 👏

name: Tori MC125
text:
Sea Dogs Restaurant offers a complete and enjoyable dining experience. The restaurant occupies an old mill which sits at the edge of a working dam. You can dine either inside or out. The food is well prepared and the serving sizes match the pricing.
Although the food and the ambience are clear winners it is the success of the brewery that draws the crowds. I am no way a connosieur of beer so I will leave the brewery reviews to others. The bottom line, Sea Dogs is a fun place that offers great food, historic ambiance, decor and a top rate brewery.

name: Howard Smith
text: Nice ambiance! Wasnt crowded. Food and Beer was Great and Phil the bartender was awesome !

name: Erin-Lynn Banfield
text: Excellent on all counts! Staff was friendly, knowledgeable and their timing was great. Food to match in plating and flavor! Cant wait to go back!!!

name: Matt Smith
text: Good beer. Food is okay. When we went there all we wanted was some nachos but it was very odd that a bar like this doesn't have on menu. What brew pub / restaurant doesn't have?!  But it is a beautiful location right on the river. So if you just want to have some appetizers and good beer, it's worth a try.

name: Rachel McCray
text: The meals weren't up to par. The appetizer was very good. The fried pickles. Would recommend them. We were seated by a very loud and rude table.

text: Great beers, atmosphere, staff and location. Beers and food on the deck is a must

name: Thomas Peters, II
text: Seadogs is an ok place. Some of the dishes are really good. Had their special yesterday, a chicken and curry stew and it was great. I just wish the bowl was a little deeper to hold a bit more. The tables are spaced well but nonetheless it is loud. Relaxed place.

name: Mary D.
text: The restaurant did a great job with social distancing. The service and food was wonderful. I can't give a 5 star as the kitchen staff was a but too slow for a quiet evening.

Would recomend!!!

text: Service was great, food was good, fries weren't very good but server went above and beyond to please us. Their house-made ranch was delicious... Enjoyed the cheesecake too!

name: Hans Rasmussen
text: Had some great appetizers and made a new best friend. Hazelnut Porter.

name: Wayne
text: The menu right now due to Covid is limited but the food was fantastic. Always have a great selection of brews. I got Blue Paw Wild Blueberry brew. It was so delicious.  Can't wait to get back there again.

name: Andrea Jacobs
text: I had a very enjoyable lunch.  The haddock was delicious.  I only wish they had more  chicken meals to choose from on their menu.

name: Alice Bean Andrenyak
text: Very noisy and hard to hear my husband sitting next to me at mid afternoon.  Food was excellent and inspired.  The veggie sweet potato burger was excellent with the quick pickled veggies. Having a choice of sides was great. My husband's pub burger was tasty and well cooked. Stemless wine glasses fit the atmosphere and the beers were full glass pours. Families with infants to teens shared the room with couple and friends. Attentive waitstaff. Vegetarians can eat here with more choices than just salad.

name: Bob Steele
text: Got to sit outside, which was excellent.  Great view, very relaxing.  Good service and good food.

name: Debra Work
text: We waited 5 minutes to be seated, in an almost empty restaurant, and deck. Once seated, I look, and within a foot of my chair is this nasty window that obviously hasn't been cleaned this year. The food is mediocre, and overpriced. Nope, not coming back.

name: Sam Keske
text: Pros: extensive menu of beer and food; plenty of room; one of the coolest waterfront views in town. Cons: food options are somewhat generic; some beers are less impressive than others. Probably the coolest Sea Dog location in the chain.

name: Barry
text: Grabbed some takeout while in town for some service. Ordered a couple of sandwiches that were excellent but the fries were almost completely cold! Ordered the takeout two miles from the site and it was ready when we arrived. We had included a good tip when we picked it up and have always had great food before covid-19.

name: Philip Paisnel
text: The place is beautiful,  its on the river and the restaurant overlooks the river as well as tue bridge on both sides. Great food, the wait staff is also great as well. They also do a buffet brunch here. Sometimes there's a wait but it goes quickly. If you get a chance to make sure you sit outside, it's shaded and not too warm so those of you who had the heat or sun will be okay.

name: Sabrina B
text: My meal seemed reheated and greasy.  The bread was good and we had a good crab Rangoon appetizer. Service was nice but slow.

name: Ernest Grendell
text: A fun place for lunch and dinners spectacular variety of locally brewed craft beers and an outdoor seating Deck with spectacular views of the Penobscot River and Brewer walking trail Beyond

name: Sherri McInnis
text: Had brunch with my daughter and her husband from New York. Very pleasant experience.  Delicious food! The only disappointing experience is there were a lot of reservations. Sea Dog had not had reservations for the longest time.  We couldn't get a table without one.  We arrive early so we can get a table and enjoy brunch . Im not sure I will come back.

name: Dan B
text: Love the view of the river, and selection of beer and food

text: Nice to be out again. We felt safe with the staff and socially distanced dining. We trust them when we order gluten free.

Excellent brews and good food. If the weather is decent sit outside for a view of the river and falls.
Had the lobster roll and clam poboy. The blueberry beer is fantastic.

name: LA Mitkus
text: Late lunch husband had a steak & cheese along with a delicious beer. I had the swordfish special everything was outstanding. We'll be back. Oh and the Sunfish Margarita was wonderful!!

name: Clayton & Cindy Putnam
text:
This was a double header. . .  quick dinner pit stop tonight and Civil War lecture in Brunswick. . . . We hit the pub at the Sea Dog, located on main street in Topsham, next to the Green Bridge that connects to main street Brunswick,  in Maine.  The Sea Dog is on the ground floor of this renovated paper mill building, next to the Androscoggin River.

You can count on a reasonably good selection of beers on tap. The wine list is limited, but understandable in a pub. The food is OK . . . We shared the nachos with beef chili on the top with an extra helping of guacamole & sour cream! Good nachos.

Not to crowded tonight, service was good, fine pub food. Our friends only paid $7 for their meal & beers . . . The advantages of belonging to their Beer Club! I guess my wife and I will join! Nice deals for Beer Club members!

name: Todd Settlemire
text: Decent food, good beer, great atmosphere. Especially when deck is open. Kinda pricey.

name: Richard Caldwell
text: The pork schnitzel was great! The restaurant was in the old mill on the river. The service was very good as well! The overall experience was great!

name: Wendy Emelianoff
text:
Had the Thai Green Curry Mussels....yum! The burgers were delicious and the flight of beers perfect!
Our waitress was amazing and was able to answer all our questions and had suggestions to offer as well.

name: Bradley Osterhout
text: Great food and drink, fun atmosphere and a beautiful view!

name: Amy Hargett
text: Really great beer. Always recommend the bluepaw, but I was happy to be able to try all of their beer on tap including their pumpkin beer! It was great but was made even better as a smashed pumpkin (layered with Sea Dog stout) and as a pumpkin pie drink (with one shot of whipped vodka). Delicious beer and great bar service!

name: Chad Pomerleau
text: Good food. Nice view....

name: Larry Gianakis
text:
The food was good and I he beer was alright.  The porter has so much fake flavor in it that it tasted like you are drinking a Yankee candle.

Great staff.

text: Totally disappointed with our experience at the the sea dog last night waiter was awful. He placed our drink order but forgot to put in our meal order. By the time we got our meals an hour had gone by. Asked to talk manager but was told he was not available would be willing to try again but would need to talk to management first.

name: Phil Anderson

name: Chelsea Cruz
text: Happy birthday to me! We had the crab ragoon dip for app and the chimichurri steak tacos! Omg they were amazing! And also there's a pic of an empty birthday shot! The view there was beautiful as well!

text: Service was outstanding! Tons of gluten free and even some vegan options. They now carry Beyond Burger and I noticed they must change menus seasonally (which i personally love) because summer was the last time i was here and i noticed changes on the menu!

name: craig carey
text: We had a great.lunch here.  The day was perfect and we sat outside....great people and great service.....they had plenty of GF options for me as well...including some GF beer....

text: Wonderful restaurant with its own beer and many seafood dishes. Right on the water with fantastic scenery.

name: Christen

name: Linda Butler
text: Had the Bang Bang Shrimp as an appetizer and it was so delicious! Perfect amount of sauce and adding a touch of lemon juice squeezed on top was perfection. Wasn't too busy and the service was good and we didn't wait too long to get our food.

text: The night was busy, so service was a tad off.  Otherwise, great!  Food was spot on.

name: Paul Bennett
text: The Sea Dog is a great place to go for casual dining, good beer and and excellent atmosphere.  The food is reasonably priced and never disappoints.  The nacho plate with chicken was large enough for 5 to share.  I loved the fresh (not jarred) jalapenos.

name: Patrick Burnham

name: Brian Churney
