name: Rob Cote
text: We were in Bar Harbor in late November, so well past the usual tourist season and more than half of the stores and restaurants were closed for the season. I got the Rum Burger and my wife, the fried chicken. With their brown butter french fries and fried brussel sprouts on the side, as well as a cup of chowder. The food is not gourmet by any means, but for what is, it's fantastic. The fries were a real surprise for me, along with the brown butter, which I honestly couldn't taste but it didn't matter, it looks like they were seasoned with fresh thyme leaves and cracked pepper. I'd go back just for those. We got our order as take out, but decided to go there a couple days later to get some dinner and a couple drinks, we ended up ordering the same things again, and we were not disappointed. The food was great again, and the staff was super friendly. I'm looking forward to eating there again next time we are in town.

name: Eddie Pascucci
text:
Brought here on the Stephen King tour. What an amazing guy who’s used his success to help build up his home community. While I haven’t met him, I hold tremendous respect for the man in both regards to his masterful writing and his contribution to his city and state. For all his acclaim and fame, his gates to his house are wide open. I ask any and all who visit please not disturb or trespass as he’s earned himself that at the very least.

Beautiful home!
For terrific informative tour around Bangor I highly recommend this Stephen King tour:
sk-tours.com

Definitely one of the cooler places at the park. Come at low tide for best weird noises. I think picture opportunities are better then at low tide also if you venture out onto the rocks.

text: Worth the stop while taking the Ocean Path Trail or driving the loop. You might be fortunate to time it right and hear the thunder. Bonus:  there are bathrooms available across the loop road at the south end of the parking lot.

name: Jessica Lewis
text: We didn't get to hear the thunder but it was still a really beautiful place.

text: Probably one of the highlights of Acadia National Park. It is a major attraction point where you can see the thunderous power of waves. Also, you have to be lucky enough to be there at a day when the waves are stronger such that you can enjoy the Thunder hole even more. The key is to around 2 hours before the high tide timing. So check the tide timings beforehand and plan your day accordingly. There are decent number of parking spots around the location too.

If you go at the right time, you can really hear the water crash like thunder! If you're taking your phone though, make sure to keep it stored in a waterproof pouch...

This place is a lot cuter than I thought it would be.  I booked it for it’s proximity to other activities I had planned for the weekend, but I had not really stopped to appreciate it.  The service was great.  Upon our arrival we could immediately tell that the guys who checked us in knew pretty much everything there was to know about the place.  Everyone was extremely kind and looked they liked their job and did it well.

We missed breakfast, but it looked like it would have been the perfect little something to grab and go for the beginning of the day.  The WiFi was also very strong.

Our bed and bath were great.  One thing I noticed was that the water was a little softer than I would like.  It just meant that I needed to stay under the water a little longer than normal to completely rinse off, but I’m sure that there are many benefits to soft water that I am unaware of.

We enjoyed our stay!

name: Roy Harper
text: The Nubble Lighthouse, properly named Cape Neddick Light, is located in York, Maine. There is an excellent gift shop on-site, ample free parking and great views of the lighthouse. The Nubble is one of Maine's most photographed lighthouses. A visit is all you'll need do to see why. The Saturday after Thanksgiving marks the annual "The Lighting of The Nubble" event; a family friendly evening of holiday cheer. The Nubble is a must see for any lighthouse enthusiast visiting Maine.

text:
If I have been there once, I have been there dozens of times as I never get sick of seeing beautiful Maine settings, especially picturesque lighthouses. You may have to do a few loops around the park, in order to find a parking space, but it is worth it. Most folks just take the requisite snapshot and bail, but some of us love to sit on the benches or rocks in the constant breeze and enjoy the pounding surf, the flashing beacon, and catch a few rays.

Once in awhile you will see one of the coastal trolleys pull up and unload a wedding party so that they can have photos taken with this beautiful backdrop. We have even seen folks get married on the rocks in the park. A restaurant is only a stone's throw away and an ice cream shop is but a short walk up the hill to the right as you exit the park. Bathrooms are on premises as well as a gift shop, and often an artist or writer is there to talk to and purchase from. On a clear day, Boon Island Light can be seen in the distance (see my photo).

Visit this place on the Saturday after Thanksgiving, in the evening, and you will see Santa pull up on a fire truck and witness the darkened lighthouse be transformed, as the countdown ends, and the light and building are lit up in Christmas lights. I love lighthouses and this is one of my favorites.

name: James Garcia
text:
How do I begin? My lovely labor day weekend (which was spent in the Billy Baldwin lux suite at the Motel 6) came to a conclusion at the Lake George Pancake House. First off, why do Bears get seated before a group of extreme titans of industry come to dine? I don't see these bears contributing to society in any meaningful way other than angering myself, my 6 business associates, and the ambassador of a country that has yet to declare its independence, but I digress.

I will sum up the epic experience with 5 key points.

Decor: Never have I realized how useless windows and lighting are until I stepped foot into this messhall. Seriously pancake house, evolve...you have met your match.

Pricing: I was not made aware that I had to take out a home equity line of credit to purchase my omelette and then maintain a 45% return on my investments in order to add a coffee with that. How these meat muppet diners with fat rolls for days afford this slaughterhouse of value is beyond me.

Service: As a summa cum laude graduate of the french institute's waitstaff program for highly skilled servers, I nearly threw up on my mexican butler when I witnessed the "waitstaff" at this cesspool. Let me just offer 1 piece of advice: Rosetta Stone bootlegged DVDs from the trunk of my buddy Gary's 1998 suburu impreza.

Clientelle: I had no idea that the monster truck rally convention rejects were siphoned here after being escorted out of the methodone clinic. To my left, 1 metric ton that was transported to this diner in a horse trailer. To my right, a scene straight out of good will hunting. Oops, did I say good will hunting? I meant joe dirt - mullets aren't a good look after labor day, bro. Grow up.

Food/sustenance: How does a pancake house - let me repeat that PANCAKE house, make quite possibly the worlds worst pancakes. My business associate is a 4 time world championship of pancakes judge and he literally cut his toungue off (they actually charged him for the tounge removal) with a butter knife to not have to endure these pancakes again. Also, how does one add a fresh fruit, such as blueberries and have the pancake go immediatley stale. Impressive. Speaking of fresh fruit the "fruit cup" (a reasonably priced $36.45) was transported by a sherpa led mule team originating 6 months ago in the valleys of fruit laden st. Petersburg. Needless to say when fruit is transported in the butthole of a sweaty mule for 6 months this leaves some taste to be desired. Pancake house, get ready to get ready.

In conclusion, I will not be recommending this establishment to billy baldwin nor will I be extending a volleyball scholarship to any of your children.

Good day

name: Robert McKee
text:
I wanted to give them 5 stars, but I have to be honest.  I go here because I have for 40 years. Not much has changed, but sometimes change is required.  The food is, the sofa fountain and candy bar serve the same food I have enjoyed all these years.  The staff is good while maybe not as friendly as in the past.

Over priced and average quality food, but if you want to experience life from 40 years ago this is your spot.

There are vastly better places to eat within a stones throw, but none of them have the pull of sitting in the same chairs as I did as a child.

text:
This place has the menu of a diner in a fancier sit down restaurant type atmosphere. The French toast was good, though two pieces was not quite filling. My wife had a cheese omelette. We couldn’t figure out why it was served with lettuce, tomato slices, and pickles on the side, but that was, in fact, how it was listed on the menu. For diner food, it was as expected, maybe slightly better.

What the place really had going for it was that it was one of only two eateries open at 7PM on a Friday night after Memorial Day.

And there’s a candy store there, too!

Hi Stephen,
Thank you for giving us a try! Our staff is always happy to greet and take care of our guests. We're disappointed to see that our apple cider doughnut wasn't the best for you. We take great pride in our delicious doughnuts and strive for them to be the best. We hope that you will give us another try to wow you with our tasty treats.

name: SeekingSerenity Harmony
text: The fresh baked gluten free donuts were so good!!!

resp.text:
Hi there,
Thanks for the review and for visiting- we're so glad to hear this! Please come back soon for more delicious gluten-free goodies.

name: Chris Albanese
text: The donuts here live up to their reputation. The jelly filled donuts are perfect, as are the chocolate glazed and the fritters too. Coffee is passable, and is decent enough when paired with a killer donut. They also have breakfast sandwiches too, though we didn’t try those when we stopped. They do both walk up orders with picnic tables as well as a drive through.

resp.text:
Hi Chris,
Thanks for the kind review! We're happy to hear that you enjoyed your jelly filled, chocolate glazed, and fritters. We appreciate your support, and hope to have you back again soon!

name: Edward Cook
text: Congdons is just an awesome place.great people .great food.

name: Katie Pare
text: Always 5 stars for the best donuts in the world!  I bought apple fritters, honey glazed, chocolate frosted and Boston creme. I'd hate to give away a secret that would make it harder on me, but I will. Go early because the line is out the door before 7am! It's worth it! Its also worth the wait and the line goes fast anyway if there is one.

resp.text:
Hi Katie,
We're glad to hear that our doughnuts are 5 stars and that you have a few favorites. Thank you for your great comments. We hope to see you again soon.

name: Richie J
text: WOW!!! The donuts here are epic! I'm angry i did not find this place sooner. Love the Pumpkin donut but they are all incredible. I will be back for sure despite my diet! i'll just have to walk more lol. If you are a Donut lover this place is worth however long you have to travel. Wells also has a great beach too!

resp.text:
Hi Richie,
Thank you for the awesome review! We are so happy to hear how much you enjoy us, especially the pumpkin doughnut. We appreciate your kind words and support, and we look forward to having you back again soon!

name: Celli J
text: Great place for breakfast.  Its a staple of Wells, Maine. donuts are unbelievably good.

resp.text:
Hi Celli,
Thank you very much for the great review! We're glad to hear how much you enjoy us, and we appreciate the kind comments. Looking forward to your next visit!

name: E L
text: We had a wonderful time at Congdon's Doughnuts. Our waitress Natalia was very nice, friendly and well spoken. I had a lobster egg Benedict with home fries. It was DELICIOUS. After that we were curious about doughnuts (since they were in the restaurant's name) and decided to share a blueberry one. It was so good, we decided to buy half a dozen to bring home (and I am not even a donut person, but it was that good). Natalia was a delight. She was knowledgeable and friendly. Extra cherry on top was when we found out we both had Russian and Ukrainian roots. Great food, wonderful experience, good time had by all. I highly recommend this place (just ignore a floor scale for a while ;) ).

resp.text:
Hi EL,
We're thrilled that you had a wonderful time with us and appreciate your kind words about our food, staff, and doughnuts. We hope that you will visit us again.

name: Mindy Aumann
text: Best donuts ever! Donuts from other places aren't worth the calories once you've had Congdons!

resp.text:
Hi Mindy,
Thanks so much for your lovely review! We're honored to be the best in your eyes, and we appreciate your support. We can't wait for your next visit!

name: Nancy E Randolph
text: Went through the drive in. Bought too many doughnuts.  Ate them all anyway.

resp.text:
Hi Nancy,
Thanks for the review - we're so glad to hear this! We can't wait for your next visit - we promise to always be doing our best!

name: Sara Kenny
text: This is my FAVORITE donut shop ( its a restaurant too!) and I've been coming here for years. If you're sitting down get some French toast, it's AMAZING, if you're taking it to go get a bakers dozen. My top picks are the apple fritters, glazed, and raspberry filled...they're really all amazing though. The whoopie pies are also some of the best in Maine.

resp.text:
Hi Sara,
Your comments are great, and we're glad to hear about your favorite doughnuts and treats. Thank you for letting us know.

name: Anna Youngmann
text: One of the best doughnut places I've ever experienced. It's famous for a reason! And Congdon's After Dark is such a fun summer experience!

resp.text: Thank you so much for the stellar review, Anna! We are honored to be one of the best in your eyes, and we very much appreciate your support. Please come back to visit us again soon!

name: Mike DeSimone
text: Our first time here, We tried the blueberry fritter and maple bacon fritters. I loved the maple bacon fritter. My wife loved the blueberry fritter.Great variety well worth the stop.

resp.text: Hi Mike! Thanks so much for the great review! We're happy to hear you loved our maple bacon fritter. It's definitely one of our favorites, too! Glad to hear your wife enjoyed the blueberry. Hope to see you both back again, soon!

name: kevin smith
text: Hands down, the best donuts around.

resp.text: Thank you, Kevin, for this great honor! We appreciate your support and are glad you enjoy us. We can't wait to make your next visit just ask great as the last.

name: Timothy Parsons
text: Homemade donuts with over 20 flavors/types to choose from. $27/dozen. They do take cash and credit card. Lines are long so be prepared to wait. Friendly staff. Walk-up window and drive thru.

resp.text: Thank you for the 5 stars, Timothy! We're glad you enjoy us, and we appreciate your kind remarks regarding our staff. Looking forward to having you back again soon.

name: Nick Foster
text: I have been here many times. For breakfast and just for donuts. It's always a popular choice to visit as they are constantly busy. After 4pm they have food trucks for all your sweet cravings. It's a stone's throw from Mile road leading to Wells beach. Worth a visit if you're in the area!

resp.text: Thank you so much for the fabulous review, Nick! We are thrilled to know that enjoy us for breakfast and for the food trucks. We appreciate your continued support –see you again soon!

name: Ashlyn Detlefsen
text: The fritters and Asiago cheese bagels are fantastic!

resp.text:
Hi Ashlyn,
Thanks for the 5 stars! We're glad to know that the fritters and asiago cheese bagels are your favorite. Please come back again soon for more!

name: John Holzinger
text: Still great doughnuts, Nice line too

resp.text:
Hi John,
Thank you for the 5 stars! We're honored to be great in your eyes and we very much appreciate your support. We look forward to your next visit!

name: Patrick Fagan
text: Good donuts, but I really love the breakfast sandwiches. The coffee is pretty basic, not a specialty spot for that. They have a lot of choices for donuts and some other baked goods. It is all delicious. Staff is positive and fun to interact with. The new covered outdoor bar, in the summer time, is the coolest place to be in Wells. Would give five stars if the coffee was better. Still highly recommend this spot!

resp.text:
Hi Patrick,
Thank you for the kind review - we are happy to hear that you enjoy our breakfast sandwiches! Hope to see you again soon.

name: Jackson Poulson
text: Great place my grandfather came here for years many years ago when he could sneak out for coffee and donuts lol

resp.text:
Hi Jackson,
Thank you for the 5 stars! We're glad to hear that visiting us is a family tradition. We appreciate your support, and can't wait for the next opportunity to serve you.

name: God First
text: Donuts were good. They forgot one of donuts and when I went back up to the window to inform them they corrected the issue and gave me two donuts! Good customer service.

resp.text: Thanks for the review, Rolyn! We're glad that you enjoyed your doughnuts and service. We apologize for the mix up with your order, and are happy to hear that our staff was able to make things right. We look forward to your next visit!

name: Thomas Meyer
text: Excellent donuts, no way around it. Many flavors. Tried apple fritter and lemon and both very incredible, would travel back for it any day!

resp.text: Thank you for the review, Thomas! We're happy to hear that you enjoyed the apple fritter and lemon. We hope to see you back soon for more delicious doughnuts!

name: Michael Holmes
text: Yea,  really.  This place is all it's reputed to be and more.  Tasty product no matter what you get and fine people at the drive through who are pleasant and don't get flustered with the volume.  Just try to pick a late AM hour when it's not so long a wait.

resp.text:
Hi Michael,
Thank you for the great review! We're happy to hear how much you enjoy us. We appreciate your support, and look forward to having you back again soon!

name: Brent C
text: Fast friendly service great food and of course great donuts

resp.text:
Hi Brent,
Thank you very much for the 5 stars! We're glad to hear how much you enjoy us. It is our pleasure to serve you tasty doughnuts with great service. We look forward to your next visit!

name: John R.
text: Delicious donuts!!!  We were still talking about them several days later!  Well worth breaking your diet for a day.  During the current times, it may be a bit difficult to realize the fantastic selection they have, because you have to peek theough the window to see them all.  We didn't arrive when the outdoors kiosk was open but that is a nice alternative.  Drive-thru had a steady stream of cars, and we stood in line for a good 10 minutes.  All for good reason!!  Some of the best donuts we have ever tasted.

resp.text: Thank you for the 5-stars, John! We are delighted to know that you enjoy your doughnuts when you come and visit us. You must try everything once, you "doughnut” want to miss out. Come back soon!

name: Carl Lemon
text: Great customer service and the best donuts in Maine! No the best donuts in the world!

resp.text:
Hi Carl,
Thank you for the wonderful review! It makes us so happy to hear how much you enjoy us. We appreciate your continued support, and we're honored to the best in your eyes. Looking forward to your next visit!

name: Bill Lynch
text: This place is a must do if you're within 20 minutes. I'd describe how good these doughnuts are, but you wouldn't believe me. Just go.

name: Kham Inthirath
text: Get here early because the line forms quick after 8am. This is a must stop place for our vacation each year. The donuts are freshly made everyday and very soft and light. Just amazing!

resp.text:
Hi Kham,
We're glad to hear that Congdon's is a must stop for you while on vacation.  it's great to hear that our freshly made doughnuts are light and delicious for you.

name: Allison B
text: Waited in line a good twenty minutes to see what the fuss was all about. Not something I would do every week, but definitely worth the visit. Tons of selection, great coffee.

resp.text:
Hi Allison,
Thank you for checking us out! We're glad to hear that you enjoyed our selection and coffee. We appreciate your support, and hope you'll be back to visit us again soon!

name: Duska Colson
text: Awsome place to eat

resp.text: Thank you, Duska! We appreciate the 5 stars and your support. Please come back to visit us again soon.

name: Nick Carroll
text: Delicious and the freshest donuts.

resp.text:
Hi Nick,
Thank you for the 5 stars! We're glad to know that you enjoy us. Please come back again soon for more delicious and fresh goodies!

name: Ashlee Kittle
text:
While we didn't eat in the dinning room, they have an"grab and go" counter. We order our coffee, breakfast sandwiches and a few sweets. The eggs were fresh made REAL NEVER FROZEN eggs, which we loved.
The doughnuts are beautiful. We had the chocolate honey dipped, and we're very pleased. We also shared they blueberry fritter was amazing! Moist but not too heavy, and it was full of blueberries.
And the Whoopie pie was larger than my hand, and full of the cream filling. And when I say full I mean FULL!
OVER ALL, we received wonderful service, had an amazing breakfast and can't wait to come back!

resp.text:
Hi Ashlee,
It's great to hear all of your comments. We're glad that you loved your breakfast and treats. Thank you for your kind words.

name: Priscilla Arsenault
text: There is something for everyone at Congdons. Although I'm partial to their Chocolate Chocolate Donuts and their Blueberry Fritters, between the variety of choices of their donuts, scones, pastries, muffins, breads, etc, not to mention their restaurant where you can get a delicious home cooked breakfast or lunch, well, Congdons pleases everyone.

resp.text:
Hi Priscilla,
Thank you for all of your great comments about our delicious doughnuts, pastries, scones, muffins, breads, and of course our blueberry fritters and chocolate chocolate doughnuts. We love hearing that we have something delicious for everyone.We hope to see you again soon.

name: Marty Robinson
text: Wonderful staff and their maple bacon fritters are worth the trip. Carol, Gary and Seamus are very inviting and personable.

name: the Mayger family & friends
text: Great spot for homemade donuts!

resp.text:
Hi there,
Thank you for the wonderful review! We appreciate the kind words and support. Please come back to visit us again soon!

name: Daniel Pino
text:
**Ordered takeout during COVID pandemic

Food
*Honey dip & raspberry filled donuts - delicious

resp.text:
Hi Daniel,
Thank you for the review! We're happy to hear that you enjoyed your honey dipped and raspberry filled doughnuts. We appreciate your support, and look forward to having you back again soon!

name: Ron Terpstra
text: Quick service early in the morning. These donuts weight about a half pound each.

resp.text: Thank you for the 5 stars, Ron! Hope to see you back again, soon!

name: Michael Barros
text: Cool old fashioned donut shop that you just have to stop and try. Had the Blueberry fritter and a egg sandwich.

resp.text: Thanks for the awesome review, Michael! We're so happy to hear that you enjoyed your visit. We appreciate the support, and look forward to your next visit!

name: Joe Sorcic
text: Great donuts! Long lines at the drive thru, but the staff kept everything moving - great job! The wait was definitely worth it!

resp.text: Hi Joe, thank you for the amazing review! We are delighted that you enjoyed your doughnuts. We are also happy to hear our staff ensures fast service. We hope to see you soon!

name: Jeff Thurston
text: Pretty average for donuts. Really not sure what they're world famous for. There are many places better.

resp.text:
Hi Jeff,
Thank you for your feedback. We’re sorry to hear that your doughnuts were average. We do our very best to ensure that all of our guests have a wonderful experience with us and enjoy their doughnuts, and we’re bummed that wasn’t the case for you. We hope you’ll consider trying us again as we have many flavors and options you might like better!

name: Mary Pisch
text: Loved the doughnuts. So fresh!

resp.text:
Hi Mary,
Thank you for the wonderful review! We're so happy to hear how much you enjoyed your doughnuts. We look forward to having you back again soon for another 5 star experience!

name: Sharon Bollinger
text: This place is sooooo good! Every review that I read before we arrived.... spot on!!! Great food... great service.... and the doughnuts are out of this world good! This "must see" has been seen multiple times already and we will go back again this week before we leave. Do not come to Wells, Maine and pass this place up... you will be sorry!

resp.text: Definitely a must stop for everyone in the area! Thank you for your excellent review, Sharon. We are so happy you enjoyed. Hope to see you again soon!

name: Michele Weilnau
text:
I will travel all the way fr Ohio to maine just to have these most spectacular donuts. Nearly every kind you can think of. And are supremely the best ever
My favorite are the round white powdered on the outside with white cream(certainlynot Bavarian! ) filling on the inside. To die for.

resp.text: Thanks for making the trip to see us, Michele! We are so pleased to hear you find out doughnuts spectacular. Thanks for the amazing review. We look forward to your next trip!

name: Rick Storck
text: Great woopie pies!!!

resp.text:
Hi Rick,
Thanks for the 5 stars! We're happy to hear how much you enjoy the whoopy pies- please come back soon for more!

name: Bruce Locke
text: Best doughnuts

resp.text:
Hi Bruce,
Thank you for the 5 stars! We're honored to be the best in your eyes. We appreciate your support and can't wait for your next visit - we will continue to be doing our best for you.

name: Daris Boggs
text: Greatest donuts in the world! And an equally great breakfast menu! Great staff too!

resp.text:
Hi Daris,
We're thrilled to hear you think we're the greatest for doughnuts and breakfast. We hope you dine with us again soon!

name: Jennifer Moseley
text: Great breakfast stop. Prices are reasonable and food is excellent.

resp.text:
Hi Jennifer,
We're glad to be a great choice for you and appreciate all of your great comments. We hope to see you again soon.

name: T Armstrong
text: Tasty yum nummies for the wife.  Fast. Efficient and patient.to explain the donuts if you ask due to the Drive-through only COVID-19 policy.

resp.text:
Hi Tim,
Thank you for the 5-stars! We're glad your wife enjoys us - hope to see you back again soon!

name: Gus Wolf
text: Best donuts in town.

resp.text:
Hi Gus,
Thank you for the 5 stars! We're honored to be the best in your eyes. Your support is much appreciated, and we can't wait to see you again soon!

name: Roger Sabourin
text: Great donuts and good breakfast fare. Be ready to wait a bit but worth it

resp.text:
Hi Roger,
Thank you for the review! We're glad you enjoy us, and that we're worth the wait. We hope to see you back again soon!

name: Rich Stevens
text: Pricey but decent. In my opinion better than DnD but not worth the extra

resp.text: Thanks for your honest feedback, Rich! We're glad you like us, and we hope you will stop in to treat yourself when you can!

name: Shelly Terzolo
text: Best gluten free donuts!  Oh my yum!

resp.text:
Hey Shelly,
Thank you for the 5 stars! We're so glad that you enjoy our gluten-free doughnuts. We appreciate your support, and we can't wait to have you back again soon!

name: Mike Nicholas
text: The honey dipped donut is all-time.

resp.text: Thanks for the 5-stars, Mike! We're glad you enjoy the honey dipped - come back soon for more!

name: Joe Todd
text: My previous review was focused on the Trucks and Pups event to kick off the 2019 food truck season. While that was wonderful, every time i visit Congdon's, whether for breakfast, lunch or the food truck park, i have a great experience with outstanding food.  I can't say enough about this business.  I feel they genuinely care about me,  the customer, which is a rarity in our modern age of impersonal, get it now service. Show this business some love and you'll be rewarded tenfold.

resp.text: We're thrilled that Trucks and pups is a favorite for you, Joe!

name: Rory Benjamin
text: What a great donut shop, well worth visiting! It's a good thing that there is so much parking available, because on a Monday morning this place was absolutely packed with customers. The raspberry jelly donut was a fantastic choice. If I lived closer to Wells, I would be here every day!

resp.text: It's terrific, Rory, that you enjoy Congdon's! Thank you for all of your wonderful comments and sharing your favorite doughnuts with us.

name: Marcel Alix
text: Awesome donuts, little pricey.

resp.text:
Hi Marcel,
Thank you for the 5 stars! We're glad to be amazing in your eyes. Looking forward to your next visit!

name: Ethel Schiller
text: So delicious but so stinking expensive 😋

resp.text:
Hi Ethel,
Thank you for the 5 stars! We're glad you enjoy us, and we hope you can splurge ever once in awhile to come visit us. We can't wait to see you again soon!

name: Heather Peatman
text:
BEST DOUGHNUTS EVER
Made fresh in house, I don't know how they keep them on the shelves. This place has the best doughnuts I've ever had, and my Husband is a baker. Every time I'm on route 1 (in reality if I'm nearby at all) I stop in and get a Bakers Dozen. Prices are good, service is fast, and the eatin' is good. :)
EDIT: Thank you for response, I appreciate it! You can bet I will be back!

resp.text:
Hi Heather,
We are thrilled to hear that we are the best in your book!  That is quite a huge compliment.  We truly appreciate it.  We are glad that you enjoy our doughnuts and breakfasts dishes.  We hope to see you again soon.

name: Steve Gosselin
text: Great donuts.   Great breakfasts.

resp.text:
Hi Steve,
Thank you for the 5 stars! We're glad you enjoy us, and we appreciate your support. Hope to see you back again soon!

name: David E. Velau
text: Great doughnuts.  Always busy.  Love there breakfast.  Sometimes hard to find a parking spot.

resp.text:
Hi David,
Thank you for the review! We are so happy that you love our doughnuts and breakfasts. See you soon!

name: Peter Guilfoyle
text: Decent  food, always cold, overpriced

resp.text:
Hi Peter,
We're glad that you enjoy our food and appreciate your review. Thank you for stopping in, we hope to take care of you again.

name: Alan Henderson
text: Best donuts around, end of story. Sit down breakfast is also amazing, albeit a little expensive. Hey the Irish Benedict and ask for a biscuit instead be of English muffin. Also, maple bacon fritters... Expect crowds and waits almost all the time. Also be aware they run out of some donut varieties early.

resp.text:
Hi Alan,
We love hearing that our doughnuts are the best and that our breakfast is also amazing.Thank you for all of your great comments. We're always more than happy to to make accommodations for our guests and we hope to see you again soon.

name: Mango
text: I've been going here for the delicious donuts for years, but only recently sat down for breakfast at the restaurant. Food was delicious, and the service was really above and beyond outstanding.

resp.text:
Hi Mango,
We are so happy to hear this! Your kind words really mean a lot to us, and we appreciate your continued business. See you soon!

name: Morgan
text: The food is delicious whether you are getting breakfast or lunch. Best eggs benedict around! You must try the doughnuts! Friendly staff.

resp.text:
Hi Morgan,
Thank you for the review! Your kind words mean a lot to us. Please come back and visit us again soon!

name: Dan Gill
text: Great breakfast. Waitress was very nice. Can review the doughnuts I don't eat them 😁

resp.text:
Hi Dan,
We're happy to hear that you enjoyed your breakfast and service. We have many breakfast items on our menu, so there will always be something yummy for you to order! We can't wait to see you again soon.

name: Tom Keane
text: Best donuts in Maine

resp.text: Thanks, Tom! We may be a little biased, but we agree with you and we promise to keep serving you the best doughnuts. See you again soon!

name: Aaron Schoff
text: Fantastic group of young people who work here during the summer(ALL the employees in fact!!)Summer can be absolutely nuts with the line out the door often and when Ive been there I notice  they  always seem to handle the pressure very well,  the wait isnt really that long..Well worth the wait !!

name: Erin DYER
text: Very quick service with a smile, hot fresh tasty food! Homefries were perfectly soft inside and crunchy outside.

resp.text:
Hi Erin,
Thank you for the wonderful review! It makes us happy to hear that you food was delicious and that you received such great service! We look forward to your next visit.

name: Brent Johnston
text: Food and service were outstanding.  Favorite spot to go when in the area.  Great value!!!

resp.text:
Hi Brent,
Thank you for the fantastic review! It's always a pleasure having you, and we look forward to your next visit!

name: SirSmartyPants
text: I've been here twice now for breakfast and both times the food was excellent. I didn't need to eat the until dinner lol

resp.text:
Hi Sir Smartypants Ruel,
Thanks for the review! We're glad to hear you've enjoyed your breakfast both times you've come to visit. Please come back and see us again soon!

name: Tim Janis Team Barbara
text: Great food, the best donuts and smiling helpful staff make this a great place to go.

resp.text:
Hi Barbara,
Thank you - your kind words mean a lot to us! We look forward to your next visit.

name: Tami Marcoux
text: The best donuts

resp.text:
Hi Tami,
Thanks for the 5 stars! We're glad to your that you enjoy us. We appreciate your support, and look forward to your next visit!

name: Jessie Caldwell
text: I have loved this place as long as I can remember.

resp.text:
Hi Jessie,
Thank you for the great review! We are thrilled to hear that you have loved us for so long. It's always a pleasure serving you!

name: Lonna Bowie
text: food is very good..service is good and fast. large variety of delicious homemade donuts

resp.text: Hi Lonna, thanks for the awesome review, we're so glad that you enjoy the doughnuts.

name: kelly
text: Fresh and delicious.  These donuts are 27.00 dollars for a bakers dozen but they are good. Also get there early or you'll be waiting in line for quite a while.

resp.text:
Hi Kelly,
it's great to hear that our doughnuts are always delicious for you! We look forward to your next visit.

name: John Fellian
text: The donuts are top shelf, hands down.  But this place REALLY rocks because of Congdon's After Dark.  Rotating lineup of fantastic food trucks.  You guys are visionaries.  Thank you!

resp.text: John, thank you for your kind words! We are so happy to hear you enjoy our doughnuts and our food trucks. Thanks for leaving us an amazing review. We hope to see you again soon!

name: Nathan Sawyer
text: Great service and good food

resp.text:
Hi Nathan,
We're glad to hear that our service and food were great for you!

name: Connie Ryan
text: Fabulous doughnuts!! So fresh and delicious.  We read so many great reviews we had to try it for ourselves during April break. Some of the best doughnuts around. Quality!!

resp.text:
Hi Connie,
We're glad that our reputation brought you in to give our delicious treat a try! Thank you for letting us know that our doughnuts are some of the best for you.

name: Bill Barbin
text: Super amazing pastries and food truck park

resp.text: Thanks for the 5-stars, Bill! We're glad to hear that you enjoy our doughnut shop and After Dark food trucks. Looking forward to your next visit!

name: Marie Kirk
text: Always a good meal/donuts! I had Eggs Florentine. Delicious & instead of toast I had a donut...which I will enjoy later..Becca was our fabulous  server..have been coming to Moody Beach for 42+ years..vacation  not complete without a few visits to Congdon!!

resp.text:
Hi Marie,
Thank you for letting us know that you always have a great meal and doughnuts with us! We love being a staple and hearing that no vacation is complete without a trip to Congdon's.

name: Karen Perron
text: The best doughnuts!

resp.text:
Hi Karen,
Thanks for the 5-stars! We're glad you enjoy us - hope to see you again soon!

name: Daniel Vermeersch
text: Always good service, even when the line is long.

resp.text:
Hi Daniel,
Thank you for the review! We're glad to hear that you always receive great service - hope to see you again soon!

name: Christine Studley
text: Food and service are great. Hostess was a real nasty person.

resp.text: Hi Christine, we are happy to hear you enjoyed the food and service, thanks for the great review.

name: deborah eaton
text: Long time family favorite. Something for everyone. Come early, it's always busy, but lines move very quickly.

resp.text:
Hi Deborah,
We're glad to be a long time favorite and are glad to have something for everyone. We look forward to your next visit.

name: Tony Sanches
text: Home made fresh donuts and muffins.  Great pancakes you can eat in or take out.  Great for the whole family

resp.text:
Hi Tony,
We're glad that so many of our delicious treats are great for you and the family. We look forward to seeing you again soon.

name: Tony Whitaker
text: Definitely place to experience. Remarkable doughnuts. And at night the food trucks are amazing

resp.text: Thank you, Tony! We are glad to hear you enjoy both the doughnuts and food trucks. Come visit again soon!

name: david mispel
text: I have been going to Congdons for many years. I don't know if they can't get help or what I got there around 8:30 and the selection was minimal the donuts I did get were awesome as always but it seemed like something was off. Happy weight gain

resp.text:
Hi David,

Thanks for the review and feedback. We are so happy to hear you enjoyed the doughnuts you were able to try. Unfortunately, we aren't always able to predict the traffic and we sell out quickly. We hope you visit us again soon to try more of our delicious doughnuts!

name: Marcia Cummings
text: Absolutely the best doughnuts in Maine! The whoopie pies too! The restaurant is amazing and the lobster Benedict is fantastic!

resp.text:
Hi Marcia,
Thanks for your great review! We're so happy that you enjoyed our lobster benedict and woopie pies! We hope to serve you again soon.

name: Mark Laferriere
text: Best donuts PERIOD...

resp.text:
Hi Mark,
Thanks so much for the 5 stars! We are honored to be the best in your eyes. Your support is appreciated, and we can't wait for your next visit!

name: Jerrod Lassor
text: the food, the service, the coffee, the atmosphere itself..... always amazing!

resp.text: Hi Jerrod, thanks for the kind review, you're amazing!

name: Gordon Whittemore
text: Stopped up to Congdon’s donuts. the donuts are huge and excellent you’ve actually got to try one. my wife actually bought two Whoopie pie’s which were huge also and great. Well back up here again I guess you can’t stay away really good donuts they now open at 6 AM and close at 2 PM gives you enough time to get a few donuts

resp.text:
Hi Gordon,
It's fantastic to hear that our doughnuts are excellent and huge! Thanks for all of your great comments.

name: Donna Sgrignuoli
text: Congdon's has the best donuts in the area. Sometimes i drive the 35 minutes just for their delicious donuts.

resp.text:
Hi Donna,
Thanks for making the drive just to see us! We're flattered. Hope you come again soon!

name: Tom Gramling
text: Never fails to be great. I look forward to getting Congdon's doughnuts whenever I get up to Maine. I love this place.

resp.text:
Hi Tom,
We are thrilled to hear your experience with us is always great! Thanks for the wonderful review. Can't wait until your next visit!

name: Holly Foresta
text: Its always the best part of heading south. The new overflow parking is great. The counter, doughnut crew, are fabulous! 25 people in line doesn't fluster them at all. Once you, quickly, get to the front of the line they fill your order in no time. Love it!

resp.text:
Hi Holly,
Thank you for the love and kind words. We're glad that our doughnuts, and staff are fantastic for you. We hope to see you again soon.

name: Vicki Matthews
text:
A bit pricey BUT well worth trying them.     8" honey bun, 8" Bismarck, chocolate bacon.
Very yummy.

resp.text:
Hi Vicki,
We're glad that you enjoy our doughnuts and appreciate your kind words.

name: Michelle Pascua
text: Wow what a large selection of doughnuts! My husband loves their coconut cake doughnuts and my son likes their honey dip (just like a glazed) doughnuts. It's right on route one in Wells. There's also a little restaurant attached but we haven't gotten past the doughnut shop to wander in there. 😂

resp.text: Hi Michelle, thank you for your excellent review, we appreciate you taking the time to not only try our doughts but to tell us about your experience as well.

name: Andrew Kraft
text: I will drive an hour out of my way for these doughnuts.

resp.text: Thank you for the marvelous 5-stars, Andrew! We are happy you enjoy our doughnuts so much you drive an hour for them. We very much appreciate your support and we look forward to your next visit!

name: Therese O'Brien
text: Best donuts! Fritters are great and the honey buns make the best French toast.

resp.text:
Hi Therese,
We are so happy to hear you love our fritters and french toast. Thanks for the fantastic review. Come join us again soon!

name: Daryl Johnson
text: We got there 5 minutes before closing time, they still seated us and gave us good cheerful service.  Good food.

resp.text: We were happy to serve you, Daryl! Thanks for taking the time to leave us an amazing review and letting us know how cheerful the service was. Hope you visit again soon!

name: Joseph Fellows
text: The service was very nice.  Their doughnuts really are worth it.  Highly recommend.

resp.text: We appreciate the nice words, Joseph. Glad we're worth it! Hope to see you back soon!

name: Cynthia Ward
text: AWESOME DONUTS!!!! ALWAYS BUSY! PARKING IS A LITTLE STICKY! NOT A FAN OF THEIR BREAKFAST SANDWICHES!

resp.text:
Hi Cynthia,
Thank you for your review, we are so happy to hear that you enjoyed the doughnuts! We hope that our fast and friendly service made up for the busy day! we hope to see you again soon.

name: Jon Abulencia
text: The donuts are great, but so is the breakfast and service. A must visit if you're in the area!

resp.text:
Hi Jon,
We're happy to hear that our doughnuts are great and so are the breakfast dishes and service.  Thanks for making us a must stop destination for you.

name: Andrew McGuire
text: Best Doughnuts in Maine. Delicious Breakfast. Always visit at least once when in Wells

resp.text:
Hi Andrew,

Thanks for the fantastic review. We are proud to hear we're the best! Come visit us again soon.

name: Kim Grady
text: Love everything..must stop when in Maine

resp.text: Hello Kim, Thank you so much for the 5-stars! We’re happy to hear that we are a must-stop whenever you’re in town. We appreciate your support, and we look forward to your next visit!

name: Bradley
text: was delicious fast great service

resp.text:
Hi Brad,
Thank you for the 5 stars! We're thrilled to hear that you had a wonderful experience with us. it was a pleasure having you, and we look forward to seeing you again soon!

name: Wayne Michaud
text: Donuts are great very tasty and yummy

resp.text: Thank you for the review, Wayne! We are glad you enjoyed your doughnuts. We hope to see you back soon!

name: LaLa !
text: Always delicious breakfast make sure you get a pot of tea

resp.text:
Hi LaLa,
Thank you for your kind review, we are so glad that you enjoyed the tea!

name: John Jacobs IV
text: A bit pricey, bit best donuts in town.

resp.text: Hi John, thank you for your review, we appreciate your time and business!

name: Dennis Brummett
text: I cant even discribe the taste of these donuts. Imagine a crispy cream and times it by a 100

resp.text: Wow! Thanks so much for the wonderful comment, Daniel! We're glad to know that you absolutely love our donuts. Come back soon for some more!

name: William de Figueiredo
text: Better donuts you won't find.

resp.text: Thanks for the 5-star review, William! We're glad you like us. We look forward to your next visit!

name: David Yarckin
text: Breakfast is delicious! I highly recommend Congdon's ! Great staff too (especially Natalia !)

resp.text: Thanks for the incredible review and recommendation, David! Hope you dine with us again soon!

name: Mark Barnes
text: Very popular spot in Wells and parking can be tight. I tried the Blueberry Fritter. It was pretty awesome.

resp.text:
Hi Mark,
Thank you for letting us know that our blueberry fritter was awesome! We hope to see you again soon.

name: Patricia Eggleston
text: Most delicious doughnuts !!

resp.text:
Hi Patricia,
Thank you so much for the review! We're happy to hear that you enjoy our doughnuts. We appreciate your support, and look forward to your next visit!

name: Linda Yeaton
text: Best doughnuts ever!!  Great food & service..

resp.text: Thank you, Linda! So proud to hear you think we're the best and you received great service. Hope you join us again soon!

name: Clara Jacobs
text: this place is a place full of good memories for me. I grew up in Wells and would go here with my parents all the time. If my father was working I would make it a date with my mother. They also donated their muffins/donuts to my high school Alternative Education program which meant a lot to me and other students at the time. They have the best homemade corned beef hash I have ever been so lucky to eat. I crave it often and gives me a good reason to go back home. I haven't been to their after dark food truck events yet but i love food trucks and I'm glad they have set something up to bring them together in one spot.

resp.text:
Hi Clara,
We love hearing that Congdon's holds so many terrific memories for you. Thank you for sharing your terrific experiences with us, we certainly appreciate all of your kind words. We look forward to seeing you again soon.

name: Tony Griffiths
text: Wow! Great donuts and coffee. I arrived late and they didnt have a donut I wanted, so they specially made one for me. Thank you!

resp.text:
Hi Tony,
It's wonderful to hear that our doughnuts and coffee are terrific for you! We're always glad to help out and we hope to see you again soon.

name: Robert Kelley
text: Must visit destination! Great donuts!!

resp.text:
Hi Robert,
Thank you for the kind review! We're so honored that we are a must-visit destination in your books, and that you enjoy our doughnuts. We look forward to your next visit!

name: Fly Fisherman
text: Great dinner. The service was good even at the last hour of being open. The honey dipped donut was moist, but firm. Delicious. The corned beef eggs benedict was full of flavor. The corned beef was very dry, but the eggs did their job and moistened everything up well.

resp.text:
Hi Steve,
We're glad to hear that your meal with us was so tasty and that our honey dip was just as delicious.

name: Paul Kapchus
text: Delicious breakfast. My understanding is the donuts are to die for, didn't have the chance to try one but I promise I will next visit.

resp.text: Thank you for letting us know that your breakfast was delicious, Paul! We look forward to your next visit.

name: STRONGER Michelle Long
text: Best donut I have ever eaten and well worth every single calorie!!!

resp.text: Thank you, Michelle! Glad you think our doughnuts are worth it! Hope to see you again soon!

name: John Cook
text: Great breakfast and of course donuts, staff pleasant and personable, decor is in need of sprucing up. A great place!

resp.text:
Hi John,
We're glad that our breakfast is great and our doughnuts of course were delicious! Thank you for all of your great feedback.

name: Stephen Lareau
text: Best doughnuts, great food truck park, friendly staff.

resp.text: Hi Stephen, thanks for your awesome review!

name: Robert Gregory
text: Best donuts i have had. If you are in maine it is a most stop. Just a warning they are pricey but worth it

resp.text: Thanks for the amazing review, Robert. We hope you come again soon!

name: Thomas Dube
text: Must stop when visiting Wells and noe cocktails to go.

resp.text:
Hey Thomas,
Thanks for the awesome review! We're happy to hear that you enjoy us and stop in every time you're in town. We appreciate your support, and look forward to your next visit!

name: Christopher O'brien
text: Gr8 donuts.

resp.text:
Hi Christopher,
Thank you for the great review! We're so glad you enjoy us - hope to see you back again soon!

name: Gi na
text: This place has some amazing donuts! My family and I venture to Congdons often because we know that no other donuts compare at all. Sometimes we meet a line as there are others like us who want to enjoy them as well but they are so worth the wait. They have a place to sit and out and even have a drive through! Staff is great!

resp.text:
Hi Gina,
We're glad to hear all of your fantastic comments and think it's great that our doughnuts are amazing for you. We hope to see you again soon.

name: Bram Warrick
text:
Great selection of very good donuts. Good, responsive service.

If the weather is good, consider getting some donuts/breakfast and heading to a beach for sunrise. It's not far and makes for a great start to the day.

resp.text:
Hi Bram,
We're glad that you enjoy our variety of doughnuts and that our service is top-notch for you. We're glad that Congdon's is a fantastic way to start your day!

name: Elizabeth Tilton
text: Delicious breakfast! This is a cozy, adorable place to have a great breakfast!

resp.text: Thank you so much, Elizabeth! It's wonderful to hear that we are cozy and adorable. Looking forward to our next chance to serve you!

name: Allen Myers
text: Most impressive freshest donuts you will find.  Glad we tried it out to see what all the talk was about.

resp.text:
Hi Allen,
We appreciate your kind words. We are thrilled to hear we're the most impressive and glad you tried us out, too. We hope you come back soon!

name: Danny Alexander
text: Awesome we will stopping on the way out of town to take some wonderful baked goods and donuts home!

resp.text:
Hi Danny,
Thank you for letting us know that you enjoyed your visit and have already planned your next one to take some of our tasty doughnuts back home with you.

name: Chelsey j
text: Great food, friendly staff, amazing food

resp.text:
Hi Chelsey,
Thank you for the 5-star review! We are so happy that you enjoy our food and service. We look forward to your next visit!

name: Judith Myers
text: Good food good prices

resp.text: Hi Judith, thanks for the amazing review :)

name: Rob Zapp
text: Doughnuts were great. Cannot go wrong with anything on the menu

resp.text:
Hi Rob,
We're glad that our doughnuts were great for you! Thank you for your great comments.

name: Rachael Cianci
text: I don’t even like doughnuts, yet I can eat 5 of them if they’re from Congdon’s. You’ll never want a doughnut from Dunks again

resp.text:
Hi Rachael,
We're happy to hear that our donuts made you change your mind! We hope to see you again soon.

name: Deanna Enis
text: Absolutely amazing donuts. Have to get there early to beat the lines.

resp.text:
Hi Deanna,
It's wonderful to hear that our doughnuts are amazing and we appreciate all of your comments.

name: Brian Spinney
text: The donuts are so good!! But if you get donuts to go, don't let them stack the donuts in the to go bag when the frosting is soft. The frosting comes off when you pull the wrapper off. But, best donuts in the area, great service too! We went back. Again, and I promise these donuts are delicious! But our problem was that they stack the donuts so that when you take them out of the bag, the frosting is wiped off. I called them. The lady said we've been doing this for 60 years. But she was friendly and gave us a coupon for a bakers dozen. We went back and the girl was very very helpful and friendly. This place has nice people and very good donuts. But we got home and took the donuts out. The frosting was completely smeared. There was frosting everywhere.  They really really need to change the to go policy. It stinks getting a donut that has been cooked to perfection, only to have it ruined by the frosting being stuck to the bag.

resp.text:
Hi Brian,
It's great to hear how delicious our doughnuts are for you and we appreciate your recommendations.

name: Ryan Eling
text: Went here for their late night for truck adventure. Nice assortment of options, but it was crazy busy and half the trucks we not prepared properly. Probably a great option for after 8, when families are gone.

resp.text:
Hi Ryan,
Thank you for joining us and your feedback. We certainly understand that our truck park has been pretty busy as we have officially opened for the season. We will pass your feedback on to our vendors to ensure that we are taking the best care of our guests.

name: Katie Thurlow
text: I mean they aren't the Holy Donut, which are my favorite donuts in the world, but this place comes in close second! It is a mile away from me and super dangerous to have that close. Great place! Congdons after dark is so fun come summer as well!

resp.text: We're proud to have doughnuts that you enjoy, Katie! We hope to see you again soon.

name: Jon Nasella
text: Excellent product. Could be better organized tho

resp.text:
Hi Jon,
Thank you for letting us know that our food and treats are great for you.

name: Jerry Leone
text: The best, hands down, no questions asked blueberry fritters on the planet. I use the drive thru, quicker then standing in line. Only drawback to that is you can't see everything they have to offer behind the counter. If there were 6 🌟 they would get it. Enjoy!

resp.text:
Hi Jerry,
We're proud to hear that our blueberry fritters the best for you and that you found a good way to avoid our lines. Thank you for all of your great comments.

name: Marlene Guay
text: Didn't care for the clam chowder, (too thick) otherwise taste was fine. Good atmosphere,good service,friendly staff, purchased 2 doughnuts on the way out What an amazing treat,they were awesome!

resp.text:
Hi Marlene,
We appreciate your feedback on our clam chowder, but glad to hear that our staff took great care of you and that everything was tasty. We noticed that the rating that you left doesn't reflect your great comments. The rating is a one to five star, with five being the best. Would you consider changing your rating to reflect your kind words? We look forward to seeing you again soon.

name: Kevin Shepley
text: Stopped in with my wife and had the Sausage and Gravy biscuits and it was unbelievable. Great service and very attentive.

resp.text:
Hi Kevin,
Thank you for visiting and for letting us know that our Sausage Gravy and biscuits were unbelievable. We hope to see you again soon.

name: Andy Dufresne
text: Excellent breakfast value. Outstanding doughnuts. Always pick up an extra dozen for the ride home.

name: Rosanna Steffen
text: I had their blueberry pancakes.  Lots of blueberries.  I should have gone with regular stack.  The large? Was too big for me.  My husband is not a pancake person so I wanted excellent food.

resp.text:
Hi Rosanna,
We're glad that our blueberry pancakes were delicious and plentiful! We hope to see you again soon.

name: RP .RTP
text: Best donuts in Maine ! Love the fritters!

resp.text: Thanks for your awesome review, we are honored to be called the best! We hope to serve you again soon.

name: Emily St. Amand
text: Amazing donuts and atmosphere! Lovely staff here.

resp.text:
Hi Emily,
We love hearing how amazing our doughnuts and atmosphere is. Thank you for your kind words.

name: kyle brown
text: If you like donuts it's a place you have to stop at, there's actually a little dining section in there where they server food as well. Great food and people stop in if your around the area!

resp.text:
Hi Kyle,
Thank you for your recommendations and great comments. We're glad that our doughnuts and food are delicious for you. We look forward to seeing you again soon.

name: Elizabeth Pockl
text: The Best Doughnuts you will ever have. They are the classic doughnut, that can't be beat. The breakfast id great too! Feels like family.

resp.text:
Hi Elizabeth,
It's fantastic to hear that our doughnuts are the best for you! Thank you for all of your great comments.

name: Jessica Reynolds
text: The most delicious donuts around!! Breakfast biscuit was one of the best we've had!

resp.text: We're glad that our doughnuts are delicious and our biscuit was the best for you, Jessica!

name: Lauren Chan
text: There is a reason it is always busy!  Donuts are delicious and made fresh. They have a great deal on breakfast too. Well worth the wait.

resp.text:
Hi Lauren,
We're glad to be well worth the wait for you and appreciate all of your great comments about our doughnuts and breakfast!

name: Sara Donlon
text: Absolutely the Best Donuts I have ever had in my Life! The raised donuts are so light and fluffy and they all just have the most unique and delicious flavor. Breakfast was delicious as well and served at lightening speed! Every employee working is full of smiles :-) All around a Great experience!

resp.text:
Hi Sara,
We are thrilled to hear that we make the best doughnuts for you!  We are proud to have some of the very best wait staff in the area.  Thank you for your very kind words, we really appreciate it.  We hope to see you again soon.

name: Adam Booker
text: Simply amazing donuts.

resp.text:
Hi Adam,
Thank you for the fantastic review! We are so glad you enjoy us. We look forward to seeing you again soon!

name: Paul Morris
text: Fantastic as always. This is a place you have to go.

resp.text: Thanks for the kind words, Paul! We're happy to hear you think we are fantastic. Looking forward to your next visit!

name: Eric Lawson
text: Always a great place to stop to grab a bite to eat. Whether you go for the world famous donuts, or stop by in the evening for the food truck park, you can't go wrong at Congdon's!

resp.text:
Hi Eric,
It's wonderful to hear that our doughnuts are great and that between our restaurant and food truck park, Congdon's is always a great choice. We hope to see you again soon.

name: Dexter Thompson
text: Very delicious doughnuts & good service.

resp.text:
Hello Dexter,
Thank you for your fantastic review. We strive to make breakfast delicious and quick and are glad we hit the mark with you! We hope to see you soon :)

name: Charrie Shockey
text: Fantastic selection of donuts, just didn't have time to sample them all! We opted for a sit-down meal in the attached restaurant and had to wait about 20 min for a table. I had an apple fritter donut with my meal, and it was delicious.

resp.text:
Hi Charrie,
It's great to hear that our selection of doughnuts is great for you and that you enjoyed your meal with us. We hope to see you again soon.

name: Al
text:
The food is really bad and overpriced, if you’re gonna go just go for the doughnuts. I went for breakfast and was served burnt pancakes...like black. They didn’t offer to remake them or anything so I just never went back.
However, my mom goes to Maine very often and she loves going here for their doughnuts

resp.text:
Hello Alyssa,
Thank you for bringing this issue from your last visit to our attention. We strive to give all of our guests an excellent experience, and we apologize that we fell short. We do hope you will join your mother on her next visit and allow us the opportunity to wow you with our food.

name: Dash Beaujippers
text: The doughnuts are fantastic but if you want the best selection you have to get there early! Don't get me wrong, they still had plenty at 9:30 a.m. when we went but we missed out on the doughnut twists. They offered a substitution of a regular shaped yeast doughnut with the sugar on it (which was still good) but there's something about that twisty shape that makes it more delicious :-) So...... next time my butt will be there sooner! Lol Great little place! Yum yum.

resp.text:
Hi Dash,
We're glad that our doughnuts are delicious and appreciate your comments.

name: Patrick Fallon
text:
Good donut
Get there early for any decent selections. Favorites go early. Would be 5 stars but... 2 bucks a donught... Kinda hurts.... Don't it...

resp.text:
Hi Patrick,
Thank you for your comments and recommendations. We hope to see you again soon.

name: Joe Todd
text: Always the best tasting and highest quality good for reasonable prices. Staff is very friendly. Worth the wait any time as the lines tell the tale.

resp.text:
Hi Joe,
It's great to hear that our doughnuts are the best for you and our staff takes the best care. We look forward to your next visit.

name: Preston Warden
text: This place has wonderful food and service. The one downside is there is no room to park or sit. They have packed way too much into a small area. Need to expand some.

resp.text:
Hi Preston,
We're glad to hear that we have terrific service and food. We hope to see you again soon.

name: Scott Anderson
text: Went to Congdons after dark food truck event, very impressed.  Great atmosphere, great food, great people.  Palms to Pines has the best empanadas I have ever tasted and Congdons has the best donuts.  Very impressed!

resp.text: Thank you for joining us, Scott! We're glad to hear that the atmosphere, food, and people were great! We hope to see you again soon.

name: Kristin Beaney
text: Best donuts. Reminds me of a local bakery when I was a kid.

resp.text:
Hi Kristin,
Thank you for letting us know that our doughnuts are the best!

name: Michael Richards
text: Great donuts. Good selection.

resp.text: Thanks, Michael! Hope to see you again soon!

name: Kelly Hassett
text: Great portions, excellent quality, gotta go to Congdons if you're in Wells

resp.text:
Hi Kelly,
Thanks for your recommendations and comments. We're glad that our food is great for you.

name: Andrew Jenson
text: Very good donuts worth the line you stand in

resp.text: Thanks for your kind words, Andrew. We are so happy to hear you think we're worth a wait and that you enjoy our doughnuts. We hope to serve you again soon!

name: Jennifer D
text: Great food! Staff is the best! Donuts are worth the drive from anywhere!

resp.text:
Hi Jennifer,
It's terrific that our staff and dishes are great for you. We love hearing how delicious our doughnuts are and that they are worth the drive.

name: Ellen Rudert
text: This place is awesome, definitely will go back...food, wait staff,fabulous 5 stars for service and food

resp.text:
Hi Ellen,
We're thrilled that you enjoy visiting Congdon's! Thank you for sharing your wonderful comments with us.

name: Emily C. Jones
text: Delicious donuts and breakfast sandwiches. This isn't open all day but they do have a Congdon's After Dark food truck in their parking lot. Very fast!

resp.text:
Hi Emily,
we're glad to hear that our doughnuts and breakfast sandwiches are delicious for you. Thank you for your great comments.

name: Shannon Kelley
text: Best donuts I've ever had

resp.text:
Hi Shannon,
It's fantastic to hear that our tasty doughnuts are the best you have ever had.

name: Rebekah Kirsanov
text: The eggs were a little mushy, coffee was a light roast, and two out of three of my bacon strips where burnt to a crisp. The toast and the doughnut were excellent though, and so was the service. A good waitress is worth 10 strips of burnt bacon. This place is definitely a bakery before a restaurant, but still definitely worth stopping to spend some money.

resp.text:
Hi Rebekah,
It's great to hear that our service was fantastic and our doughnuts were excellent! We appreciate all of your comments and are disappointed that your breakfast wasn't as tasty. We would have gladly replaced your meal as we always want our guests to have the best experience with us. We hope that you will give us another try.

name: Annette Desjardins
text: Great fresh doughnuts.

resp.text: Thanks for the review, Annette! We hope to see you back again soon.

name: Greg Wilhelm
text: Don't let long lines fool you. I gave them a second try before writing this review. Granted I've only tried the donuts. Both times I was very disappointed. My wife loves Bravarian Creme. She ordered Bravarian Creme. What they gave her was Boston Creme. I felt adventurous and ordered "Chocolate Crunch" which turned out to be Plain Chocolate with some kind of nutty topping. I should've ordered it plain. Once I got the nutty topping scraped off with just a finger, it wasn't bad. All in all, next time I'm in the neighborhood, if it weren't for the long lines, I might consider stopping.

resp.text:
Hello Greg,
We appreciate you giving us a second try and are sorry to hear that you and your wife were disappointed. We do have a plethora of other items that you may find better suited to your taste. We honestly do not receive many comments about our doughnuts not being the best for one of our guests, but we understand that we are not for everyone. We hope that you will stop back in and give one of our other treats a try.

name: Bob R
text: Great donuts.  Everything else just ok and high priced.

resp.text:
Hi Bob,
We are so happy to hear you think our doughnuts are great. Our prices are made to match the quality and fresh ingredients used in every dish. We hope you can understand, and come back again soon!

name: Todd Andrews
text: Great food. Worth the wait. A Wells icon. It's pricey, but they can get away with it. Get the French toast style honey bun and you'll save money by not needing to eat for the rest of the day.

resp.text:
Hi Todd,
Thank you for your great comments and recommendations. It's great to hear how much you enjoy our dishes. We hope to see you again soon.

name: Chris Giguere
text: I cannot believe  in the 30 years I've been going over to the beach that I've never been here,this place is awesome I've eaten my share of doughnuts n this was THE BEST DOUGHNUT IVE EVER EATEN! lol ,not only that but the service at the counter was spot on pro from how one lady handled a customer that cut in line to the cashier that had a smile on her face the whole time I was in line.i was in the food service biz for over 30 years n super good job at congdons all the way around!!

resp.text:
Hi Chris,
Thank you for giving us a try! We're thrilled to have the best doughnut you have ever eaten and to hear that our staff were great for you. We always want to take the best care of our guests and it's wonderful to hear that we are hitting the mark with you.

name: Daniel DeOliveira
text: Fabulous doughnuts

resp.text:
Hello Daniel,
Thank you for the 5-stars! We are delighted to hear that our doughnuts are fabulous in your eyes. Looking forward to your next visit!

name: Rebecca Bense
text: We go here every year near Mom and Dad's anniversary. Food is good.Service is excellent. Go in and have sit down breakfast and order donuts from you waitress...skipping the ultra long lines for the best donuts around!

resp.text:
Hi Rebecca,
We're glad to be a staple for you and to hear your great comments about our food and staff. We look forward to your next trip in.

name: Chuck Fuller
text: If you have not tried Congdon's Doughnuts, you have missed out on one of the world's eating pleasures.  Fantastic homemade donuts, great breakfast and lunch menu - have tried many of the items on the menu and never had a bad meal.  Well worth the 1.5 hour ride over for breakfast!

resp.text:
Hi Chuck,
Thank you for your kind words.  We are delighted to hear that we have the best doughnuts in New England!  We hope to see you again soon.

name: David Bianchi
text: Got to Congdon's drive thru for my birthday.  Got a great big Breakfast Burrito and enjoyed every bite.  look forward to going again

resp.text:
Hi David,
Thank you for giving us a try! We're thrilled that you enjoyed your experience with us and look forward to seeing you again.

name: Sebastian Ruscansky
text: Amazing doughnuts....great service...a real local gem!

resp.text: We're glad to be a local favorite and appreciate hearing that our doughnuts are amazing, Sebastian! We look forward to your next visit.

name: Kris Clough
text: A little pricy, I think, but the best doughnuts in York County!

resp.text:
Hi Kris,
We're glad that our doughnuts are the best for you!

name: Caleb Valley
text: Pretty solid food, crazy busy (it's summertime so expected) food is a little bland but the doughnuts are very good. Service was good as well

resp.text:
Hi Caleb,
It's disappointing to hear that your meal was bland. We always want our guests to have the best experience possible and would have been more than happy to replace your meal. We appreciate your feedback and hope to see you again soon.

name: Promise Pretzels
text: A favorite place to visit when in Wells. My daughter's fab is the chocolate croissant...mine the sesame bagel. Really loved the food truck park in the summer...especially the benoits!

resp.text:
Hi Promise Pretzels,

name: QUINNY
text:
5 star rating with a negative experience...
15 min. wait for seating found us at the bar getting a libation.
Blueberry Lemonade was a hit! Very flavorful.
I ordered a "sour" beer. When I asked the bartender what made it sour and what flavor was it he responded...verbatim..."Dude, I don't know. You need to Google it because I'm to busy"
Really? Isn't his job customer service? Shouldn't he know what the beers are all about on his menu?
This guy should only be busing tables because interacting with customers is NOT his fortee!
Now the really good part...
Our awesome server HALEY C came to the rescue once we were seated.
Great personality, excellent customer service abilities and a self proclaimed beer geek.
She told us that the beer the idiot (my word not hers) bartender sold me  wasn't a sour...which I could tell from its taste.
She told me actually what makes a beer sour and that is a great touch for an UBER knowledgeable server.
Set me up with a tart beer that was tasty...see pic.
We ordered our food. With the place hopping on a Sat. afternoon, service was very fast.
Mac and cheese with Chix was bubbly hot, tasty and moist Chix.
The Spinach and Fennel Salad was good, a bit small and very little fennel...see pics. But very fresh and tasty.
Oh yah...this place is known for pizza and what we saw sure looked good...try that.
With the day saved by Haley C. I would recommend this place highly on your next visit to Ogunquit.
My advice...hire more like people Haley C.

name: Stephen Arlaud
text: This is such a nice vintage type building with old time flare and architecture. The facade is undergoing restoration and prepped for repairing and painting. The workers are doing the excellent prep work with the shop open for business. I got to say the prep is just amazing and your able to see multiple layers of different color paint over the years. The interior is very nice with yesteryear type metal ceilings. You are able to see the large kitchen area where they make the candy through the windows. As for the candy, it’s just perfect and tasty. They also have sugar-free and vegan type selections along with traditional. We usually always walk up here to shop after walking Marginal Way Oceanside trail. The only thing I will mention is the shop packages your purchases in paper bags with handles instead of usual plastic bags which is very environmentally friendly. We purchased about a pound or two of candy and back to the trail. The paper handles tore out and my bag fell. The sides also started ripping out, my reason for bringing this up is to suggest that you ask for double bagging or a box maybe and hold the bag around the bottom. My suggestion is for Harbor Candy is to get more sturdy paper bags with thicker and stronger paper and better reinforced handles. When I go to Trader Joe’s they pack your groceries in some very nice heavy duty paper bags with pretty robust paper handles. I have never had trouble with the bags ripping out or handles tearing off so there are heavy bags out there. For this application the purchases may be lighter or heavier than what we bought and stronger bags would be nice.

name: James Pettit
text: Very famous all day breakfast spot in Bar Harbor, Maine.  You have to try anything on the menu made with wild Maine blueberries.  I have been coming here for years and always recommend Jordan’s to everyone I know.  Perfect place to come after a Cadillac Mountain sunrise.  The blueberry pancakes are so yummy.  We’ll be back next year for sure!

name: Perks Advisor
text: Great breakfast joint!  I highly recommend the wild blueberry pancakes with maple syrup.   Breakfast is served quickly and they also offer eggs and blueberry muffins.  You can also order any number of sides.  The servers were friendly and efficient.

name: Katherine Cruz
text: Friendly staff and delicious homey comfort food. This place has a diner feel to it. Definitely recommend the blueberry muffins, they are delicious and the coffee is great.

name: Max P
text: The only game in town if you’re trying to get early breakfast- this spot opens at 5am!  I actually didn’t think much of the blueberry pancakes (feel like there was something off about the batter) or the muffins (preferred a more firm consistency).  The quiches were great though- both the tomato bacon cheddar and the broccoli cheddar ones were generously portioned and tasty.

name: Vicki Johnson
text: When you go out of town, you don't know how to pick where you're going to eat. You don't know if the foods good. If the place is clean. Nothing, unless someone you know refers you there. I went online and researched different places that we could go and eat. Jordan's had amazing reviews so we set off for town. Had some of the best food. Had amazing service and the place was really clean. So glad we picked it!

name: Nathaly
text: Tasty, straightforward, quick & good service. It's your typical neighborhood diner. No fluff or adventurous twists to classics. I really love breakfast spots with  fresh, locally sourced ingredients and creative menus but every once in awhile a good ol' classic breakfast will do. **Keep that in mind, when you ask for hot chocolate and it's from a machine😬

name: pmwartel
text: Excellent variety of breakfast selections. They are all like home made, delicious, and reasonably priced. Given the COVID situation, they took great care to sanitize the restaurant and properly space patrons from one another. Really one of those can't miss places for good reliable food and friendly service.

name: Maranda Nielson
text: We had such a great experience at Jordan's! The service was exceptional. We got our food quickly and our waitress was very attentive. The food was delicious and priced really well. I would recommend the blueberry muffin and blueberry pancakes! I hope to come back soon.

name: Alicia Daniel
text: This was a fun place with yummy food at good places. The potato salad was amazing. There can be a little bit of a wait, so plan ahead. Some of the supervisors weren’t overly nice to the staff, but it was lunch rush so I hope that wasn’t the norm. It’s the only reason they lose the 5th star.

name: Dad Does Stuff
text: Blueberry muffins are on point! Makes you feel at home when my wife and I eat here. It's a must for breakfast if in Bar Harbor

name: Narlo Schiesser
text: Come hungry because here food is delicious and the omelets are big, tasteful and service is fast. The best staff ever in this small town. We loved it since our first breakfast!

name: Khite Tzu
text: Food was great.  Service was amazingly fast. They have great teamwork,  not just one server.  Everyone was friendly.

name: Mike Finn
text:
One of the prettiest bars I’ve ever seen.

Good food, cold drinks, friendly service.

Thanks!!

name: Megan Townsley
text: As always, a pleasure to visit after seeing the sunrise on Cadillac Mtn. Our waitress was nice (although a smidge over-eager and channeling a sassy 50's waitress vibe which just didn't work) and the rest of the serving team was extremely kind and prompt. The quiche was well portioned, though a little over cooked and I wished it had been warned through. The side of bacon was yummy. The real winners here were the coffee (much improved over last year) and the "order of blue"- blueberry pancakes with blueberry syrup. Guys....this is where the gold is! Order these now!!

name: Boris Park
text: A classic dinner. Fresh ingredients make for tasty food. Many items feature Blueberries.

name: Andy Callens
text: Jordan's has a bit of a captive audience and is priced as such. Gets pricy if you start going ala carte with sides as they are offered. A solid diner, everything was good, but for breakfast it's hard to say this was above average diner fare with the exception of the very good blueberry syrup (again offered as an upgrade)

name: Julie Day
text: Delicious spot for breakfast always busy, but always worth the wait! Great coffee great service! Don't forget your souvenir bag on your way out, so worth it.  Love the muffin mix!

name: Thomas Tj
text: Excellent breakfast place. Open kitchen. Very lively and acquaint setting. Yummy pancakes and muffins.

name: Ben Trentman
text: We had a great experience at Jordans! The breakfast food was very good, especially the blueberry muffins, blueberry syrup on the pancakes, and the home fries (fried potatoes seasoned with Old Bay, maybe?). The coffee, eggs, sausage, and bacon were also pretty good. Our waitress was very helpful and had a wonderful accent (Brooklyn?), and the prices were reasonable on an island in which everything is expensive.

name: Marit Ivory
text: Great blueberry pancakes and muffins. Felt like a hometown dive. Would not recommend the Maine maple syrup for the up charge.

name: Ranger Ben
text: If you like good old fashioned breakfast at a good price this place is awesome.

text: Outstanding breakfast place!  Get blueberry muffins and pancakes.  Rest was standard breakfast food well done.

name: Stan Levenger
text: Unsofisicated diner food that is delicious. Been here many times and never disappointed. Breakfast is their speciality but they also have   Interesting lunch items like quiche. Breakfast home fries are done right in mass on the griddle. Many omelettes and other foods but anything with blueberries is amazing. Blueberry muffins are absolutely amazing being chocked full of berries and a having a very nice cake like dough. Must have if you go here along with the blueberry pancakes. A bit pricy and noisy but well worth it. Lobster asparagus quiche is highly recommended and can feed two.  Oh....and the blueberry pie is a must here.

text: Awesome pancakes!!! It was easy to get carried away and order more than I could actually eat. Everything was delicious and the staff were fantastic.
